items.title: Senior Data Engineer
items.summary: Who are we, and why are we hiring? We're based on over 15 years of success, producing world-class video content and building, developing, and managing a number of high-traffic websites.
items.description: Who are we, and why are we hiring? We're based on over 15 years of success, producing world-class video content and building, developing, and managing a number of high-traffic websites. Our award-winning content and websites are created exclusively by us and directly for the use of millions of users worldwide. At Kodify, we're not just pushing boundaries in online entertainment—we're rewriting the script! Our goal is to empower our people with everything they need to pioneer innovation in our industry. Our culture is our secret sauce, and we're committed to preserving and enhancing it every step of the way. Join our crew, where the Kodify team is not just an asset, it's our crown jewel. We prioritize their growth and well-being above all else, ensuring they're set up for success and always inspired to deliver their best work. As a rapidly expanding company with diverse hubs across the globe and over 20 vibrant national cultures, working with us means embracing thrilling challenges tailor-made for a star Senior Data Engineer! At Kodify, data is at the heart of how we make decisions. From product and marketing to finance and operations, every team relies on trustworthy data delivered at the right time. We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help us raise the bar — building the pipelines, models, and platforms that turn raw events into reliable insight at scale. What will you do? You'll help to evolve a data platform that supports products serving close to 100M unique visitors a month. Design, build, and own robust data pipelines from source systems (Postgres, MongoDB, event streams, third-party APIs) into our warehouse. Architecture - Make pragmatic decisions about ingestion, storage, transformation, and serving layers, including our columnar/analytical serving layer. Balance speed, cost, and maintainability. Modeling - Drive our dbt project: structure, conventions, testing, documentation, and CI. Make it a platform other people love to contribute to. Semantic layer - Own and evolve our semantic layer so metrics are defined once, governed centrally, and consumed consistently across BI, product, and finance. Governance & lineage - Champion data cataloging, documentation, and end-to-end lineage so everyone can find, trust, and understand our data. Quality & Reliability - Own data quality end-to-end: tests, monitoring, alerting, lineage, and SLAs. If a dashboard is wrong, you care. Performance - Optimize warehouse and columnar query performance. Know where the bottlenecks are before stakeholders do. Collaborate with the BI team, Product, Development, Marketing, and Finance to understand what they need and translate it into clean, reusable data models. Mentor the wider BI/Data team — code reviews, pairing, raising the technical bar on SQL, dbt, Python, and engineering practices. Duties - Becoming a valued team member, providing feedback about tech, development lifecycle and processes. Take ownership of your code / task / role. Goal - Be proud of the data platform you help build, and be one of the driving forces behind always making it better. Where and when: From wherever you want, the position is fully remote in the EU. We're very flexible about when you get your work done, but we do have some core hours where we like to overlap in order to promote collaboration and low-latency communication between team members (10:00 to 15:00 CET/CEST). Our daily virtual stand-ups are important for us but other than that, you're free to manage your own time. What we offer: Fully remote position or, if preferred, working in our awesome Barcelona office! Agile environment Top-notch tech stack! Flexible working hours + core hours! 10% on top of your salary for learning and development - of your choice! Latest tech equipment - Macbook Pro Company Amazon book account! Modify off-sites, on-sites, events, and team activities! Amazing international team! 1 day off on your birthday Generous vacation and personal days 1 month paid sabbatical after 3 years Health & Wellness budget Requirements Senior-level experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or similar — you've done this before, at scale, and you can show it. Expert-level PostgreSQL — complex transformations, window functions, performance tuning, the lot. Hands-on production experience with a columnar/analytical database (ClickHouse strongly preferred; BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake, or similar also relevant) — modeling for it, loading into it, and tuning queries against it. Solid building experience using AI - understanding AI harnessing best practices such as , hooks, skills, rules, mcps, plugins etc. Strong production experience with dbt — not just writing models, but structuring projects, testing strategy, macros, and CI/CD. Experience with a semantic/metrics layer (Cube.dev, dbt MetricFlow, LookML, or similar) — defining governed, reusable metrics. Experience with data cataloging, documentation, and lineage tooling (OpenMetadata, DataHub, or similar) — you treat discoverability and lineage as first-class, not an afterthought. Solid Python for data engineering — pipelines, scripting, APIs, data manipulation. Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and MongoDB as source systems (replication, CDC, schema evolution, the realities of pulling data out of them). Experience designing and maintaining data warehouses and dimensional/analytical models. Comfort with Git, code review, and modern software engineering practices applied to data. Strong sense of ownership — you don't wait to be told something is broken. A team player who likes to help others and solve problems together. Experience of mentoring junior engineers Investigation of new technologies. Advocate of clean code and clean architecture — applied to data. Passionate about testing — data tests, unit tests, end-to-end checks. You have a real 'Can Do' work ethic - We are results-based, not clock-based! You love to have fun while you work! Nice to have: Docker AWS Experience with high-traffic / high-volume data environments Understanding of Agile principles Experience working remotely Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt. ARR, Umsatz, GMV. Das sind die Kennzahlen, an denen sich unser Management und unsere Shareholder orientieren. Jemand muss die Verantwortung dafür übernehmen, was diese Kennzahlen tatsächlich bedeuten, entscheiden, wann ihre technische Definition angepasst werden muss, diese Änderungen in unserem Data Warehouse umsetzen und sicherstellen, dass die Menschen, die mit diesen Zahlen arbeiten, sie selbst erklären und vertreten können. Genau darum geht es in dieser Rolle. Es ist keine klassische Reporting-Rolle, in der Anforderungen und Anfragen abgearbeitet werden. Stattdessen übernimmst du die Verantwortung für das analytische Fundament unserer geschäftskritischen KPIs – von der SQL-Logik im Data Warehouse bis hin zu den technischen Definitionen, auf die sich Finance und Management verlassen, wenn beispielsweise die Frage aufkommt, warum sich eine Kennzahl im vergangenen Monat verändert hat. Diese Position ist Teil des Business Intelligence Teams und kann vor Ort, hybrid oder vollständig remote innerhalb Deutschlands besetzt werden . Dein Arbeitsort wird im Voraus vereinbart und bildet die Grundlage deines Arbeitsvertrags. KPI Ownership: Du verantwortest die technischen Definitionen und die zugrunde liegende Logik unserer geschäftskritischen KPIs – allen voran ARR und Umsatz. Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, bestehende Definitionen zu pflegen. Du beurteilst, wann eine technische Definition angepasst werden muss, steuerst Änderungen durch unsere Governance- und Freigabeprozesse, setzt sie technisch um und stehst hinter dem Ergebnis – auch dann, wenn es im Rahmen eines Audits oder durch externe Stakeholder kritisch hinterfragt wird. Dazu gehört auch die Kommunikation: Du erklärst Definitionen und Änderungen proaktiv und verständlich – von operativen Teams bis hin zum Management. Technische Expertise und unsere Datenlandschaft: Du entwickelst, debuggst und prüfst deine eigene analytische Logik. Deine fundierten SQL-Kenntnisse ermöglichen es dir, die benötigten Daten selbst zusammenzustellen, anstatt darauf warten zu müssen, dass andere sie bereitstellen. Du hast ein echtes End-to-End-Verständnis davon, wie Daten aus den Quellsystemen über das Data Warehouse bis ins Reporting gelangen. Dadurch kannst du unterscheiden, ob die Ursache eines Problems in den Daten, im Prozess oder in der Definition liegt. Du erkennst, wann ein Problem an der Quelle behoben werden muss, anstatt es lediglich im Reporting zu korrigieren. Gleichzeitig kannst du einen umfangreichen, laufenden Backlog eigenständig priorisieren und vom ersten Tag an selbstständig bearbeiten, ohne engmaschige Steuerung zu benötigen. Für unsere Pipelines oder die Plattform selbst bist du nicht verantwortlich – das übernehmen unsere Data Engineers, mit denen du eng zusammenarbeitest. Enabling statt reiner Umsetzung: Du gestaltest Definitionen, Modelle und Reportings so, dass Stakeholder ihre weiterführenden Fragen selbst beantworten können, statt für jede einzelne Frage erneut auf BI angewiesen zu sein. Für Finance bedeutet das konkret: Du entwickelst die Datenbasis, Tools und Transparenz, die es dem Team ermöglichen, Themen vollständig selbst zu verantworten, die fachlich bei Finance liegen – beispielsweise den Monatsabschluss oder ARR-Korrekturen. BI verantwortet die Definition und die technische Umsetzung; Finance verantwortet den Prozess und die Kennzahl. Das Ziel ist ein Prozess, den Finance eigenständig durchführen kann. Governance als Change Management: Gemeinsam mit dem Head of BI etablierst und verankerst du ein Governance-Framework für unsere geschäftskritischen KPIs. Ihr definiert, was Ownership auf Business- und BI-Seite konkret bedeutet, wie Definitionen dokumentiert, aktuell und audit-ready gehalten werden und wie Änderungen geprüft, entschieden und kommuniziert werden. Die eigentliche Herausforderung liegt dabei nicht in der Dokumentation, sondern in der Akzeptanz und Anwendung im Unternehmen. Du erhältst sowohl das Mandat als auch die Unterstützung des Leadership-Teams, um diese Veränderung voranzutreiben. Wissenstransfer: Du teilst Workflows, Logiken und Arbeitsweisen mit dem Team. So stellst du sicher, dass die von dir etablierten Standards nicht nur bei dir liegen, sondern nachhaltig im gesamten Team verankert werden. Das bringst du mit: Du verfügst über mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Business Intelligence oder Data Analytics. Dabei hast du Themen bereits eigenständig von Anfang bis Ende verantwortet, anstatt lediglich nach vorgegebenen Anforderungen zu arbeiten. SQL ist ein zentraler Bestandteil dieser Rolle und kein Nice-to-have . Du bist sicher darin, komplexe Logiken innerhalb eines mehrschichtigen Data Warehouses zu lesen, zu schreiben und zu debuggen. Dabei denkst du in Datenmodellen und übergreifenden Zusammenhängen, anstatt dich ausschließlich auf einzelne Queries zu konzentrieren. Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung mit einem modernen BI-Tool . Wir arbeiten derzeit mit MS Power BI, weshalb Erfahrung mit Power BI besonders wertvoll ist. Du hast Erfahrung mit Business- oder Finanz-KPIs und bist bereit, dich intensiv mit deren Definition und Berechnungslogik auseinanderzusetzen. Kenntnisse von SaaS-Kennzahlen wie ARR und NRR oder von Revenue Recognition sind ein großes Plus. Falls diese Themen für dich noch neu sind, erwarten wir echtes Interesse und die Bereitschaft, dich intensiv einzuarbeiten. Du hast Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Finance oder anderen Business-Stakeholdern . items.title: (Senior) Web Analyst (m/f/d)
items.summary: Who We AreSpread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology.
items.description: Who We Are Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Our core business model revolves around producing precisely what our customers desire, precisely when they desire it. As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products! As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as the (Senior) Web Analyst (f/m/d) and drive our business forward. What Will Your Role Be We're looking for a Senior Web Analyst to own and evolve our digital measurement ecosystem. You'll help us understand how millions of users interact with our digital products and turn that understanding into better product and business decisions.You'll work at the intersection of Product, Marketing and Engineering, ensuring that our tracking is accurate, scalable and future-proof. From defining measurement strategies to implementing tracking solutions and uncovering actionable insights, you'll play a key role in improving our digital products and customer experience. This is not a generic Data Analytics or Data Science role. We're looking for someone with a strong background in Web Analytics, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics or Product Analytics who enjoys solving real business problems through reliable data. What You´ll Do Own Digital Measurement Own and continuously improve our digital measurement landscape across multiple digital products. Design, implement and optimise client-side and server-side tracking solutions. Ensure accurate, scalable and privacy-compliant data collection. Drive Measurement Strategy Translate business questions into measurement concepts and technical tracking requirements. Define KPIs and success metrics together with Product, Marketing and business stakeholders. Develop tracking specifications for new products, features and customer journeys. Generate Insights Analyse user behaviour, customer journeys and conversion funnels. Build dashboards and reporting solutions that enable data-informed decision making. Identify optimisation opportunities and provide actionable recommendations. Experiment and Optimise Design, implement and evaluate A/B tests and experimentation initiatives. Measure the impact of new features, campaigns and product improvements. Continuously improve tracking quality, measurement standards and analytics processes. Collaborate Across Teams Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers and Marketing teams. Present analytical findings in a clear and actionable way to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Help establish analytics best practices across the organisation. What You´ll Bring Several years of experience in Web Analytics, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics or Product Analytics. Hands-on experience with modern tracking implementations and digital measurement architectures. Practical experience with tag management systems such as Adobe Experience Platform Tags or Google Tag Manager. Experience with Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics 4 or comparable enterprise analytics platforms. Solid knowledge of JavaScript and experience with SQL and/or Python. Experience with client-side and server-side tracking. Strong analytical thinking combined with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset. A solid understanding of data quality, tracking validation and analytics governance. Confidence working independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. Excellent written and spoken English. Nice to Have Experience with Product Analytics platforms. Experience with Looker Studio, Power BI or Tableau. Experience with BigQuery, Snowflake or similar cloud data environments. Experience with experimentation platforms. Knowledge of privacy regulations and consent management. Experience in e-commerce or digital consumer products. Why Should You Join Us Autonomy and Impact: We believe in giving people real ownership. You'll have the freedom to make decisions, take action, and see the direct impact of your work on the business. Development and Growth: We believe that the greatest professional and personal growth happens when you're challenged. If you're looking to build your career, you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so. We Win as a Team: Work alongside ambitious, motivated colleagues who challenge and support each other to achieve exceptional results. Through honest feedback, high standards, and shared ambition, we bring out the best in one another. Learn from Proven Entrepreneurs: Work closely with experienced founders and business leaders, gaining first-hand insights into growing a successful international company. Transparency and Involvement: Stay connected to our vision through regular General Assemblies, learn about our processes in our production sites in the Czech Republic and join workshops and cross function initiatives to lead positive change. The Extras That Matter: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, attractive employee discounts on our products and partner brands, modern office spaces designed for collaboration, and regular company events where we celebrate our successes together. Equal Opportunity Employer We value diversity at Spread Group . We are proud of and continue to encourage the increasing diversity of our company culture and community. Your skills, talents, and experience are our focus no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital or disability status. Extraordinary teams building inspiring projects: Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place. Differentiated by the quality of our people and our relentless drive to deliver the most successful outcomes, we align our capabilities to our customers' objectives to create a lasting positive impact. We serve the Infrastructure; Nuclear, Security & Environmental; Energy; Mining & Metals, and the Manufacturing and Technology markets. Our services span from initial planning and investment, through start-up and operations. Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments . They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report . Project Overview: The rapid growth of AI and digitalization is fueling unprecedented demand for data centers that require large, reliable sources of energy. In response to this market trend, the Renewables & Clean Power (R&CP) team has signed an early works contract to build one of the largest gas-fired power generation facilities in the U.S. Our team is helping the customer progress early-stage development, that would lead to the start of full EPC delivery in 2026. The candidate will act as the Field Systems Technician on the Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) Project in Cheyenne, Wyoming. The candidate may start in the home office in Reston-VA to support planning, ahead of project mobilization to the field, when the candidate will locate on a long-term assignment to the project in Cheyenne, Wyoming. This position is contingent upon project award. Job Summary: Reporting to the EPC Automation Lead role, the Field Tech Coordinator is responsible for the implementation, configuration and support of jobsite digital/automation applications. The successful candidate can expect to deploy a broad range of automation, innovation, and AI solutions in the field. Working under the direction of the EPC Automation Lead, this position works with the site team to help implement digital solutions - mobile applications, configurations, troubleshoot system issues, prepare dashboards, documentation, and assist with user support and training. This role contributes to the overall digital delivery strategy and ensures site teams can effectively use automation tools to drive safe and efficient execution. #LI-RM1 Major Responsibilities: Assist the EPC Automation Lead and Lead Field Tech Coordinator in the deployment and management of Bechtel Standard Applications (BSAPs) and related workflows in line with Bechtel standard work processes. Assist the EPC Automation Lead in coordinating with the Project Field Engineer, project IS&T Lead, and other automation leads (procurement and project controls, commissioning, etc.), as well as Bechtel functional leads, to support AWP processes. Audit data exchanges to and from field applications and ensure they are correctly configured to support construction & Commissioning work activities. Review any application deviations raised by the project team, evaluate their impact on other applications, data integration, and work processes, and work with the project EPC Automation Lead, Lead Field Tech Coordinator, and Construction Automation teams for verification and approval of deviations. Develop and maintain reporting solutions, including performance curves, metrics, dashboards, and trackers to drive insights and continuous improvement. Provide day-to-day operational support, including troubleshooting, issue resolution, system monitoring, and escalation of complex technical issues. Lead training, onboarding, and user support, including the development of user guides and training materials for project teams, contractors, and suppliers. Ensure contractor and supplier compliance with automation, data quality, and reporting requirements across construction workflows. Participates in the rollout of new technologies, services, and security remediations by working with the project EPC Automation Lead, GBU Innovation Manager, AI Program Manager, and BEO. Support execution planning and digital adoption, including upskilling initiatives and alignment of automation solutions with project delivery objectives. Champion innovation and digital transformation, including AI, robotics, and field data capture technologies (e.g., drones), fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Education and Experience Requirements: Bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Construction Management, or a related discipline with less than 1 year of experience or 4-5 years of relevant work experience in lieu of degree. Required Knowledge and Skills: Required Knowledge and Skills: Basic knowledge of engineering and construction methods, workflows, and capital project execution processes, including cross-functional integration across Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Project Controls, Startup, Safety, Quality, and Client teams. Experience in data analysis and management, including understanding data relationships, performing validation, identifying anomalies, and developing corrective or recovery actions. Understanding of system integration, configuration, and change management practices, including configuration control, troubleshooting, and support of construction automation systems. Familiarity with 3D modeling and construction visualization tools (e.g., Navisworks) to support planning and coordination activities. Strong problem-solving capability with a practical, hands-on, and self-directed approach, combined with adaptability to learn new tools and technologies (e.g., Power Platform, drones/GIS). Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively with field teams, contractors, and global stakeholders, build relationships, gather feedback, and drive continuous improvement. Commitment to safety, including knowledge of Bechtel's "Zero Incidents" program and a demonstrated focus on maintaining a safe and healthy work environment. Preferred Qualifications: Basic understanding of EPC automation applications and associated work processes (e.g., installed quantities, work packaging, turnover/completions, technical correspondence) and ability to articulate construction requirements across functions. Working knowledge of construction progress measurement processes (e.g., QURR) and related reporting practices. Experience in Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint Online) for solution development and automation. Experience with 4D planning/visualization (Synchro) and Autodesk ecosystem tools (e.g., Revit, Navisworks) to support construction sequencing and analysis. Experience with project turnover and completions processes, including data readiness and system handover requirements. Experience with SQL database administration and data management Total Rewards/Benefits: For decades, Bechtel has worked to inspire the next generation of employees and beyond! Because our teams face some of the world's toughest challenges, we offer robust benefits to ensure our people thrive. Whether it is advancing careers, delivering programs to enhance our culture, or providing time to recharge, Bechtel has the benefits to build a legacy of sustainable growth. Learn more at Bechtel Total Rewards Diverse teams build the extraordinary: As a global company, Bechtel has long been home to a vibrant multitude of nationalities, cultures, ethnicities, and life experiences. This diversity has made us a more trusted partner, more effective problem solvers and innovators, and a more attractive destination for leading talent. We are committed to being a company where every colleague feels that they belong-where colleagues feel part of "One Team," respected and rewarded for what they bring, supported in pursuing their goals, invested in our values and purpose, and treated equitably. Click here to learn more about the people who power our legacy. The position to which you are applying may have additional background and drug screening requirements from those of your current position. Please speak with your Bechtel recruiter to determine if any additional background and drug screening is required for this position and work location. Bechtel's internal staffing policy includes the minimum time that you need to be in your current position before applying to a new position. Please refer to the applicable policy manual and ensure you meet the minimum requirements. Per Policy 203-Internal Staffing, the Functional Manager of all internal Bechtel employees that are selected to proceed with an interview as part of Bechtel's internal recruitment process will receive a notification including the position title and corresponding Functional Lead. Please note that the overtime designation for this position might differ from your current position even if the position is at the same grade level. Please speak with your TA Specialist to understand the overtime eligibility for this role.

items.summary: We are currently recruiting a Data Analytics & ERP Consultant to work with our Awards Management Unit.
items.description: We are currently recruiting a Data Analytics & ERP Consultant to work with our Awards Management Unit. This is a 3-month, remote independent consultant contract, where candidates are ideally able to work during working hours in EST, EEST and/or AST time zones. At Relief International , we are committed to building a representative, inclusive and authentic workplace. We strongly encourage applications from candidates from minoritized backgrounds and those who bring lived experience of the contexts in which we work. Statement of Work Consultancy Title: Data Analytics & ERP Consultant Location where the Services are to be performed: Remote Contracting Manager: Global Awards Director, with technical reporting to the Global Awards and Donor-Compliance Coordinator, and Global Partnerships Advisor (joint technical oversight) Timings: 34 days worked across 3 months Dates: September 15, 2026 – December 15, 2026 Pre Hire Checks Requirements: Standard pre contracting checks. About Relief International Relief International is an international non-profit organization that partners with communities impacted by conflict, climate change and disaster to save lives, build greater resilience and promote long-term health and wellbeing. We work in countries across Africa, Asia, and the Middle East, providing Health and Nutrition, WASH (Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene), Education and Livelihoods programming that creates the foundation for community resilience. Scope and Nature of Services: Relief International 's Awards Management Unit (AMU) is responsible for award and partnership management across the full grant lifecycle, from pre-award review, contracting, modifications, and compliance reporting, to close-out. This includes direct oversight of the partner and sub-award lifecycle across country offices: partner due diligence, SGA and drafting, partner performance, alongside prime award compliance and donor reporting obligations. AMU is completing a 2025 update to the NetSuite Partnerships Module (originally built in 2023), which will become the system of record for both award and partner data. Ahead of full NetSuite roll-out, AMU relies on country-office award and partner matrices maintained outside the system, we need these data to be visualized, to enable AMU's to report in real time on award/sub-award volumes, ICR, partner status, due diligence (DD) compliance, and cost-contribution tracking. AMU requires a consultant to professionalize this reporting in the interim and to ensure continuity into NetSuite once the transition is complete. Objective To strengthen AMU's data management and reporting capability by (a) consolidating and visualizing current country-office award data into a live Power BI dashboard, and (b) preparing data structures, logic, and reporting continuity for the NetSuite Partnerships Module transition, including bridge solutions for the interim period. Information, services or resources to be provided by the consultant: The consultant is expected to be able to carry any of the following tasks: Data Consolidation & Management Review existing country-office award matrices and identify inconsistencies, duplication, and gaps against AMU's reporting needs. Lead the design and maintain a consolidated master dataset (awards, sub-awards, partners) with a clear data version control. Establish a standard data submission template and validation/QA process for country offices. Lead the design database for AMU to launch, collect COs KPIs and how to manage and visualize these data. Reporting & Power BI Dashboard Build and maintain a live Power BI dashboard connected to the consolidated dataset (and later to NetSuite), refreshed on an agreed cadence. Ensure the dashboard is structured for role-based access (AMU, Country Directors, senior management). NetSuite Transition Support Interim/bridge solution: provide a temporary data and reporting mechanism that covers AMU's needs while NetSuite is not yet fully live. NetSuite alignment: map dashboard fields and logic to the Award and partnerships Module's fields, current requirements, and workflows so reporting migrates cleanly once NetSuite goes live. Post-transition continuity: advise on and help configure NetSuite. Analytics Connect / API connectivity so Power BI can pull live from NetSuite, and document the reporting logic for AMU and the dev team. Consultant Profile Essential requirements: Proven experience in humanitarian/development sector data management (NGO experience strongly preferred). Advanced Power BI skills Working knowledge ERP/grants-management systems. Understanding of sub-award/grants-management concepts: ICR/NICRA, cost share/match, FFATA, due diligence and risk assessment, OCA. Demonstrated ability to design bridge/interim data solutions during system transitions, adaptable and sustainable. Desired requirements: Product management or business-analyst background, able to translate functional requirements into technical specs for a dev team (relevant given the ongoing NetSuite transition). Prior experience with multi-country data collection from field/country offices with variable data quality and connectivity. Data governance / data quality framework experience (validation rules, audit trails, version control). Familiarity with UN and other major institutional donor reporting requirements. Skills and Competencies: Proven ability to deliver reporting solutions with evolving data, prioritizing usable outputs. Excellent stakeholder engagement skills, with experience training or supporting non-technical, multi-country field staff to ensure timely data submission. Prior experience supporting a data or systems migration from a legacy platform to a new system. Flexibility to align delivery schedule with the ERP system development timeline and go-live milestones. Strong documentation skills, including data dictionaries and technical handover materials for both non-technical and technical audiences. RI Values. Guided by the humanitarian principles of humanity, neutrality, impartiality, and independence, as well as “Do No Harm,” Relief International Values: We value: Integrity Adaptability Collaboration Inclusivity Sustainability How To Apply To apply for this post, click on the Apply button in the job advert page. You will be asked to upload a CV and Cover Letter (Proposal). The cover letter should be one page, and outline your proposal on how you would deliver the services outlined above. Please include your daily rate, and timelines where possible. Closing Date September 7, 2026. As a humanitarian organization, Relief International is committed to the safeguarding of all those we come into contact with through our work. We are committed to the core humanitarian principles regarding prevention of sexual exploitation and abuse. Relief International expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment and uphold the values and behaviors outlined in the Code of Conduct. Recruitment to all roles in Relief International include a criminal records self-declaration, references, and other pre-employment checks, which may include police and qualifications checks. items.summary: AffirmedRx is on a mission to improve health care outcomes by bringing clarity, integrity, and trust to pharmacy benefit management.
items.description: AffirmedRx is on a mission to improve health care outcomes by bringing clarity, integrity, and trust to pharmacy benefit management. We are committed to making pharmacy benefits easy to understand, straightforward to access and always in the best interest of employers and the lives they impact. We accomplish this by bringing total clarity to business practices, leading with clinical approaches, and utilizing state-of-the-art technology. Join us in improving health care outcomes for all! We promise to do what’s right, always. Position Summary: The Data Scientist (AI/ML) designs, builds, and validates the advanced analytics that turn pharmacy, claims, clinical, and member data into decisions. This is a hands-on modeling role: the person owns machine learning models end to end, applies AI and natural language processing to unstructured clinical and member data, resolves member identity across fragmented data sources, and packages results into tools and dashboards the business can use. The role sits at the intersection of data science, clinical/pharmacy reporting, and applied AI, and partners closely with data engineering, clinical, reporting, and client-success teams. What you will do: Machine Learning and Predictive Modeling: Build predictive and prescriptive ML models for pharmacy cost and risk (e.g., forecasting second-year member spend), including feature engineering, model selection, and explainability analysis (e.g., SHAP-based feature attribution) Develop member-level risk and comorbidity scoring, mapping drug identifiers (NDC → ATC) to clinical conditions and severity weights, and validating outputs against edge cases Apply ML to automate high-effort clinical operations processes (e.g., prior-authorization override automation), moving manual workflows into rules-based and model-driven pipelines Applied AI and Natural Language Processing: Use AI/NLP to analyze unstructured member and clinical text — sentiment analysis, topic modeling, and tokenization of open-ended survey and feedback data Apply AI tooling (LLMs / copilots and internal AI services) to automate clinical policy and documentation workflows, including prompt design, output validation, and controls against hallucination and format drift Contribute to the organization’s broader AI direction: evaluating models, defining evaluation/answer-key datasets, and building drift and validation checks for AI outputs Member Identity Resolution and Data Quality: Design and maintain probabilistic (fuzzy) matching logic to assign and reconcile unique member identifiers across carriers and source systems, including collision handling, cluster analysis, and audit/logging frameworks Monitor and improve match rates, investigate false positives and fragmentation, and document data lineage and safeguards against duplicates Clinical and Pharmacy Analytics: Produce clinical and pharmacy analytics such as medication adherence and persistence (drug-, class-, and NDC-level), aligned to compliance requirements (e.g., URAC / PQA measures) QA and validate reporting products (e.g., pharmacy trend dashboards, PMPM metrics), reconciling data-point discrepancies across source systems Analytical Tooling and Delivery: Build analytical tools and prototypes (e.g., formulary/tier decision tools and cost-comparison tools), including lightweight front ends (e.g., Streamlit) for sales, clinical, and pricing use Deliver validated datasets and tables into the data warehouse in partnership with data engineering, and support the transition of prototypes into production Validation, Documentation, and Collaboration: Own QA and validation for analytical outputs, including auditing of claims files and validation of model results before release Document models, logic, data sources, schedules, and troubleshooting steps to make work reproducible and auditable Collaborate across clinical, reporting, pricing, client-success, and engineering stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into analytical specifications What you need: Degree in a quantitative field (data science, statistics, computer science, applied math) or equivalent experience 2–3 years of experience using Python and SQL for data analysis, machine learning, NLP, data quality, and record-matching solutions. Data modeling experience in PBM and/or healthcare industry in general preferred Strong Python for data science and ML (e.g., pandas plus a modeling stack), and proficiency in SQL Demonstrated experience building and validating ML models, including feature engineering and model explainability Experience with NLP techniques (sentiment analysis, topic modeling) and with applying AI/LLM tooling to real workflows, including output validation Experience with entity resolution / probabilistic record matching and data-quality analysis Comfort working with a modern cloud data warehouse and data lake, and partnering with data engineering on production hand-off Healthcare, pharmacy benefit management (PBM), or claims-data experience Familiarity with pharmacy data concepts (NDC, GPI, ATC, formulary tiers, prior authorization, rebates) Experience with compliance-driven reporting (e.g., URAC / PQA measures) Experience building analytical front ends or dashboards (e.g., Streamlit, BI tools) for non-technical stakeholders Willingness and ability to travel (10%-20%) What you get: To impact industry change in the pharmacy benefits management space, while delivering the highest quality patient outcomes To work in a culture where people thrive because when OUR team thrives, OUR business thrives Competitive compensation, including health, dental, vision and other benefits Note: AffirmedRx is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. Remote employees are expected to maintain a professional work environment free of distractions to ensure optimal performance and collaboration. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Position SummaryThe Project Monitor operates the performance, data, and compliance monitoring system for project.
items.description: Position Summary The Project Monitor operates the performance, data, and compliance monitoring system for project. This individual translates the QASP and PWS into measurable definitions, reliable data-collection processes, dashboards, quarterly reports, and corrective-action workflows. The Project Monitor provides an objective view of whether TTA, pilots, products, and deliverables are timely, high quality, useful, and likely to produce sustainable results. Core Responsibilities Develop and maintain the performance-measure dictionary, data-collection plan, reporting calendar, source documentation, quality checks, and dashboard required by the QASP. Track the number, type, frequency, duration, level of effort, recipients, outputs, and status of TTA and program-support activities by quarter. Measure recipient roles, knowledge gain, use of rapid-cycle evaluation and learning, satisfaction, implementation progress, product use, and sustainability indicators. Monitor the PWS requirement that at least 85 percent satisfaction be achieved for sponsored training and technical assistance activities and flag emerging performance gaps. Compile quarterly performance and outcomes reports and provide validated monitoring inputs for monthly status reports, the annual report, briefings, and pilot learning products. Track deliverable schedules, review cycles, Government comments, acceptance status, quality findings, risks, corrective actions, and evidence of closure. Support pilot-site data planning, baseline and monitoring data, data dictionaries, data-use controls, privacy protections, missing-data rules, and cross-site synthesis. Conduct data-quality checks, reconcile source records, document limitations, and prevent unsupported causal claims or overstatement of results. Coordinate with the Project Leader and SME and Content Manager on logic models, measures, analytic questions, promising-practice evidence, and product performance. Required Qualifications At least five years of experience in program monitoring, performance measurement, evaluation, data analysis, quality assurance, or federal contract compliance. Demonstrated ability to define measures, design data-collection tools, validate data, develop dashboards, and produce clear performance reports. Experience with qualitative and quantitative data, surveys or feedback instruments, data dictionaries, documentation, and data-quality controls. Working knowledge of privacy, confidentiality, secure data handling, Section 508, and responsible reporting of limitations. Strong analytical writing and ability to explain performance findings to project leaders, technical staff, pilot sites, and nontechnical client audiences. Preferred Qualifications Graduate training in program evaluation, public policy, statistics, economics, sociology, public administration, or a related field. Experience with TANF, HMRF, means-tested programs, rapid-cycle learning, multi-site pilots, or human-services administrative data. Proficiency with Power BI, Tableau, Excel, R, Stata, SPSS, SAS, Qualtrics, or comparable analytics and survey tools. Education and Experience Bachelor's degree in evaluation, statistics, economics, public policy, social science, public administration, or a related field required; master's degree preferred. Five or more years of directly relevant experience is preferred. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: OGC is a boutique research and consulting agency specializing in data-driven strategy, quantitative analytics, and Customer Experience (CX) program design and optimization.
items.description: OGC is a boutique research and consulting agency specializing in data-driven strategy, quantitative analytics, and Customer Experience (CX) program design and optimization. We work with some of the world's largest organizations across a variety of industries, including Financial Services, Specialty Retail, Telecommunications, Hospitality, and Software, helping them gain a deep understanding of their customers, develop actionable insights, and improve business processes. Our client is a global leader in the Consumer Packaged Goods industry, with a focus on delivering data-driven insights that support commercial decision-making and business growth. Their Growth Analytics team develops dashboards and reporting solutions used by senior leadership across the organization. They are seeking a Data Liaison to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical development teams, ensuring reporting solutions accurately reflect business needs and industry metrics. This is a 6-month remote contract with the potential for extension. About the Role The ideal candidate is analytical, commercially minded, and an exceptional communicator who enjoys translating business needs into actionable data requirements. You will work closely with business stakeholders, insights teams, and analytics developers to ensure dashboards and reporting solutions are built using the correct business logic, calculations, and data sources. This role is ideal for someone with experience in business analytics, commercial insights, or consumer insights who understands both the language of the business and the language of data. should be comfortable working closely with technical teams, translating business requirements into technical specifications, and validating data before it reaches senior leadership. You'll also play an important role in helping the analytics team build a stronger understanding of the business, enabling them to become increasingly self-sufficient over time. Responsibilities Include Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, insights teams, and analytics developers, translating executive requests into clear business requirements, data specifications, and analytical approaches. Review dashboards, calculations, and reporting logic before release, ensuring the correct business logic, methodologies, metrics, and data sources (including syndicated datasets such as Nielsen) are used while proactively identifying and resolving reporting inaccuracies. Participate in business and executive reporting discussions to understand business priorities, reporting requirements, and how data is used to support decision-making. Document business metrics, calculation methodologies, and data source guidance to establish consistent reporting standards and best practices. Coach and mentor analytics developers to strengthen their understanding of business metrics, commercial context, and reporting expectations, with the goal of enabling greater independence over time. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve reporting processes, strengthen communication between business and technical functions, and develop scalable documentation and best practices that enhance the long-term capability of the analytics team. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Marketing, or a related field. 4+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Consumer Insights, Market Research, Strategy, or a related analytical role. Experience within Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Retail, or a similar commercial environment is strongly preferred. Experience working with syndicated data sources, particularly Nielsen, with the ability to determine the most appropriate data source for different business questions. Strong understanding of retail and commercial performance metrics, including velocity, points of distribution, market share, merchandising, pricing, and related KPIs. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to validate data, calculations, business logic, and reporting accuracy. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into clear guidance for technical and analytics teams. Experience collaborating with analytics, BI, engineering, or dashboard development teams in a cross-functional environment. Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Experience with business intelligence platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools is advantageous. Technical coding or dashboard development experience is not required; however, the ability to engage credibly with technical teams is essential. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Payments Analyst StellarTech is a rapidly growing company at the forefront of innovation in the EdTech industry. We build and scale educational apps for users around the world, combining data, technology, and an x1000 mindset to create meaningful products and sustainable business models. We are looking for a Payments Analyst to join our Payments Division. Payments sit at one of the most critical points in the customer journey: the moment user intent turns into revenue. As our product portfolio and global presence continue to grow, we need an analyst who will help us keep payment reporting accurate, monitor performance, identify anomalies, and support data-driven improvements across our payment flows. You will gradually take ownership of day-to-day payment analytics while developing deep expertise in transactional data, monetization, and subscription products. What You’ll Do Maintain and improve recurring payment reports and dashboards. Adapt existing reporting for new applications, markets, and business needs. Create analytical reports and data extracts independently. Add new filters and dimensions to existing dashboards. Monitor payment performance, alerts, and week-over-week changes in key metrics. Identify anomalies in payment data and conduct first-line investigations into possible causes. Perform data quality checks and help maintain consistency across multiple data sources. Work with large product and transactional datasets. Support the Payments team with clear conclusions and actionable insights, not just raw data. Collaborate with Payments, Product, Finance, and other cross-functional teams. Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports and analytical workflows. Gradually contribute to more advanced payment analytics, experiments, and business hypotheses. What We’re Looking For 1-3 years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, or a similar analytical role. Strong SQL skills and the ability to write queries independently. Practical Python skills for data analysis and automation. Working knowledge of statistics and analytical methods. Experience working with large datasets and real product or business data. Experience creating or maintaining reports and BI dashboards. Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills. Ability to validate data, identify inconsistencies, and investigate anomalies. Ability to clearly explain what you did, what problem you solved, and how the result was useful. Strong attention to detail and respect for data accuracy. An ownership mindset: you do not simply complete tasks but take responsibility for the result. High learning agility and genuine interest in developing within the payments domain. Clear, structured communication and willingness to raise questions or blockers early. Nice to Have Experience working with payment, transactional, billing, or financial data. Experience in subscription-based, web-to-app, fintech, e-commerce, gaming, or other high-volume B2C products. Understanding of monetization models and online payment flows. Experience with AWS Athena or Amazon S3. Experience with Tableau, Apache Superset, Looker, or similar BI tools. Experience automating reports or recurring analytical processes. Personal, academic, or professional projects involving automation, AI tools, or real-world datasets. Previous payments experience is an advantage, but it is not a requirement. Strong analytical fundamentals, ownership, and the ability to learn quickly matter more. What Success Looks Like During your first months, you will learn the Payments Division’s data, reporting logic, and key processes. You will gradually take ownership of recurring dashboards, reports, filters, data extracts, monitoring, and alerting. You will be able to identify issues, explain what is happening in the data, and escalate anomalies with the necessary context. Why You’ll Love Working With Us Direct business impact: Work with data at the point where customer intent becomes revenue. Global scale: Analyze payment flows across multiple products, markets, and payment methods. Valuable expertise: Build your career in payments, transactions, subscriptions, and monetization. Professional growth: Learn directly from an experienced Senior Analyst and gradually take ownership of your analytical area. Modern tools: Work with SQL, Python, AWS Athena/S3, Tableau/Superset, and AI-powered solutions. Innovative environment: Experiment, improve processes, and bring your own ideas. Global remote: Work remotely as part of an international product company. Health support: Company-provided medical expense compensation. AI tools: Company-covered AI subscriptions and other tools. Balance: 21 days of annual leave plus 10 bank holidays. Collaborative culture: Work with ambitious professionals who value reliable evidence, extreme ownership, energy, and speed. items.summary: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher.
items.description: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher. Your core mission will involve a deep dive into the complex internals and mechanics of various blockchain networks, reverse engineering of sophisticated Decentralized Finance (DeFi) protocols, and translating these complex systems into actionable, structured data. Develop new derivative data models and datasets for client insights and competitive advantages. Map, cleanse, and normalize raw, disparate blockchain data (transaction logs, smart contract events, state changes) into consistent, structured relational and non-relational schemes for consumption by analytics, machine learning, and AI tools. This role requires a unique blend of expertise in distributed systems, data engineering best practices, and a profound understanding of the crypto and decentralized ecosystem. What You’ll Do Maintain an AI-native and blockchain-forward mindset, proactively leveraging emerging trends and generative technologies to stay at the vanguard of the crypto revolution while maximizing work efficiency and uncovering novel, high-alpha data opportunities. Architect Intuitive Data Models: Turn the messiness of on-chain data into elegant, unified abstractions. You'll build the models that provide our users with granular, high-integrity insights across various protocols. Deconstruct DeFi Mechanics: Get under the hood of DeFi protocols. You'll reverse-engineer smart contracts and on-chain events, translating complex interactions into clean, production-grade SQL/dbt models. Scale Our Ecosystem Coverage: Lead the charge in indexing new blockchains. You’ll design the schemas that transform raw chain data into our internal "source of truth," ensuring every block is captured with 100% accuracy. Engineer Signal from Noise: Define the metrics that matter (TVL, Volume, Fees). You’ll be the gatekeeper of data quality, proactively identifying and filtering out wash trading, bot activity, and Sybil attacks. What You'll Need: Experience 3+ years hands-on in Data Science, Data Engineering, or a hybrid role; Blockchain or crypto analytics background strongly preferred, familiarity with on-chain data structures, transaction semantics, and asset classification; Streaming & Lakehouse Apache Flink or Spark Streaming building and operating real-time data pipelines; Apache Iceberg or Apache Hudi managing large-scale Data Lakehouses with schema evolution, time travel, and ACID guarantees over petabytes of raw blockchain data; AWS Data Platform S3 for scalable data lake storage; RDS for structured relational workloads; Spark SQL and PySpark for interactive querying and ad-hoc analysis; Caching & Distribution Familiarity with Data Grid technologies (e.g. Hazelcast, Apache Ignite, Redis) for high-throughput, low-latency data access patterns; Languages & Tooling SQL advanced query writing, window functions, query plan analysis, performance tuning at scale; Python Pandas, Polars for data wrangling; Scikit-learn for model development; Proficient in architecting high-throughput ingestion pipelines that leverage external data sources REST/WebSocket APIs, JSON-RPC node queries; Strong grasp of ETL fundamentals (extract, transform, load), including managing schema mismatches between heterogeneous sources and destinations; Engineering Mindset Systematic approach to debugging: reproducing issues, isolating root cause, validating fixes; Comfortable working with large, semi-structured, or undocumented data sources. Why Join Lukka ? Are you looking for a challenge? Lukka solves the most complex data and technology challenges for an industry that is at the forefront of innovation. At Lukka , we strive to anticipate and respond to the needs of this new and ever-changing ecosystem of digital assets. That was true in 2014, while everyone was focused on trading & buying this new asset class, we were thinking about the tax implications of crypto. That innovative foresight continues today as we evolve and iterate on our product suite to address the regulations and educate our customers. We are looking for passionate, collaborative, and strategic individuals who want to help shape the future of, well, everything – starting with making crypto more accountable. We invest in our teammates, promote from within & are responsible to each other by fostering an inclusive space for curious minds to thrive and innovate. What’s life @ Lukka like? We move fast and continue to be ahead of the curve. You could be part of a growing company bridging the gap between business and blockchain. Here’s some insight into why our team members have joined: Ability to own the projects they work on; Less red tape to take ideas from inception to delivery; Being at the forefront of an industry; Small team, big dreams. Of course, let’s discuss some perks: Opportunity to work directly on data for digital assets, an industry-leading product with well-known clients. Working with multiple AI solutions daily. Exposure to both technical problem-solving and customer-facing challenges. A growing Poland-based team with direct collaboration across US and global stakeholders. A startup-style culture where your impact is visible every day. So you’ve scrolled, your interest is piqued and hopefully read all of the important things...now what? This is an exciting time to join a team that’s at the forefront of this rapidly growing industry. We are looking for people who constantly push themselves to think differently, are ready to face new challenges and chart exciting new paths. If this sounds like you, apply! items.description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The Role: We are seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer to drive significant business impact by shaping our data infrastructure, developing robust data models, and promoting best practices in analytics engineering (e.g., data quality, documentation, and scalable data architectures). You will collaborate closely with the Marketing team in order to ensure that funnels are being tracked and surfaced in our data models and that Marketing campaigns can be evaluated using accurate data. What you'll do: Create trusted, self-serve datasets and reporting layers in Omni that power Marketing performance reviews, campaign reporting, attribution analysis, funnel health monitoring, and investment decision-making. Proactively identify and resolve data quality issues across Marketing and GTM systems, including source tracking, campaign metadata, funnel stage completeness, attribution coverage, and spend data. Add comprehensive metadata to datasets, including documentation, lineage, ownership, definitions, data quality checks, and sensitive data masking. Partner with Marketing stakeholders to translate business questions into robust data products, dashboards, analyses, and decision-ready insights. Enable Marketing teams to confidently use Omni and core GTM datasets through documentation, training, office hours, and self-serve resources. Activate data from Snowflake into operational tools where needed, supporting audience segmentation, lifecycle programmes, campaign optimisation, or GTM workflows. We'd love to hear from you: Extensive experience in analytics engineering or related data roles, with demonstrated expertise in advanced SQL, dbt, and Snowflake. Proficient in using BI tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker, PowerBI, Snowsight) to deliver clear, actionable insights for business stakeholders. Skilled in performing data ingestion and activation using no-code tools (e.g. Fivetran, Stitch), ensuring efficient data integration into operational systems. Knowledgeable in managing metadata, documentation, data quality checks, and sensitive data masking effectively. Effective at collaborating closely with diverse stakeholders, understanding their data needs, and delivering impactful solutions. Experienced in conducting training sessions and providing informal mentorship to junior analytics team members, fostering a collaborative and knowledge-sharing environment. Familiar with Marketing and GTM data concepts such as campaign tracking, attribution, funnel stages, lead/account lifecycle, pipeline generation, paid media, web analytics, CRM data, and marketing automation data. Experienced with common GTM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Google Analytics, ad platforms, enrichment tools, or similar. The exact stack is less important than the ability to understand how GTM data is created, transformed, and used. Comfortable working across Marketing, RevOps, Sales, Finance, and Data to align definitions, reporting logic, and ownership. Everyone is welcome at Paddle At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group. Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together. Our Values Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us” Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple” Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs” Why you’ll love working at Paddle We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture. We are a ‘digital-first’ company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and 4 months paid family leave regardless of gender. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

items.summary: Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money.
items.description: Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money. For too long, financial systems have worked for the institutions that built them, not the people using them. Runaway interest, fine print and limited access have left many behind, feeling shut out of a system that wasn't setting them up for success. We're building a different kind of system, in a complete money app to send, spend and save. One that's clear, flexible and puts people and businesses in control. Founded in 2019, we serve customers and businesses across Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. Millions of customers and 65,000 global brands, government services and small businesses rely on us today. What began as a better way to pay at checkout has grown into a financial system working the way it should have all along. You will lead a team of analysts that work on activation, engagement, and profitability , helping shape how the product grows from 1 → 100. The role requires balancing user growth with sustainable economics , working across Product, Risk, and Growth teams. Experience in planning data structures for new products and features. Strong knowledge of Python (Pandas, Numpy, Statsmodels, Matplotlib, etc.) Experience in product analytics in fintech is a plus. Job Overview: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior UX Research & Design Specialist with a dual passion for user advocacy and tangible web design. In this role, you will lead end-to-end qualitative and quantitative research cycles within our K-12 educational data and assessment platforms. Beyond traditional data synthesis, you possess a strong sense of visual and layout design, allowing you to translate raw researcher findings directly into clean, interactive, and tangible UI prototypes. You will act as a critical bridge between educator insights and production-ready web design. Drive Feedback Syntheses: Design and facilitate educator panels to capture nuanced workflows, translating feedback into clear product design opportunities. Iterate and Track Perceptions: Build systematic, iterative research loops to measure shifts in user perception and long-term platform adoption. Manage Diverse Recruitment: Orchestrate participant recruitment strategies across varied K-12 demographics (elementary, middle, and high school tenures). Tangible Web Design & Interactive Prototyping Translate Insights into Mockups: Convert user pain points and research metrics into high-fidelity web designs, intuitive screen flows, and interactive layouts. Bridge Design and Engineering: Collaborate directly with front-end web designers by delivering design specifications that map closely to web structure realities. Refine Interface Hierarchy: Evaluate and rapidly iterate on layout sequences, visual hierarchies, UI text labeling, and main navigation structures. K-12 Assessment & Data Literacy Demystify Student Data: Apply deep knowledge of K-12 grading architectures and standards-based reporting to build accessible teacher dashboards. Align with Classroom Realities: Design specifically for time-constrained educators who need immediate visual data displays for student remediation and administrative groupings. Data Visualization & Web Usability Apply Visualization Best Practices: Craft clean, visual progress bars, color-coded matrices, and grouping indicators tailored for non-technical users. Enforce Digital Accessibility: Ensure all generated data visualizations and interface layouts meet inclusive, accessible design guidelines. Job Requirements: Experience: 7+ years of dedicated professional experience in UX research, interface design, or digital analytics architectures. Preferred Degrees: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Interaction Design, Human Factors, Cognitive Psychology, Computer Science, or a related behavioral/technology-focused discipline. Design Stack Literacy: Mastery of contemporary UI wireframing and prototyping ecosystems (e.g., Figma). Cross-Functional Communication: Proven ability to present research artifacts (personas, journey maps, insight decks) to technical development squads and leadership. Preferred & Technical Qualifications: Classroom & Instructional Experience: Prior experience as a K-12 classroom teacher, instructional coach, or school-level educator, providing firsthand empathy for school schedules, administrative burdens, and classroom data usage. Front-End Development Frameworks: Functional technical understanding of front-end development, specifically the ability to read, interpret, and write HTML5 and CSS3 code to facilitate seamless developer handoffs. AI Tooling Efficiency: Demonstrated proficiency leveraging AI productivity systems and predictive tools to generate user scripts, synthesize large datasets, and build rapid UI prototypes. EdTech Domain Experience: Direct familiarity with standards-based grading metrics, formative assessment patterns, and large-scale district or state educational technology rollouts. Compliance Standards: Working familiarity with compliance rules governing K-12 web ecosystems, including WCAG accessibility benchmarks and FERPA privacy guardrails.
