items.description: Software Engineering Job Requisition ID # 25WD93193 English posting follows 25WD93193 Architecte logiciel, Plateforme de données AEC Aperçu du poste Chez Autodesk, nous sommes des pionniers dans le domaine des logiciels de conception 3D, d'ingénierie et de divertissement. Nous développons des outils qui permettent à certains des esprits les plus créatifs de la planète de résoudre des problèmes concrets. Reconnus par Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor et d'autres comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs, nous nous engageons à créer un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif où l'innovation et la créativité s'épanouissent. L'organisation Autodesk chargée des données en architecture, ingénierie et construction (AEC) est à la recherche d'un architecte logiciel expérimenté pour se joindre à l'équipe AEC Data et définir les services natifs du nuage ainsi que l'architecture des systèmes distribués qui sous-tendent le modèle de données AEC (AECDM) et les nombreux services qui l'entourent. Bien que le domaine soit celui des données, ce poste relève fondamentalement de l'architecture du nuage et des services - API, contrats de service, intégrations, conception de systèmes distribués et modèle de données connecté qui les relie entre eux - et s'étend à plusieurs équipes. Il ne s'agit pas d'un poste de spécialiste en entrepôt de données ou en analyse de données. L'organisation AEC Data met en place l'infrastructure de données fondamentale qui sous-tend la vision d'Autodesk en matière de construction connectée : les plateformes, les services et les modèles de données unifiés qui couvrent l'ensemble du cycle de vie des actifs bâtis, de la conception et de la construction jusqu'à l'exploitation et à l'entretien. Ce travail permet la circulation continue des données AEC (modèles 3D, dessins 2D, suivi des problèmes, coûts, flux de capteurs, etc.) entre les produits Autodesk et les intégrations tierces. L'architecte contribuera à façonner la prochaine génération de fonctionnalités pour le nuage industriel Autodesk Forma, en collaborant avec des architectes logiciels, des experts du domaine et les équipes de produit de Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud et Autodesk Forma. Il s'agit d'un poste de contributeur senior dans un parcours d'architecture bien établi, relevant de l'architecte émérite de l'équipe AEC Data, qui occupe également le poste d'architecte logiciel principal. La responsabilité principale consiste à définir la manière dont plusieurs équipes conçoivent et développent - par le biais de normes, d'architectures de référence, d'ADR et de la gouvernance de la révision de conception - plutôt que de gérer un service unique. L'orientation précise du poste s'adapte aux points forts du candidat et aux besoins de l'organisation. Responsabilités Conception et évolution des API : Concevoir et faire évoluer les interfaces API des services AEC Data - modélisation des ressources, adressage, gestion des versions et évolution rétrocompatible, API de requête, et unification des interfaces qui se chevauchent en un seul contrat cohérent Architecture système : Définir et faire évoluer une architecture inter-équipes et native du nuage pour l'ensemble des services AEC Data; concevoir des systèmes distribués, y compris les contrats de service et les flux pilotés par les événements Conception et évolution des schémas : Concevoir, documenter et faire évoluer les schémas de données pour les entités du domaine AEC (bâtiments, infrastructures, espaces, systèmes, composantes, relations) - y compris les modèles sémantiques, les ensembles de propriétés, les systèmes de classification et les hiérarchies de relations. Assurer la gestion des versions, de la compatibilité ascendante et descendante, de la dépréciation et de la migration; maintenir le registre des schémas, les règles de validation et les contrôles de qualité Normes et gouvernance : Établir des normes, des architectures de référence et des composantes réutilisables; rédiger des propositions d'architecture et des comptes rendus de décision (ADR) pour examen par un conseil d'architecture interorganisationnel, et mener des revues de conception interéquipes Prototypage et faisabilité : Évaluer différentes orientations architecturales par la modélisation et le prototypage, afin de réduire les risques liés aux décisions clés avant leur adoption à grande échelle Mentorat et leadership technique : Encadrer les développeurs et les autres architectes sur les technologies émergentes et établies ainsi que sur les pratiques architecturales; approfondir les compétences techniques au sein des équipes Fiabilité et performance : Assurer la fiabilité, la sécurité et la performance des systèmes; définir les SLO et favoriser l'observabilité (métriques, traçage, journalisation) Communication : Communiquer sur l'architecture à l'aide de vues et de diagrammes clairs (p. ex., C4) ainsi que de présentations adaptées à la haute direction; produire une documentation exhaustive et du matériel d'intégration Qualifications Minimales Baccalauréat en informatique, ou expérience équivalente Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans la conception de systèmes distribués natifs du nuage, dont au moins 5 ans à un niveau d'architecte inter-équipes (architecte logiciel, développeur principal, Staff+ ou équivalent). Le titre est flexible; l'étendue de l'impact est le critère principal Expertise approfondie des services en nuage (de préférence AWS), de la conception d'API et de services, ainsi que des modèles de systèmes distribués (microservices, architecture orientée événements, résilience) Solides bases en modélisation de données et en conception de schémas - y compris les langages de définition de schémas (p. ex., JSON Schema), la gestion des versions, ainsi que la compatibilité ascendante et descendante et les stratégies d'évolution - telles qu'appliquées tant aux schémas de données autonomes qu'aux contrats d'API. Une spécialisation en architecture d'entrepôt de données ou d'analyse n'est pas requise Excellente connaissance de la conception logicielle et des modèles d'architecture Capacité démontrée à exercer une influence sans autorité hiérarchique et à favoriser la coordination entre les équipes ne relevant pas de la gestion directe du candidat Solides compétences en leadership et en mentorat, avec une expérience avérée dans l'encadrement et le développement d'équipes diversifiées et interfonctionnelles Maîtrise de la communication d'idées complexes de manière concise et convaincante, avec d'excellentes compétences verbales, écrites et de présentation auprès d'un large éventail de parties prenantes Capacité à collaborer avec une équipe internationale Qualifications Souhaitées Les qualifications souhaitées constituent un éventail de compétences plutôt qu'une liste de critères à cocher : une expertise approfondie dans quelques domaines clés importe davantage qu'une connaissance superficielle de l'ensemble d'entre eux. Les compétences émergentes en IA/apprentissage automatique (IA/ML) énumérées ci-dessous constituent un atout et peuvent être développées en cours d'emploi; elles ne sont pas des conditions préalables. Domaines clés Services en nuage : AWS et ses services clés (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS) Systèmes distribués : décomposition des services orientée domaine, modèles de cohérence des données (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas) et conception multi-locataires/multi-régions Conception d'API et de services : conception et évolution des API REST; GraphQL (y compris la fédération) Architecture de bases de données : relationnelles et NoSQL (p. ex., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL) Observabilité/SRE : OpenTelemetry, traçage distribué, métriques/SLO pour les services de données Bonus Technologies sémantiques : graphes de connaissances, RDF/OWL ou graphes de propriétés - particulièrement pertinents pour l'AECDM connecté/sémantique Expertise BIM : concepts de modélisation de l'information du bâtiment (BIM), familles Revit ou systèmes de modélisation paramétrique similaires Systèmes d'IA : RAG, agents/MCP, orchestration agentique (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), observabilité des grands modèles de langage (LLM), et gouvernance des données / sécurité de l'IA (renseignements personnels identifiables [PII], injection de prompts, filtrage de contenu) IA spécifique au domaine de l'AEC : extraction BIM/IFC, traitement CAO ou de nuages de points B Architectures orientées événements B : Kafka ou Kinesis; registres de schémas (Confluent, AWS Glue); traitement exactly-once Connaissance du secteur de l'AEC : Expérience dans le secteur de l'architecture, de l'ingénierie et de la construction; connaissance des normes de l'industrie (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Une formation d'intégration au secteur est offerte ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 25WD93193 Software Architect, AEC Platform Data Position Overview At Autodesk, we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor, and others as a top place to work, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where innovation and creativity thrive. Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experienced Software Architect to join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it. Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture - APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together - spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role. The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma. This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build - through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance - rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to the candidate's strengths and organizational need. Responsibilities API Design & Evolution : Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services - resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract System Architecture : Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows Schema Design & Evolution : Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) - including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks Standards & Governance : Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews Prototyping & Feasibility : Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption Mentorship & Technical Leadership : Mentor developers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams Reliability & Performance : Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging) Communication : Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Developer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience) Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design - including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies - as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders Ability to collaborate with a global team Preferred Qualifications Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites. Core Cloud Services : AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS) Distributed Systems : Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design API & Service Design : REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation) Database Architecture : Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL) Observability/SRE : OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services Bonus Semantic Technologies : Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs - particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM BIM Expertise : Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems AI Systems : RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering) Domain-Specific AI for AEC : BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing Event-Driven Architectures : Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing AEC Domain Knowledge : Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Domain onboarding is provided Plus d'information/ Learn More À propos d'Autodesk/ About Autodesk Bienvenue chez Autodesk ! Nos logiciels créent chaque jour des choses extraordinaires : des bâtiments les plus écologiques aux voitures les plus propres, en passant par les usines les plus intelligentes et les films à succès. Nous aidons les innovateurs à concrétiser leurs idées, transformant non seulement la façon dont les choses sont fabriquées, mais aussi ce qui peut l'être. Nous sommes très fiers de notre culture chez Autodesk ; elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Notre culture guide notre façon de travailler et de nous comporter les uns envers les autres, influence nos interactions avec nos clients et nos partenaires, et définit notre image au monde. En tant qu'Autodeskien, vous pouvez accomplir un travail significatif qui contribue à bâtir un monde meilleur, conçu et réalisé pour tous. Prêt à façonner le monde et votre avenir ? Rejoignez-nous ! Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software - from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made. We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk - it's at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world. When you're an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us! items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: San Francisco Bay Area or New York (Remote) Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games. Ad Operations and Sales Analytics support Discord's ads business, partnering with Sales, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality campaign executions, impactful data insights, and go-to-market strategy across our advertising products. As an Ad Operations Manager, you will play a crucial part in scaling our Ads business. You'll improve the efficiency and scale of campaign execution while contributing to deep-dive analyses that drive business growth and inform go-to-market strategy. You'll provide valuable feedback to Product and Engineering teams, directly impacting Discord's advertising capabilities while removing friction from customers' experience with our platform. What You'll Be Doing Ensuring ad campaigns are implemented and launched on time and to specification — including campaign parameters such as dates, targeting, tracking, impression/reach goals, geographies, and budget — working closely with Account Executives and Account Managers to align setups with client objectives Providing hands-on technical support to key customers and Ad Sales partners, and owning the processes and escalation path (in partnership with Engineering) for issues related to platform integration and use Partnering with Account Managers and technical teams to optimize campaign outcomes and maximize client ROI, including troubleshooting and A/B testing of messaging, creative, and targeting Synthesizing campaign performance insights for internal stakeholders and clients — performance, trends, ROI, and actionable recommendations Building and scaling automations and tooling (including AI/LLM-based workflows) that reduce manual effort and increase leverage across the team Serving as the operational engine for multiple revenue-driving functions across the Discord Business Organization What you should have 3–5+ years of experience in digital advertising, ad operations, or related roles Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., LLM-based workflows, scripting/automation) to drive measurable efficiency gains in a professional environment Comfort working with data and light scripting — SQL required; Python or similar strongly preferred — to build or maintain internal tooling and reporting pipelines Demonstrated knowledge of a broad variety of ad technologies, campaign operation methodologies, and ad tracking/measurement solutions Experience partnering with Engineering and/or Product on technical escalations, platform integrations, or API-level troubleshooting Successful track record working directly with clients — understanding needs and delivering value Strong analytical proficiency: ability to query and interpret data, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions Familiarity with market trends and KPIs such as viewability, brand safety, yield analysis, and audience extension Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a fast-changing, cross-functional environment Bonus Points Experience designing or building internal automation/tooling (bots, pipelines, dashboards) that scaled a team's operations Team player with a sense of humor, humility, curiosity, and empathy This position is US-based and can be based in New York (remote) or San Francisco but if you live in the Bay Area, you’re welcome to work from our beautiful SF office. The US base salary range for this full-time position is $192,000.00 to $216,000.00 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. Why Discord? Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away! Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know. Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord’s collection and usage of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking HERE. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/discord-advertising-operations-manager

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote but only within Poland Who are we? We're Bee Talents, an IT recruitment agency that has been helping clients from all around the world in building their technical teams since 2015. Currently we have a great pleasure of working as an exclusive RPO provider for Gcore and we would like to invite you to participate in the recruitment process for Platform Product Analyst (PLG & Mixpanel Expert). Company Description This position is available only under an employment (labor) agreement. The world’s digital experiences run on something invisible: the infrastructure and software that keep them fast, reliable, and secure. At Gcore, you’ll help design and deliver that foundation for an AI-driven world. We’re a global provider of infrastructure and software solutions for AI, cloud, network, and security, powering everything from real-time communication and streaming to enterprise AI and secure web applications. With 210+ edge locations, 50+ cloud regions, and thousands of GPUs, your work here can reach users and businesses across the globe. You’ll collaborate with leading technology partners such as Intel, NVIDIA, Dell, and Equinix, and work on platforms that power digital products used around the world. Our vision is simple: to connect the world to AI, anywhere, anytime. Want to work on technology that goes beyond a single product or industry? Join a global team of 550+ professionals building infrastructure and software that supports the entire digital ecosystem. We are currently looking for a Platform Product Analyst (PLG & Mixpanel Expert) , a Data-Driven Growth Partner for our Platform team. Your focus is our Self-Service funnel. We have a powerful cloud platform where users can register, pay, and launch infrastructure on their own. Your job is to analyze their journey in Mixpanel, find friction points, and help us increase Activation and Revenue. Job description You will work in a cross-functional setup: Daily collaboration: You will work side-by-side with our Digital Director, as well as Backend and Frontend Developers, Product Managers and the UX/Design team, helping them prioritize features based on data. Reporting: You will be structurally part of our BI (Business Intelligence) team, ensuring you have professional support and access to our data infrastructure. However, you will be embedded in the Platform team, working directly with the Digital Director on a daily basis. What You'll Do: Self-Service Optimization: Deep dive into the registration → activation → payment flow. Identify where users drop off and propose A/B tests to fix it. Product Qualified Leads (PQL): Analyze usage patterns to identify high-potential customers (e.g., "This startup just spun up 50 GPUs") and signal our Sales team to engage them. Event Tracking Design: You are the owner of our tracking plan. You tell developers exactly which events and properties to track. "If we don't track the 'Error 500' on the billing page, we are flying blind." Dashboarding: Create clear, actionable dashboards in Mixpanel for Product Managers and Execs. Hypothesis Testing: Help PMs formulate and measure experiments. Did the new onboarding flow increase activation? You give the final verdict. Who You Are: You are a Mixpanel Ninja. You don't just look at standard dashboards. You build complex cohorts, retention curves, and funnel steps to understand exactly what users are doing. You are AI-Native. You use AI tools (Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude) to accelerate your analysis. Need a complex JQL query for Mixpanel? You prompt it. Need to summarize user feedback? You use an LLM. You have a Growth Mindset. You care about business metrics (Revenue, Conversion, Retention), not just vanity metrics (Pageviews). You are constantly looking for "Aha! moments" that turn visitors into paying customers. What We Are Looking For: Experience: 3+ years in Product Analytics, preferably in a SaaS / PLG (Product-Led Growth) company. Tooling: Mastery of Mixpanel (or Amplitude/Heap). Implementation from the ground up. You know how to clean data and debug events. AI Workflow: Active user of AI tools for data analysis and automation. Basic Technical Literacy: You can read a JSON event payload and understand SQL logic (even if you don't write complex ETLs). English: Professional proficiency (C1/C2). Nice to Have: Experience with B2B Cloud/Infrastructure products. Understanding of Product-Led Sales (PLS) mechanics. Experience with A/B testing tools. Why Gcore? You will have a direct impact on our Self-Service revenue. You will work with a modern stack (Mixpanel + AI tools) without legacy baggage. We value data over opinion. If your analysis shows we are wrong, we change course. Equal Opportunity Employer We provide equal opportunity to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics. Additional Information Benefits At Gcore, we want you to do your best work and enjoy the journey. Our benefits are designed to support your growth, well-being, and life beyond work: - Competitive compensation - Flexible working hours and hybrid or remote options, depending on your role - Work from anywhere in the world for up to 45 days per year - Private medical insurance for you and your family* - Extra paid vacation and sick leave days* - Support for life’s important moments and celebrations - Language courses to help you connect and grow - Modern, welcoming offices with snacks, drinks, and entertainment* - Team sports and social activities* *Benefits may vary depending on your location. Equal Opportunity Employer We provide equal opportunity to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics. BEE TALENTS INFORMATION CLAUSE ⬇️ The Administrator of your personal data is Bee Talents PSA, ul. Garbary 35/12, 61-868 Poznan, NIP: 7792463296. The purposes of processing your personal data are: conducting the initial stage of recruitment, based on your consents, participation in future recruitment processes conducted for our clients, based on the consent, defense against potential claims of our Clients for whom we conduct recruitment, in particular regarding the non-compliance of the Candidate’s profile with the requirements specified by the Client – which is a legitimate interest of the Data Administrator pursuant to art. 6 section 1 pt. f) GDPR. Due to data processing you have the right to access your personal data, request a copy of it, retrificate it, delete or limit it and withdraw of consents at any time, make an objection to the processing of personal data and lodge a complaint to the President of the Personal Data Protection Office if it violate the GDPR rights. MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Costpoint Cognos Report Writer and General Ledger Business Analyst to join our team. The Costpoint Cognos Report Writer / GL Business Analyst will leverage their strong technical background and knowledge to support the company's financial transformation and Costpoint migration efforts, to include designing custom reporting solutions, translating complex business requirements, and optimizing our Costpoint Cloud environment. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: Designing, developing, testing, and deploying custom reports, dashboards, and queries using IBM Cognos Analytics against the Deltek Costpoint database Collaborating with finance, accounting, and leadership teams to capture, analyze, and document complex business reporting requirements Ensuring data integrity and accuracy by thoroughly testing and reconciling report outputs against Costpoint GL balances Applying a strong understanding of Costpoint 8.2 General Ledger functions to provide day-to-day production support and optimize GL processes end-users and junior analysts on how to navigate Cognos and build basic ad-hoc reports Creating and maintaining comprehensive documentation, including data dictionaries, report specifications, user reports in IBM Cognos Analytics Strong functional knowledge of Deltek Costpoint 8.2, with specific expertise in the General Ledger module and financial reporting Strong proficiency in writing SQL queries to navigate backend database tables and validate data Experience working across teams to manage multiple priorities and report development projects simultaneously Experience creating, maintaining, and communicating complex technical and financial documentation Preferred Qualifications: Experience working specifically within the Deltek Costpoint Cloud environment Prior experience working within government contracting (GovCon) compliance environments (DCAA, FAR, etc.) Demonstrated experience in training, mentoring, or team-enablement capacity Clearance Requirements: Must be a U.S. Citizen Physical Requirements: Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50%. About the Risk & Analytics Team The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering,…
items.description: Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest. About the Risk & Analytics Team The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability. Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks. We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently. One Role, Multiple Teams We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A. If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process. Potential team placements include: Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel. Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences. Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience. Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions. Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency. International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets. About the Role As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions. You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights. You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently. What You Will Do Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies. Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members. Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies. Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite. AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs. What We Look For 1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued. Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages. Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling. Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems. Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers. Pay Grade - I Equity Grade - 5 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range . Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company). USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $115,000 - $165,000 USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $101,000 - $151,000 #LI-Remote Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities. We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include: Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process. [For U.S. positions that could be performed in Los Angeles or San Francisco] Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Affirm will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as described therein.

items.description: Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co . We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions About the role This role maintains and executes the systems infrastructure, and process support for our ATS, Ashby and understands how critical it is to power a world-class recruiting function. The team's mission is to ensure every recruiter, hiring manager, and candidate experiences a seamless, data-informed hiring process from requisition open through Day 1. This role keeps Applied Intuition's recruiting technology stack—Ashby, its integrations, and emerging AI tooling—running cleanly day to day, and turns recurring friction into documented, scalable process improvements. Working alongside Recruiting Operations and the People Analytics team, they are a key steward of the data hygiene that feeds reporting. It is a high-impact opportunity to build depth in recruiting infrastructure at one of the fastest-growing physical AI companies. At Applied Intuition, you will: Administer and maintain the recruiting tech stack (Ashby, integrations, downstream systems)—configuring workflows, interview plans, permissions, and templates, and monitoring data integrity across global teams. Serve as first-line support for recruiters and hiring managers: triage and resolve tickets, troubleshoot issues with offers, approvals, scheduling, and candidate communications, and escalate systemic problems with clear documentation. Manage core recruiting operations workflows, including PID and requisition management, approval routing, and offer process execution. Identify recurring points of recruiter friction and implement process improvements that speed up hiring and hold up as the organization grows. Support the Analytics team on reporting: build and maintain Ashby reports and dashboards, audit data quality, and help interpret pipeline health, funnel conversion, and capacity metrics. Deploy AI-powered solutions across recruiting workflows—automating repetitive tasks, improving candidate experience, and reducing manual data entry. Partner with People Operations on onboarding handoffs and IT on system integrations and access management to keep cross-functional processes aligned. Write and maintain documentation, SOPs, and enablement materials so process changes actually stick. We're looking for someone who has: Minimum 2 years of experience in recruiting operations, recruiting coordination, HR technology, or systems administration. Hands-on Ashby experience is required—including workflow and interview plan configuration, permissions, and building/maintaining reports. Experience implementing process improvements or automation—including AI/ML tooling—with clear before-and-after operational results. Strong analytical skills: comfortable working in spreadsheets and ATS reporting, spotting data quality issues, and translating findings into practical recommendations. Systems thinking orientation—able to map dependencies across tools, teams, and processes, and anticipate the downstream effects of a change before making it. High attention to detail and strong follow-through in a high-volume, fast-changing environment, with the judgment to know when to escalate. Clear written communication and a service mindset toward recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates. Nice to have: Experience supporting a rapidly scaling or global recruiting team. Familiarity with HRIS platforms (Workday preferred) scheduling tools like ModernLoop, sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter and Juicebox), or assessment platforms and how they integrate with an ATS. Light scripting, API, or no-code automation experience (e.g., Zapier, Workato, Python). Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Applied Intuition is an equal opportunity employer and federal contractor or subcontractor. Consequently, the parties agree that, as applicable, they will abide by the requirements of 41 CFR 60-1.4(a), 41 CFR 60-300.5(a) and 41 CFR 60-741.5(a) and that these laws are incorporated herein by reference. These regulations prohibit discrimination against qualified individuals based on their status as protected veterans or individuals with disabilities, and prohibit discrimination against all individuals based on their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin. These regulations require that covered prime contractors and subcontractors take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status or disability. The parties also agree that, as applicable, they will abide by the requirements of Executive Order 13496 (29 CFR Part 471, Appendix A to Subpart A), relating to the notice of employee rights under federal labor laws. FOR US-BASED ROLES: Applied Intuition is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive application and interview experience to applicants who are disabled veterans and other applicants with disabilities or medical conditions. Reasonable accommodations are available, requesting an accommodation will not affect your candidacy in any way, and you are not required to disclose the nature of your disability or medical condition in order to make a request. If you require an accommodation please contact careers@applied.co . We will work with you!

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving…
items.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. Backend Engineer - Platform - Stacks This role is available for candidates located in the UK, Germany, Spain, Ireland and Sweden. The Opportunity: Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. Foundations produces the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP) and partners closely with our Cloud, Enterprise, and Grafana teams. Our team develops the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations. We utilize the grafana.com platform to engineer bespoke integrations and solutions that unify the diverse technical ecosystem of a modern software enterprise. The team owns important domain areas that help keep both our customer workflows and internal business processes running smoothly. AppCore is made up of multiple squads, each focused on one or more of these domains. Our work includes maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculation, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the user portal our customers rely on to manage their accounts. This is a team working at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations. The systems we build are critical to how Grafana scales. We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex workflow and systems problems, improving reliability and developer experience, and building software that directly supports both customers and internal stakeholders. As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. Engineers at Grafana also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities and collaborate across teams beyond their immediate scope. What You’ll Be Doing: The AppCore Stacks squad owns the systems that create, configure, reconcile, migrate, and operate Grafana Cloud stacks at scale. A stack is the customer-facing Grafana Cloud environment that connects an organization to Grafana and the backend services it uses, including Mimir, Loki, Tempo, plugins, dashboards, data sources, and stack-level configuration. Our work sits at the intersection of product, platform, and operations. We build the control-plane services and workflows that keep stack state aligned across grafana.com, Stack State Service (SSS), Hosted Grafana, cloud regions, and the underlying Grafana Cloud infrastructure. When this domain works well, customers get reliable stack creation, safe configuration rollout, predictable migrations, and fewer manual operational interventions. Design, build, and operate reconciliation systems, including the SSS backend, to track desired stack state, detect and repair drift across stack templates, grafana.com state, Hosted Grafana, and actual customer stack configuration Collaborate across SSS, grafana.com, and deployment configurations to ensure stack lifecycle workflows remain reliable, observable, and resilient Improve operational efficiency by reducing deployment complexity (e.g., aiming for single PR regional SSS deployment) and contributing to the Stack Config Reconciliation project Manage rollout mechanisms for provisioned plugins, dashboards, data sources, Grafana versions, release channels, and stack-level configuration Support new region and cluster rollouts, including the operational paths required to bring stacks online safely in new Grafana Cloud regions Improve incident response and recovery paths for stack misalignment, reconciliation failures, plugin rollout issues, and Hosted Grafana integration failures Partner with Product, Hosted Grafana, Infrastructure, Support, and adjacent AppCore squads on customer-impacting stack lifecycle work Contribute to roadmap planning, technical design, OnCall improvements, and long-term simplification of stack operations You will help own the production behavior of the systems you build. That includes improving runbooks, dashboards, alerts, reconciliation safety, rollout controls, and recovery procedures. You should be comfortable debugging across service boundaries and making careful changes in systems that affect customer stacks What Makes You a Great Fit: At Grafana, we actively embrace AI-assisted and agentic development practices, integrating these technologies into both our engineering workflows and the systems we deliver. We encourage our engineers to thoughtfully leverage AI tools to enhance every stage of the lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing, documentation, and operations. We also look for strategic opportunities to embed agentic capabilities within our services to eliminate toil, bolster reliability, and ensure that complex customer workflows remain resilient and safe. We are seeking a Backend Engineer who thrives on building production systems where correctness, scalability, and operational clarity are paramount. As a remote-first organization, you should be comfortable collaborating asynchronously across time zones and taking full ownership of the critical systems powering Grafana Cloud. Our team is small and operates with a high degree of independence; you will be expected to lead major projects, coordinate across service boundaries, and help define the technical direction for our domain. You will be particularly successful in this role if you enjoy solving challenges related to stateful systems, eventual consistency, and reconciliation loops. We value engineers who can take ambiguous lifecycle requirements and transform them into explicit, modular solutions. You should be adept at breaking down complex systems work into safe, iterative increments while clearly communicating technical tradeoffs to both internal stakeholders and adjacent product teams. Some things you might be expected to do could include: Writing efficient, readable, and easy to maintain code Implementing new microservices or systems Collaborating with teammates and other departments to reach consensus on proposed solutions Coordinating with product and UX when needed Responding to customer requests and feedback When ready, participating in our follow-the-sun OnCall rotation Participating in team decisions, such as roadmap planning and prioritization Requirements: You have at least 1 year of fully remote work experience You have some experience working on a SaaS platform and are familiar with common distributed systems concepts (e.g., scalability, multi-tenancy, HA). Have professional experience with Golang and be willing to work across both backend service and application code Care deeply about developer and user experience and the quality of the products that you work on Have some experience contributing to the delivery of projects, from initial brainstorming to shipping a product to the customer. You write clean, well-tested software that other engineers can understand, operate, and maintain Can take on well-defined tasks, break them down, and execute iteratively to deliver working solutions and gather feedback. You are willing to collaborate across teams and ensure your work is aligned with the needs of other squads and external stakeholders. Familiarity with Kubernetes in AWS, GCP, or Azure, and exposure to infrastructure-as-code tooling (Helm, Terraform, Jsonnet, etc.). Experience participating in blameless incident response and contributing to post-incident reviews. Bonus Points For: Experience with TypeScript/Node.js Experience with Kubernetes control-plane patterns, operators, reconcilers, or desired-state systems Experience with Jsonnet/Tanka, Terraform, Flux, Argo, or similar deployment/configuration tooling Experience working on SaaS provisioning, tenancy, regional expansion, plugin rollout, or customer lifecycle systems Experience with incident response involving configuration drift, partial failure, or cross-service state mismatch Compensation & Rewards: In Sweden, the compensation range for this role is SEK 609,985 - SEK 762,481. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy .

You should be adept at breaking down complex systems work into safe, iterative increments while clearly communicating technical tradeoffs to both internal stakeholders and adjacent product teams. Some things you might be expected to do could include: Writing efficient, readable, and easy to maintain code Implementing new microservices or systems Collaborating with teammates and other departments to reach consensus on proposed solutions Coordinating with product and UX when needed Responding to customer requests and feedback When ready, participating in our follow-the-sun OnCall rotation Participating in team decisions, such as roadmap planning and prioritization Requirements: You have at least 1 year of fully remote work experience You have some experience working on a SaaS platform and are familiar with common distributed systems concepts (e.g., scalability, multi-tenancy, HA). Have professional experience with Golang and be willing to work across both backend service and application code Care deeply about developer and user experience and the quality of the products that you work on Have some experience contributing to the delivery of projects, from initial brainstorming to shipping a product to the customer. You write clean, well-tested software that other engineers can understand, operate, and maintain Can take on well-defined tasks, break them down, and execute iteratively to deliver working solutions and gather feedback. You are willing to collaborate across teams and ensure your work is aligned with the needs of other squads and external stakeholders. Familiarity with Kubernetes in AWS, GCP, or Azure, and exposure to infrastructure-as-code tooling (Helm, Terraform, Jsonnet, etc.). Experience participating in blameless incident response and contributing to post-incident reviews. Bonus Points For: Experience with TypeScript/Node.js Experience with Kubernetes control-plane patterns, operators, reconcilers, or desired-state systems Experience with Jsonnet/Tanka, Terraform, Flux, Argo, or similar deployment/configuration tooling Experience working on SaaS provisioning, tenancy, regional expansion, plugin rollout, or customer lifecycle systems Experience with incident response involving configuration drift, partial failure, or cross-service state mismatch Compensation & Rewards: In Spain the Base compensation range for this role is EU 65K - EU 81K. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy .

items.title: [Contract] Accreditation Solutions Consultant, Clinical Strategy
items.summary: About Lyra Health Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies,…
items.description: About Lyra Health Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. About The Role Lyra Health’s Clinical Strategy team is seeking a seasoned Senior Operations Lead for a high-impact, 6-month contract engagement focused on driving our Joint Commission (TJC) Behavioral Health Care and Human Services (BHC) accreditation readiness. This role sits at the intersection of clinical strategy, regulatory execution, and cross-functional project management. Acting as the primary project lead, you will bridge the gap between Clinical Strategy, Clinical Operations, and key cross-functional teams to drive our accreditation roadmap. This role is ideal for a senior healthcare project manager who excels at translating complex regulatory mandates or compliance standards into actionable project plans. While familiarity with Joint Commission standards is preferred, we are primarily seeking an exceptional operational lead who can quickly get up to speed on TJC requirements, partner with clinical domain experts, and drive execution. You are a self-directed player-coach who is comfortable getting "in the weeds" with workstream leads to build compliance documentation while also zooming out to present a 30,000-foot risk assessment to leadership. What You’ll Do (6-Month Scope) As a senior contractor, you will hit the ground running and lead the execution of our TJC survey readiness roadmap: Roadmap & Work Plan Ownership: Refine, maintain, and drive the master Project Work Plan for TJC Behavioral Health and Telehealth accreditation readiness, establishing clear workstream milestones across clinical and operational teams. Gap Analysis & Risk Mitigation: Continuously identify gaps, compliance risks, and cross-functional dependencies; proactively update the roadmap and implement risk mitigation strategies. Workstream Facilitation: Partner directly with workstream leads to deep-dive into specific TJC standards. Develop supporting materials and process documentation as needed. Mock Survey & Readiness Execution: Organize and project manage internal mock audits, tracer activities, and readiness drills to ensure operational teams are fully prepared for survey execution. Governance & Cross-Functional Alignment: Establish clear communication cadences across stakeholders (live working groups, asynchronous updates, and project dashboards) to drive cross-functional accountability. Executive Visibility: Develop concise, data-driven written updates for senior leadership to highlight progress, key milestones, and critical risks. Requirements: 10+ years of healthcare project management, healthcare operations, or management consulting experience, preferably within high-growth health tech or clinical environments Demonstrated track record of leading complex, cross-functional regulatory, compliance, or accreditation readiness initiatives from gap analysis through execution Exceptional strategic and project management skills with the ability to influence cross-functional peers and senior leadership without direct authority Strong written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to distill complex clinical insights and regulatory requirements into actionable executive summaries A highly organized self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments and can create structure out of ambiguity Deep passion for expanding access to high-quality, evidence-based mental health care Preferred Qualifications: Direct experience or familiarity with the accreditation process (e.g., The Joint Commission, CARF, NCQA, or other), specifically within Behavioral Health Care and Human Services (BHC) or virtual/telehealth models Compensation Additional Information "We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information or any other category protected by law. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that your personal information will be processed as per the Lyra Health Workforce Privacy Notice . Through this application, to the extent permitted by law, we will collect personal information from you including, but not limited to, your name, email address, gender identity, employment information, and phone number for the purposes of recruiting and assessing suitability, aptitude, skills, qualifications, and interests for employment with Lyra. We may also collect information about your race, ethnicity, and sexual orientation, which is considered sensitive personal information under the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA) and special category data under the UK and EU GDPR. Providing this information is optional and completely voluntary, and if you provide it you consent to Lyra processing it for the purposes as described at the point of collection, for example for diversity and inclusion initiatives. If you are a California resident and would like to limit how we use this information, please use the Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information form . This information will only be retained for as long as needed to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, as described above. Please note that Lyra does not “sell” or “share” personal information as defined by the CPRA. Outside of the United States, for example in the EU, Switzerland and the UK, you may have the right to request access to, or a copy of, your personal information, including in a portable format; request that we delete your information from our systems; object to or restrict processing of your information; or correct inaccurate or outdated personal information in our systems. These rights may be subject to legal limitations. To exercise your data privacy rights outside of the United States, please contact globaldpo@lyrahealth.com . For more information about how we use and retain your information, please see our Workforce Privacy Notice ."

items.title: Senior Data Analyst
items.summary: OneMagnify is an AI native, platform-enabled B2B digital agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity.
items.description: OneMagnify is an AI native, platform-enabled B2B digital agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity. We help complex organizations drive measurable business outcomes by building smarter customer experiences and delivering highly integrated solutions across digital, media, and technology. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced analytics and artificial intelligence, we enable our clients to make better decisions, move faster, and compete more effectively in dynamic markets. We are looking for Data Analysts with deep experience translating business requirements into technical data specifications, manipulating large datasets, and supporting various data initiatives for our client. Our Data Analysts will help design and support a set of data services and capabilities for our client's customers. They will work directly with the client's business partners and their Data Engineering and Analytics team to understand the business meaning of data and provide analysis and requirements so that data design is fully understood and the data service initiatives are in line with intended design and standards. The impact you’ll have: You are a data person with solid hands-on technical skills and great attention to detail. You enjoy taking data and turning it into a solution. You are a troubleshooter and passionate about what you do. Resourceful and relentless: independently capable of seeking information, corralling resources, and delivering results in challenging situations Collaboration and Teamwork: works with others to deliver results, contributing to the team and prioritizing group needs over individual needs Problem Solving: uses an organized and logical approach to find solutions to complex problems. Looks beyond the obvious to uncover the root cause of problems Open Communication: clearly conveys thoughts, both written and verbally, listening attentively and asking questions for clarification and understanding What you’ll do: Leverage data tools and capabilities to deliver superior service to client's customers and to advance the Data & Analytics Road Map. Conduct discovery and end-to-end data analysis to understand customer needs and to help develop plans and activities to improve data quality. Elicit, analyze, interpret business and data requirements to develop complete data product solutions, includes review data models (entity relationship diagrams, dimensional data models), ETL and business rules, data management, governance, lineage, metadata and reporting elements. Manipulate large data sets using SQL to understand patterns in the data. Perform data profiling using various tools to learn the shape of the data to help inform data quality checks and/or curation rules that need to be developed. Partner with customers in interpreting data and remediating issues when required. Collaborate with data owners, stewards to implement, maintain, enhance data governance, quality, security and privacy requirements, and related policies and standards. Prepare technical specifications for data ingestion and transformation rules. Partner with data architects to build data models for efficient consumption of data. Support the development of standards and best practices within the Data Analysis team, this includes documentation templates and agile development methodologies. What you’ll need: University or college degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, or related field of study. 5+ years of relevant experience gathering and documenting requirements as well as technical specifications for data solutions. Advanced SQL scripting skills. Python knowledge is plus. Experience with AWS platform and tools associated with analytics and data (S3, Redshift, Glue). Understanding of Snowflake platform a plus. Data governance and metadata management experience (standards, format, definition, structure, tagging, transmission, manipulation, use and management of data). Understanding of Monte Carlo and Atlan. Experience in integrated marketing, digital agency, marketing services, or consulting environments preferred. Benefits We believe great work happens when people have the support and flexibility they need to thrive. Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) retirement plan, paid holidays, and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can take time away to recharge when you need it. We also offer additional programs focused on wellness, financial security, and professional growth. We are an equal opportunity employer We believe that Innovative ideas and solutions start with unique perspectives. That’s why we’re committed to providing every employee a workplace that’s free of discrimination and intolerance. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and actively search for like-minded people to join our team. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform job functions, and to receive benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. Originally posted on Himalayas
