items.description: Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate. Our team is made up of 400+ energetic and passionate Unifones who are dedicated to delivering the best possible experience to 5000+ customer-centric companies. We pride ourselves on our fun and collaborative work environment, where creativity and new ideas are constantly encouraged. As shareholders in the business, we’re so much more than a group of passionate communicators. We are Unifones. Join our team and be a part of something big! Meet the team! Our Engineering team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic ’s solutions. We work closely with other departments to ensure our products and services meet the needs of our customers. If you are passionate about technology and are excited about working on cutting-edge communication and engagement solutions, we want you on our team. As a Product Operations Lead, you will partner closely with Product Leadership to translate product strategy into scalable operational practices that drive alignment, efficiency, and measurable business outcomes. You will establish and continuously improve product operating models, governance frameworks, and cross-functional processes that enable Product, Engineering, Commercial, Marketing, and Customer-facing teams to work effectively toward shared goals. Acting as a trusted partner to stakeholders across the organization, you will drive collaboration, facilitate informed decision-making through data and insights, and ensure clear communication of product priorities, roadmaps, and outcomes. You will lead product enablement initiatives, support successful product launches and adoption, develop performance metrics and reporting frameworks, and identify opportunities to streamline workflows through process optimization and automation. By championing operational excellence, customer-centricity, and continuous improvement, you will help create an environment where product teams can scale efficiently, deliver value consistently, and maximize the impact of the product portfolio. Help us shape the future of communication by: Leading and continuously improving product operations frameworks, governance, and ways of working across Product teams. Owning and optimizing product planning processes, roadmap reviews, prioritization workflows, and operational cadences. Establishing scalable operational practices that improve alignment, transparency, delivery predictability, and execution quality. Driving standardization of product reporting, KPIs, operational dashboards, and decision-support insights. Identifying operational inefficiencies and implementing process improvements to increase team effectiveness and focus. Promoting adoption of AI tools, automation, and operational best practices to improve workflows, reporting, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Customer Success, Support, Presales, and Marketing teams to ensure strong operational alignment. Acting as a central point of coordination between business and product organizations. Facilitating communication of product priorities, roadmap updates, launches, and operational initiatives across stakeholders. Supporting leadership teams with operational insights, strategic reporting, and executive-ready communications. Leading Product Enablement initiatives that help internal teams effectively position, support, and adopt product capabilities. Supporting product launches, feature rollouts, demos, and internal readiness activities. Translating complex product functionality into clear messaging, use cases, enablement materials, and customer value narratives. Partnering with Commercial and Marketing teams to improve product awareness, adoption, and customer engagement. Helping identify and remove adoption barriers impacting internal teams or customers. Synthesizing customer feedback, product analytics, sales insights, and market trends into actionable recommendations. Identifying product usage patterns, operational gaps, and growth opportunities that can influence product strategy and commercial outcomes. Supporting Product leadership in defining and tracking success metrics tied to product and operational performance. Contributing to strategic initiatives focused on scaling Product Operations maturity and organizational effectiveness. Requirements What you’ll bring: 5+ years of experience in Product Operations, Product Management, Product Enablement, Product Marketing, Presales, Solution Consulting, or related roles. Proven experience leading or scaling operational processes within Product or SaaS organizations. Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, product delivery processes, and cross-functional collaboration. Experience working closely with Product, Engineering, and Commercial teams in fast-paced environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate insights into actionable outcomes. Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. items.description: Data and Analytics About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. The Opportunity The 3PL Operations Customer Success Manager acts as the crucial operational bridge between Flexport's e-commerce and retail clients and our warehouse fulfillment teams. You ensure SLA compliance, manage onboarding, and drive client retention by translating complex supply chain metrics into actionable business value. It's a client-facing, cross-functional role, and you'll be a key voice in how Flexport delivers on its commitments to fulfillment clients. You will: Client Success & Operational Liaison: Be the client's day-to-day point of contact, connecting them with warehouse, inventory, and tech teams to resolve fulfillment issues. Partner Oversight & SLA Accountability: Serve as Flexport's primary POC for assigned 3PL/4PL partners, inspecting sites and holding them accountable for SLAs on receiving, shipping, inventory accuracy, and packing quality. Coach teams of 30 to 100 at partner facilities and drive corrective action when needed. Forecasting & Capacity Planning: Share SNOP forecasts with partners and confirm labor and capacity plans align to demand. Billing & Invoice Management: Review and approve 3PL/4PL invoices and resolve discrepancies with partner teams. Process & Systems Compliance: Ensure partners follow Flexport SOPs and use our WMS correctly; troubleshoot system issues on the ground and reinforce best practices through hands-on support and training. Client Onboarding: Guide new merchants through WMS and OMS integration for a smooth transition into Flexport's fulfillment network. Performance Reporting: Deliver client-facing reports on inventory turns, shipping volume, and logistics efficiency to guide business reviews. Escalation Management: Own high-pressure escalations involving inventory loss, delayed shipments, or compliance fines, resolving quickly and communicating transparently with clients. Retention & Growth: Build long-term client trust through consistent operational reliability. Build the Function: Document how Flexport works with 4PL partners, including processes, escalation paths, and performance standards. You Should Have: 3+ years of hands-on experience in a warehouse, fulfillment, or 3PL/4PL operations environment, with working knowledge of floor-level workflows. 2+ years managing or coaching a team in a fulfillment, warehouse, or 3PL setting. Experience in account management or client-facing operations, translating operational performance into business outcomes. Proven ability to hold external partners accountable to SLAs without direct authority over their staff. Comprehensive, practical knowledge of WMS operations: capable of identifying root causes, training staff, and resolving system complications rather than merely managing daily operations. Strong reporting and data analysis skills: experience building and interpreting KPI dashboards (Excel or BI tools) and turning data into clear recommendations. Polished client-facing communication skills: experience leading business reviews and presenting performance data to external stakeholders, including navigating difficult conversations. Experience building structure and process in fast-paced, evolving environments. Nice-to-Haves: Experience managing merchant onboarding or system integrations Familiarity with client business reviews (QBRs) or account growth conversations International logistics or supply chain experience Before You Apply: Availability: Client fulfillment issues can arise outside standard business hours; you'll need to be reachable and able to manage your own time to match. Travel: You will visit partner and client sites regularly, including some travel outside your home region. A valid passport is required. Strong understanding of AI-powered tools and how they can be leveraged to drive efficiency and insight. Proven history of achieving revenue and retention goals through consultative account management. Self-starter with strong collaboration, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. items.description: Vice President, Invoice to Cash The Vice President, Invoice to Cash (I2C) is a senior operating executive responsible for leading both the Accounts Receivable, Cash Applications, and Requestor Management teams. This combined department of ~50 staff are responsible for working with a wide range of medical record requestors (insurance companies, attorneys, and their retrieval agents) with a mix of high touch account management for the high-volume requestors and a long tail mass touch approach for long tail of low volume requestors. Key metrics and activities that this role will be responsible for include: measuring and tracking Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) by cohort, percent of request volume actively managed, enhancing the monthly billing and statement process, maintaining unapplied cash at a 3-day level, and bringing more automation/technology to this function. This role is intentionally hands-on and detail-oriented, requiring deep engagement in daily collections activity, aging trends, customer disputes, and cash forecasting. In a private-equity-backed environment, this leader is expected to operate as a player-coach who can personally diagnose issues, drive execution, and hold teams accountable for results. Duties & Responsibilities: Hands-On Accounts Receivable Leadership & DSO Ownership (Primary Mandate), with Cash Applications and Requestor Management as secondary mandates Own enterprise-wide accounts receivable (AR) performance with direct, personal accountability for DSO reduction, and past-due aging Engage directly in weekly aging reviews, top delinquent account analysis, and high-risk customer situations Design and enforce disciplined collections operating rhythms, including daily, weekly, and monthly execution cadences Define, track, and actively manage KPIs including DSO, aging mix, Collection Effectiveness Index (CEI), dispute cycle time, and billing accuracy Lead hands-on improvements across collections, billing accuracy, cash application, and dispute workflows. Ensure improvements are embedded into daily execution, not just documented in policy Expand and mature the requestor management/data integrity process and team including management of sales tax-exempt requestors Partner with R&D team to design AR/collections modules within our platform Oversee daily cash application activities for all payment channels, including ACH, wire transfers, lockbox, credit cards, checks, and electronic payment platforms Ensure timely and accurate posting of customer and requestor payments to accounts receivable. Establish and maintain strong internal controls for cash receipt processing Lead implementation and optimization of cash application technologies, including AI-driven cash application tools and/or robotic process automation (RPA) Collaborate as a peer to the Controller, SVP of Finance, and VP of FP&A as a leader in the finance organization Perform other duties, as assigned, to ensure effective operation of the department and the Company Live by and promote Verisma Core Values Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business, required 12-15+ years of progressive experience in Management of Order/Invoice to Cash, Accounts Receivable, Collections, or Finance CPA strongly preferred Proven ability to lead and develop large, multi-functional teams with a data driven mindset Experience in Release of Information, Revenue Cycle, Record Retrieval, or Healthcare, preferred Technically proficient with data analysis tools such as Advance Excel, Power BI, SQL, etc. Travel 5 to 10% of the time Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Product Headquarters: Ireland (Remote); Netherlands (Remote) ; Portugal (Remote) ; Spain (Remote) ; United Kingdom (Remote) Who we are Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot. About the Team You'll join a small but high-impact Accounting & Controlling team at a pivotal moment in Typeform's journey. As we've grown into a global SaaS business, our finance function is evolving to support greater scale, complexity, and ambition. We're investing in stronger financial controls, more sophisticated accounting operations, and systems that will enable our next stage of growth. You'll partner closely with the VP of Accounting & Controlling, serving as their strategic deputy and helping lead both the day-to-day function and the longer-term evolution of our accounting organization. Together, you'll build a world-class finance operation that is scalable, resilient, and ready for what's next. About the Role As Director of Accounting & Controlling, you'll lead the operational accounting function while helping shape the future of finance at Typeform. Reporting to the VP of Accounting & Controlling, you'll own the integrity of our global accounting operations, oversee a growing team, and drive initiatives that strengthen financial controls, improve efficiency, and support international growth. You'll combine technical accounting expertise with strong leadership and operational excellence, ensuring the business continues to scale on solid financial foundations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You'll be a trusted partner to senior leadership, mentor and develop the accounting team, and play a key role in transforming how finance operates across the company. Things you will do: Lead the Accounting & Controlling function, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant financial operations across multiple entities and jurisdictions Partner closely with the VP of Accounting & Controlling as a strategic deputy, helping define priorities, lead the team, and drive the finance roadmap Manage, coach, and develop a high-performing accounting team, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, ensuring high-quality financial reporting and strong balance sheet integrity Strengthen our internal control environment and ensure compliance with IFRS and regulatory requirements across all operating jurisdictions Oversee revenue recognition policies and processes across our subscription and usage-based business models Lead our indirect tax strategy and compliance (VAT/GST, digital services taxes, and related obligations), partnering with external advisors where appropriate Oversee transfer pricing frameworks, intercompany accounting, and cross-border financial operations Partner with Legal, FP&A, People, and external advisors to support international expansion, entity creation, and regulatory compliance Lead external audits and statutory reporting processes, ensuring smooth execution and strong stakeholder relationships Drive finance transformation initiatives, including process redesign, automation, ERP optimization, and scalability improvements Build internal accounting capabilities while reducing dependency on external advisors where appropriate Provide leadership and continuity for the function, acting on behalf of the VP of Accounting & Controlling when required What you already bring to the table: Significant experience leading accounting and controlling functions within a high-growth technology or SaaS environment Experience managing and developing accounting teams in a fast-paced, international business Strong technical accounting expertise with deep knowledge of IFRS Proven experience managing multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction accounting environments Strong understanding of revenue recognition, particularly for subscription and usage-based business models Experience overseeing indirect tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions Strong understanding of financial controls, risk management, and audit processes Experience partnering with executive stakeholders and influencing cross-functional decisions A pragmatic, hands-on leadership style with a willingness to dive into the details when needed Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trusted relationships across the business A continuous improvement mindset with experience driving operational excellence and finance transformation Extra awesome: Experience leading accounting in a global B2B SaaS company Experience with international expansion, entity setup, and cross-border compliance Strong knowledge of transfer pricing and international tax structures Big 4 background or equivalent public accounting experience Experience implementing or optimizing ERP systems (NetSuite preferred) Track record of leading finance transformation, automation, or systems implementation projects Experience preparing an organization for rapid international growth, acquisitions, or IPO readiness *Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team , empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/typeform-director-of-accounting-controlling

items.description: Company Overview LevelUp is a specialist agency providing outsourcing solutions to agencies, software vendors, and website owners. For over seven years, we have successfully collaborated with various companies, delivering valuable technical, operational, and back-office support. We boast a large team of skilled and passionate professionals committed to producing high-quality work for our clients. Position Overview We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented L1 Hosting Tech Support Agent to join our team. In this critical, frontline, customer-facing role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for clients seeking technical assistance with their hosting environments and WordPress websites. Leveraging your passion for customer service and solid foundational knowledge of web hosting, you will troubleshoot and resolve a broad spectrum of technical issues via live chat and ticket-based support. Since stellar client experiences are highly valued, you will be expected to multitask efficiently by managing two to three concurrent live chat channels during busy periods while maintaining excellent response times, a high-quality assurance (QA) score, and top-tier Customer Satisfaction (CSAT). This is a full-time, long-term opportunity embedded in an active, supportive team. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love solving technical puzzles, and enjoy delivering empathetic, world-class customer service, we would love to have you on board! This fully remote position requires working a fixed mid-shift or night-shift Monday through Friday with no schedule flexibility, observing standard Philippine holidays. Reference: 2634-323775 Responsibilities Provide world-class technical support to hosting customers via live chat (managing 2 concurrent chats, scaling up to 3 during high-volume periods) and ticket-based support via Zendesk. Diagnose and resolve common web hosting and WordPress issues, identifying root causes to solve customer inquiries on the first contact whenever possible. Assist customers with general WordPress tasks, including troubleshooting issues related to core files, plugins, themes, and configuration errors. Answer server-side queries, inspect DNS records, check and update SSL certificates, and troubleshoot website accessibility issues. Handle basic database queries and migrations (MySQL) to resolve backend errors and facilitate site movement. Utilize basic Linux command-line tools to diagnose, navigate, and troubleshoot server-side issues. Meticulously document issues and escalate complex, tier-2 technical problems to senior teams to ensure service continuity. Actively meet and exceed key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), Average Handling Time (AHT), QA scores, Acceptance Rate, and Average Customer Wait Time. Maintain an active, highly responsive online presence via Slack and Zendesk during your entire shift. Requirements 1 to 2 years of solid technical support experience specifically working in a web hosting environment. Basic to intermediate knowledge of WordPress, with a demonstrated ability to identify and troubleshoot plugin, theme, and configuration conflicts. Proven experience with FTP/SFTP, cPanel, or custom web hosting dashboards. Strong understanding of DNS zone files (A records, CNAME, TXT) and SSL setup. Basic knowledge of HTTP response status codes (e.g., 500, 404, 403, 502, 504). Experience with MySQL databases, including running simple queries or basic site migrations. Excellent multitasking capabilities, specifically the capacity to handle 2 to 3 concurrent live chat windows smoothly and accurately. Outstanding written and verbal English communication skills, with a conversational, natural flow and minimal grammatical errors. A warm, empathetic customer support style that prioritizes active listening, rapport-building, and customer advocacy. Practical experience navigating files and running basic diagnostic commands via Linux CLI. A bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred (nice-to-have), but equivalent hands-on experience will be highly considered. More Information This is a fully remote position with a standard 40-hour fixed-schedule work week. The exact work schedule depends on the client that you are assigned to but is often an afternoon or night schedule and so having flexibility when it comes to schedule is important. We have a company culture that focuses on the well-being of its team members, with a good work life balance and respectful work environment. Equipment provided HMO + 13th month pay and other government-mandated benefits Compensation Additional Information

Liaising with key stakeholders, such as admissions, quality assurance and student support. Regular communication with the Business Development Team, providing feedback on Agent documents that are being submitted. 6. Continuous Improvement Advise on and propose changes in procedures, planning and systems to improve operational efficiency to improve quality of service in student recruitment. Keep skills up to date and develop depth or breadth of knowledge in student recruitment practice by learning from colleagues and exposure to a range of activities, training and networking opportunities. Continuing to improve conversion rate and enrolled numbers coming from each partner. Make recommendations on how to improve the University’s brand and make it more commercially attractive. Look at ways of improving current processes, especially when looking at growth within the team and recruitment numbers. 7. People Management Co-operate with other colleagues (either individually or in a team setting) to contribute to the achievement of departmental objectives. Train and develop junior staff members, and ensure direct reports are performing their duties and meeting their KPI’s. Managing the agent/partnership relationships, ensuring they are clear on all admissions procedures and are meeting their quality requirements. Show sensitivity and consideration and emotional support to other people’s/student’s needs and feelings, which often include dealing with signs of obvious distress. Dealing with culture differences, for example when dealing with overseas staff remember they may be used to a different working environment than we are in the UK or other global countries Deliver guidance and support in a calm, discreet, diplomatic and professional manner. Support agents/partners and provide referral and signposting pathways for students in crisis to internal and external support function and organisations. 8. Personal and Professional Development and Training Identify and address development needs to ensure continuing professional development. Communicate and share best practice. Proactively identify new opportunities and work with management to develop solutions. Work in accordance with the University’s Values Framework. Maintain strong empathy for the university's commitment to equality of opportunity and equality of treatment for colleagues and students. 9. Other Responsibilities Any other duties as appropriate to seniority and role. The post-holder will be required occasionally to travel to other locations for meetings or training. Attendance at appropriate internal working parties as required. To always ensure the University’s name and brand is never brought into doubt and that externally we are seen as professional and a pleasure to work with. Essential: Analyse market data and trends, to assist and advise faculties, departments and senior management within the University on the development of UK and global recruitment strategies, new programmes, or policies on UK activities where appropriate. Liaise and engage with key stakeholders and internal and external contractors to influence opinion, delivery and reputation of services. Influence and contribute to the scoping and resource planning across a range of activities at operational level to meet organisational objectives, including contributing to business plans and strategy documents where required. Implement processes to manage the integrity and security of all commercially and professionally sensitive and personal data. Analysis & problem-solving capability Well-developed written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal skills Ability to manage partners expectations and provide training sessions to ensure quality Ability to prioritise tasks and delegate tasks to direct reports. Represent the University at education expositions, Universities, schools, and colleges, as a University Influencing Senior Colleagues/external partners. Develop external relations, identify and develop opportunities for communities of practice, employers, alumni and donors via extra-curricular activities and increased levels of participation with a view to positively impact student recruitment. Build and sustain an influential network of contacts both internally and externally to influence and promote reputation, including relevant education institutions, Embassies, Consulates and sponsorship bodies. Keep well informed about the University in all relevant aspects of its work through engagement with relevant committees, attendance at workshops and events, and networking with University colleagues. In collaboration with finance business partners create business cases to validate commercial opportunities for the university Contribute to operational leadership teams and decision making to shape the nature and level of support services. Experience of working with complex sales processes and CRM software Experience of working/responding independently and dealing with unforeseen problems and circumstances Comprehensive knowledge of the work practices, processes, and procedures relevant to the role. items.title: Clinician (Oncology / Hematology)

items.description: Role Title: Clinician (Oncology / Hematology) Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Clinician (Oncology / Hematology)s to contribute to a customer’s project at the forefront of AI in healthcare. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Author and review evaluation tasks that require nuanced clinical judgment, leveraging Clinical Study Reports, periodic safety reports, and regulatory correspondence in oncology and haematology. Assess the clinical defensibility of efficacy and safety conclusions, ensuring endpoints and effect sizes reflect true clinical significance. Apply advanced judgment to dose escalation, dose-limiting toxicity, modifications, adverse event grading and attribution, and the coherence of patient narratives. Evaluate benefit-risk reasoning, scrutinizing the durability of conclusions in light of new events, and the realism of described management strategies. Identify and flag content that is clinically implausible or internally inconsistent, distinguishing these from legitimate clinical variation. Provide structured, guideline-based written rationales that clearly explain the validity or limitations of clinical interpretations for a non-clinical audience. Preferred Qualifications Specialist registration or board certification in medical oncology and/or haematology, with 5+ years of post-training clinical experience. Direct involvement in clinical trials as investigator, sub-investigator, or sponsor-side medical monitor, safety physician, or clinical development physician. Proficiency with CTCAE grading, relevant response criteria (RECIST, Lugano, IMWG, IWCLL, ELN), and outcome endpoints (ORR, DoR, PFS, OS, MRD). Hands-on experience with trial documents such as protocols, investigator brochures, CSRs, safety narratives, or DSMB/IDMC materials. Demonstrated excellence in written communication, with clear, structured explanations of clinical reasoning tailored for non-clinical readers. Previous roles in medical monitoring or as medical director on oncology or haematology programmes, and committee participation (IDMC, DSMB, adjudication, or independent review committees). Peer-reviewed publication record or authorship on clinical trial manuscripts, with any exposure to AI-assisted clinical review tools seen as a plus. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Role Title: Adolescent/Child Safeguarding & Exploitation Specialist Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Adolescent/Child Safeguarding & Exploitation Specialists to contribute to a customer's project focused on assessing sexual safety and exploitation risk in adolescent scenarios. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Review complex adolescent cases to assess sexual safety and exploitation (CSE/CSA) risks. Produce clear, defensible written safeguarding guidance suitable for non-specialists. Apply recognised risk-assessment and safeguarding frameworks to evaluate urgency and appropriate interventions. Identify indicators of grooming, coercion, and exploitation within nuanced case details. Recommend protective actions and escalation pathways, including when mandatory reporting is warranted. Utilise a trauma-informed lens, weighing developmental, capacity, and consent factors in each assessment. Benchmark your clinical judgments against peer standards and established protocols to ensure guidance accuracy and reliability. Preferred Qualifications 3–5+ years post-qualification experience in child safeguarding, adolescent-protection, or relevant clinical roles. Specialty background in child protection, forensic child/adolescent psychiatry or psychology, or paediatric medicine with a safeguarding remit. Active clinical license or registration in good standing. Current or recent (within the last two years) adolescent caseload or safeguarding practice. Demonstrated expertise in CSE/CSA risk assessment and mandatory-reporting requirements. Strong skills in trauma-informed practice and documentation. Exceptional written communication in research-grade English (native, or IELTS 7.5+/writing 7.0+, TOEFL 100+, Cambridge C1–C2, or equivalent). Experience in a designated safeguarding or expert-witness capacity, and familiarity with ACEs and trauma frameworks, is a plus. Start Timeline & Availability We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24 – 48 hours of completing onboarding. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: External Communications Strategist
items.summary: Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference?
items.description: Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference? Make an impact. Join PMI. How will you make a difference to PMI? The External Communications Strategist III is an execution-first, senior individual contributor responsible for driving earned media opportunities and narrative enablement in support of PMI’s corporate reputation, thought leadership, and strategic priorities. This role sits within the PR + Communications team and operates with a high degree of autonomy, judgment, and ownership. As a Level III individual contributor, this role is expected to operate as a trusted advisor within Communications—anticipating opportunities, identifying risks, and independently driving work forward while ensuring alignment to broader narrative and reputational priorities. You will provide strategic counsel to senior stakeholders on external narrative direction, message discipline, and reputational considerations, and recommend narrative adjustments based on trends, current events, and performance insights. What you’ll bring to the role: Earned Media Strategy & Agency Partnership Collaborate with PR agency to identify story opportunities and develop timely, compelling pitch angles aligned to priority narrative beats for both B2B and consumer audiences. Maximize PR agency performance helping to sharpen briefs, challenge thinking, and ensure proactive, high-quality execution against PMI’s strategic communications goals. Partner with PR agency (and consult with internal stakeholders, including regional and functional leads) on developing strategy and positioning for global media house moments. Partner with the broader Marketing organization to source appropriate community or executive spokespeople; vet, prepare, and align them for earned media pitching and engagements. Use media intelligence and performance insights (e.g., message pull-through, tier-1 quality, topic traction) to identify narrative opportunities and gaps, and to refine story angles and pitching strategy. Shape earned media strategies that strengthen PMI’s discoverability and influence in search and AI-driven answer environments, ensuring coverage reinforces desired brand perception, priority narratives, and authoritative topic associations. Earned & Sponsored External Opportunities Independently or collaboratively identify and execute strategic earned opportunities for PMI executives or community spokespeople to reach unaware or new audiences (e.g., third-party events, podcasts, partner activations, key account–adjacent moments). Partner with PR agency and relevant internal teams to evaluate, secure, and execute selective sponsored opportunities (e.g., panels, conferences, tentpole events) that advance PMI’s narratives and reputational goals. Assess external opportunities for narrative fit, audience value, and reputational considerations; recommend go/no-go decisions and execute approved engagements end-to-end. Identify and shape thought leadership platforms (e.g., executive bylines, strategic reports, high-impact forums, and selective partnerships) that reinforce priority narratives and differentiate PMI’s point of view. Narrative Ownership & Enablement Lead efforts for defined corporate message houses, including maintenance of current proof points, examples, and data, ensuring they reflect evolving business priorities and external context. Own external narrative governance for assigned topics (message architecture, claims/proof points, and executive-ready guidance), ensuring consistency across earned media, executive platforms, and thought leadership moments. Define what is included in narrative-specific enablement kits (e.g., message houses, executive-ready slides, talk tracks, FAQs, supporting materials) and proactively distribute to internal stakeholders and executives ahead of external opportunities. Maintain and refresh enablement kits on a regular cadence; communicate updates clearly and ensure adoption across PR, Marketing, and regional teams. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Judgment Work closely with Director of PR & Communications, Marketing, regional teams, and agency partners to ensure narrative consistency and executional excellence across external touchpoints. Influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners to align on narrative, timing, and external positioning—often without direct authority—and deliver clear recommendations (including go/no-go) in ambiguous, high-visibility situations. Maintain issues readiness for assigned narratives, including rapid response positioning, Q&A, and escalation recommendations in reputationally sensitive moments. Navigate nuanced, high-visibility topics with maturity and discretion; identify risks early (misalignment, gaps, timing, tone) and recommend solutions. Independently manage multiple workstreams and deadlines; maintain clear tracking of opportunities, deliverables, approvals, and outcomes. Role Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Public Relations, or related field (or equivalent experience). 8-10+ years of experience in corporate communications, PR, or earned media–focused roles. Demonstrated experience partnering with and managing PR agencies to drive earned media outcomes. Proven track record of developing and executing proactive earned media or external engagement strategies tied to corporate narratives. Experience operating with senior-level autonomy and judgment in complex, matrixed organizations. Strong earned media instincts with the ability to translate narrative strategy into executable story angles. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to distill complex topics into clear, compelling messages. High judgment and discretion; comfortable operating in reputationally sensitive areas. Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Highly organized, self-directed operator with strong prioritization and follow-through. Ability to anticipate needs, proactively identify opportunities, and execute with minimal oversight. Stakeholder management is paramount; ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment on narrative direction and recommendations. Strategic, analytical mindset with the ability to use insights and reporting to optimize external communications strategy and outcomes. Proficiency in the business language for PMI (English). Possible travel up to 5% What you can expect from us We value and nurture an environment of inclusivity and diversity, and a culture of communication and collaboration. Your health, safety and well-being come first, and we believe that you should have time for your work, but you should also have time for you.. Join us and you’ll get: an excellent total package, with compensation and benefits based upon your geographic location. skill development opportunities, to help you grow now and into the future. access to a global network, to enrich your professional experience. flexible options to help balance work time and your time award and bonus opportunities. The salary offer will be based on several factors, including the candidate’s demonstrated skills, qualifications and relevant experience. Let’s help make the world work better for everyone. Apply today! Project Management Institute, Inc. is committed to providing equal employment opportunities without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. items.description: About Us Mighty Networks helps people and brands build communities, online courses, memberships, challenges, and events. Because of this novel approach and member-centered experience, Mighty has produced the most $1M communities and helped its Hosts earn over $500M. The Role As a Community Strategist, you’ll work with our premium Mighty Pro customers to help them create deeply engaging community experiences that lead to powerful outcomes. You will lead workshops, co-create launch strategies, and shape the early member experience for some of the world’s boldest and most influential Hosts. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in both structured systems and creative problem-solving, and is excited to model excellence, mentor peers, and scale success through repeatable frameworks. What You'll Do Serve as a strategic partner to new Mighty Pro Hosts during their onboarding phase as they set up their Network in the way that leads to maximum member adoption, engagement, and retention. Facilitate impactful workshops with Hosts and their teams that establish strong foundations in community design, content cadence, and engagement strategy. Deliver targeted training on feature utilization, member onboarding flows, and tactical programming to drive adoption, activation, and retention. Provide creative input and feedback on brand elements like landing pages, welcome experiences, email sequences, and network messaging to ensure a cohesive and compelling member journey. Own the development and delivery of strategic Community Design Plans—including network architecture, monthly themes, onboarding flows, and launch programming calendars. Collaborate closely with Launch Specialists and Implementation teams, providing timely information and handling lightweight setup tasks directly where appropriate. Ensure clarity, consistency, and excellence in the execution of space configuration, access structure, and end-to-end member experience. Maintain regular updates to internal stakeholders on Host performance, needs, risks, and outcomes—contributing to visibility and cross-functional alignment. Contribute to shared knowledge across the Customer Success team by capturing and scaling best practices, identifying emerging trends, and improving playbooks. What We're Looking For 6+ years of client-facing experience, ideally working with strategic accounts or supporting 5–6 figure engagements in a SaaS, media, or creator-focused business. 2+ years experience in a consulting, business coaching, or agency role. Strategic thinker and tactical executor—you can map out long-term plans, define metrics for success, and follow through on details to deliver. Deep understanding of community-building and digital member experiences; you’re passionate about helping others create belonging at scale. Excellent communicator and facilitator, with confidence in guiding executive teams through planning, decision-making, and feedback cycles. Master of meetings—you show up with a plan, gather input with nuance, read the room, and close with clear decisions and next steps. Adaptable and proactive, energized by growth and ambiguity, and always seeking ways to streamline and improve. Highly collaborative and cross-functional, thriving when working across CS, Implementation, Product, and Strategy to elevate outcomes. Radically curious, with a growth mindset and drive to keep learning about Hosts, their businesses, and how digital communities are evolving. What We Offer A dynamic, remote-first work culture that values creativity, autonomy, and bold thinking. Comprehensive benefits, including health, vision, dental, and generous paid time off. Clear opportunities for professional growth, including leadership pathways and skill development support. The chance to shape the future of how communities, creators, and brands thrive online—with the team that’s building what’s next. Join us in shaping the future of community-driven digital businesses with Mighty Pro! Compensation: The base salary for this role ranges from $80,000–$145,000, with exact compensation based on location, experience, and cost of living. Originally posted on Himalayas

We’re building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we’re just getting started. Join us to put AI to work for people. Job Description Role and team: We are looking for an experienced Senior Auditor to support planning and lead execution of global and/or regional operational and integrated audits spanning business operational controls, IT general controls and application controls. This remote position will be reporting to Director, Internal Audit Management. We have a tight team environment where support, loyalty, and honest feedback are the currency. ServiceNow employees are expected to be self-starting, proactive, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. Conduct walkthroughs, evaluate process design, and perform controls testing across both business processes and IT systems, consistently delivering quality audit work papers that support and substantiate audit observations. Continuously explore and adopt AI tools creatively and responsibly through the audit lifecycle to accelerate fieldwork and elevate analytical depth. We expect our auditors to experiment, share what works, and help evolve how Internal Audit delivers value. Utilize data analytics and AI to identify control gaps, quantify risk exposure, and deliver data-driven insights to management. Assist in producing high-quality Internal Audit reports by clearly drafting audit issues and developing valid conclusions resulting in process and internal control improvements, while considering implementation requirements, cost, and stakeholder feedback. Timely and effective communication with audit leads on audit status, escalations, issues, and reporting. Perform action tracking follow-up with management for Audit Committee reporting purposes. Participate in major business initiatives and proactively advise and assist the business on key risks, control environment, and change initiatives. Contribute to the evolution of Internal Audit methodology, automation, and reporting, including ServiceNow IRM to scale audit coverage and quality. Responsible for internal stakeholder engagement, including the development of working relationships with key stakeholders and proudly representing the Internal Audit function. Qualifications To be successful in this role, you have: A passion for Internal Audit and strong desire to be part of a stellar IA team! Minimum 4-year degree (or US equivalent) from an accredited university; degree in Management Information Systems, Finance and Accounting strongly preferred. Minimum of 5 years’ work experience, with 3 years at a public accounting firm (Big 4 or national consulting firm preferred), including experience in internal auditing, external auditing, SOX, operations and process improvement. Demonstrated experience auditing both IT general controls and application controls, and business operational processes. Comfort moving fluidly between technology and business-process audits, including within the same integrated engagement. Understanding of data governance and privacy compliance, and the ability to apply system architecture knowledge to the processes being reviewed. Understanding of risks and controls in modern technology environments. Awareness of AI/GenAI governance and model risk considerations. Good understanding of business and operations, strong analytical and project management skills. Proficiency in Excel and process mapping tools. Hands-on experience with data analytics tools such as Power BI. Experience with SAP preferred. Strong critical thinking and analytical skills; ability to identify and conduct root cause analysis. Excellent verbal, written, oral communication, and presentation skills. Ability to work both independently and as a team member. Ability to manage multiple tasks concurrently, efficiently and effectively with minimal oversight. Familiarity with the ServiceNow platform, including IRM modules, a strong plus (Preferred) At least one of the following certifications: CISA, CISM, CIA, CPA Prefer candidates with exposure to a high growth and/or rapidly changing technology enterprise. This is a very collaborative and inclusive work environment where individuals strong in aptitude and attitude will have an opportunity to grow their professional careers through working with some of the most advanced technology and talented developers in the business. items.description: Who is Boulevard? Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most. Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen . We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most . Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too. Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard. We're hiring a Director of Engineering - Cloud & Reliability to lead our infrastructure transformation and establish industry leading reliability practices. This role will be instrumental in evolving Boulevard's infrastructure into a scalable, reliable, secure, and highly available platform that supports our rapid growth and customer needs across a spectrum of market segments (Small Business, Franchises, Enterprises). Reporting to the SVP of Engineering, you'll lead a team of infrastructure and reliability engineers while driving the technical strategy for our cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, and platform capabilities. Your work will directly enable the Engineering & Data teams to deliver APIs, services, customer-facing products and data capabilities at scale by providing robust, self-service infrastructure foundations. You'll architect and implement modern infrastructure practices including containerization, infrastructure-as-code, advanced CI/CD pipelines, and comprehensive observability systems. This role is perfect for a technical leader who wants to build the infrastructure platform that becomes the backbone of Boulevard's next phase of growth. Domains of Ownership Cloud Infrastructure & Platform - Design, implement, and maintain scalable AWS infrastructure including multi-region deployments, and infrastructure-as-code DevOps & CI/CD - Transform deployment pipelines, implement container orchestration, and enable rapid, reliable software delivery Observability & Reliability - Implement comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and incident response using DataDog and related tools Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity - Establish DR infrastructure, failover systems, and business continuity planning across all Boulevard services Infrastructure Automation - Build self-service infrastructure capabilities and advanced automation using Terraform and GitOps practices Security & Compliance - Establish comprehensive security practices, manage compliance frameworks (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2), and implement security-by-design principles Key Projects & Initiatives EKS Migration & Containerization : Lead the migration from current infrastructure to Amazon EKS, implementing container orchestration and services-ready architecture Multi-Region DR Implementation : Design and implement hot-hot disaster recovery with automated failover, load balancing, and regular testing procedures CI/CD Pipeline Transformation : Modernize deployment pipelines to support faster, more reliable deployments Advanced Observability : Enhance comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and incident response using DataDog, enabling proactive issue detection and resolution Security Framework : Establish enterprise-grade security practices, compliance frameworks, and automation to support Data team's governance requirements Infrastructure-as-Code Evolution : Scale Terraform usage, implement GitOps practices, and create self-service infrastructure capabilities Database Scaling : Address current RDS limitations and implement scalable database architecture What you'll do here: Technical Leadership : Define and execute the long-term infrastructure and security strategy, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security as Boulevard grows Team Building : Lead, mentor, and grow a team of infrastructure and reliability engineers, establishing best practices and fostering a culture of operational excellence Cross-functional Collaboration : Partner closely with Product, Services and Data Engineering teams to provide the infrastructure foundation for their initiatives Architecture & Design : Drive architectural decisions for cloud infrastructure, security systems, and operational practices Operational Excellence : Establish monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices that ensure high availability and performance Compliance Management : Ensure compliance with industry standards (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2) and implement security controls What you'll need to thrive: 10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure and platform engineering, with 5+ years leading infrastructure teams of 5-15 engineers Deep experience with AWS services including EKS, RDS, VPC, IAM, and infrastructure automation using Terraform Proven experience migrating applications to Kubernetes/EKS and implementing container-based architectures Strong background in security practices, compliance frameworks (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2), and security automation Experience transforming CI/CD pipelines, implementing GitOps practices, and enabling rapid software delivery Expertise with monitoring and observability tools (DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana) and implementing comprehensive alerting strategies Proven ability to work with Product Engineering, Data Engineering, and Platform Services teams to enable their technical initiatives How we'll take care of you: At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we’re happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated base salary range is $209,500 - $270,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling. In addition to the wonderful people you’ll get to work with and challenging projects that’ll push you - Boulevard is here to make sure you’re always at the top of your game emotionally, mentally, and physically. ✨ We’ve got you covered with a 401(k) match plus dental, medical, vision, and life insurance. Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy. Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You’ll receive a work from home stipend every month. Family planning resources and specialized support programs. Equity: get ahead on the ground floor and grow with Boulevard. Boulevard Bucks Learning and Development program allows employees to explore businesses in the market we serve. We recommend following our official LinkedIn page to stay up to date on all things Boulevard life! Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

items.title: Sales Operations Manager, Foundry
items.summary: At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people…
items.description: At Instructure , we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers. We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in: Foundry is a new division inside Instructure, built to generate new revenue with AI-built products. We operate as a portfolio of small pods, each charged with one product bet, under tight weekly governance. They operate independently, with dedicated resources, separate from the core business on purpose: different pace, different governance, and different rewards. Our goal is to generate meaningful revenue within 12 to 18 months, so this isn’t an innovation lab. We’re building scaled businesses that customers pay for and retain well, and we’re measuring ourselves on revenue, not activity. Instructure reaches roughly half of higher education in the United States, connecting a credential network of more than 13,000 institutions. Pair that distribution and data with a fast-moving team that builds leanly, and you have something no competitor has. That’s the opportunity New Markets exists to take. How we work A pod is two people: a Founder and a Builder, both hands on, close to the customer. The bet is deliberate: we invest in agent-developer tooling and tokens, not in headcount. An operating team of growth marketing, revenue operations, sales overlay, and G&A supports every pod, so founders stay on building products. Every pod inherits an underlying platform with common design, development, and deployment harnesses, so no pod rebuilds the plumbing. Each pod runs through key phases with regular checkpoints where a governing board reviews progress or recommends a pivot or kill. The rhythm is fast and transparent. Investor-style updates go out weekly. Demos and keep-or-kill checkpoints happen twice a month. Transparency is the operating model. What you will do You’re the operational engine behind New Markets’ newest product bets. You’ll own the end-to-end go-to-market lifecycle for pod products, from market sizing and early strategy through launch, performance tracking, and the handoff when a product graduates into the core. When a pod proves customers will pay, you make that motion repeatable and hand it to the full seller base. This is a blank-page job: the playbook doesn’t exist yet, and you’ll write it. The role reports directly to the President, New Markets, with a matrixed dotted line to Instructure’s Go-to-Market Strategy and Operations leadership. What you’ll own You own go-to-market operations across the portfolio, and you’re the voice of the New Markets business in the rooms where commercial decisions get made. In practice, that means you’ll: Own the end-to-end GTM lifecycle for pod products. Carry each product from market sizing and early strategy through launch planning, field execution, and post-launch performance tracking. Shape the go-to-market approach with each pod. Partner with Pod Founders, marketing, and the sales overlay on ideal-customer definition, pricing and packaging input, channel strategy, and competitive positioning. Design the sales motion. Build the coverage models, pipeline processes, forecasting cadences, and rules of engagement for the first seller cohort on each product. Build the reporting backbone. Stand up and maintain the analytics in Salesforce and Excel that track pipeline health, win/loss, attach rates, average contract value, and renewal trends, and turn that data into insight leadership can act on. Run launch readiness. Lead CRM buildout in Salesforce, playbook documentation, tool configuration, and alignment across enablement, marketing, finance, deal desk, and IT. Own the graduation playbook. Define the criteria and the integration motion for products that complete a pod’s journey, so the full seller base can carry and sell the product without a messy handoff. Be the voice of the business. Translate early-stage complexity into clear, data-backed narratives in planning forums, business reviews, and executive sessions, and support annual planning across capacity, quota, incentive design, and growth roadmaps. What we expect Blank page to operating framework. You go from nothing to a working system without a lot of hand-holding, then improve it as results and field feedback come in. Rigor under ambiguity. You structure messy, early-stage go-to-market problems, build the analytical frame, and land a recommendation you can defend. Accuracy you stand behind. The insights and reporting you put in front of leadership are right, and you own them. Influence without authority. You move product, finance, marketing, and sales toward a shared plan without managing any of them. What we’re looking for Five or more years in sales operations, revenue operations, or a related go-to-market function. Real experience supporting new-product launches or emerging-business initiatives, where the playbook didn’t exist yet. Three or more years hands-on in Salesforce, building and maintaining reports, dashboards, and data structures. Advanced Excel, comfortable building models, running variance analysis, and turning raw data into decision-ready output. Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive-level presentations. A bachelor’s degree is preferred. Your first 90 days Month 1. Immerse yourself in the New Markets portfolio, the key stakeholders, and the current go-to-market infrastructure. Understand where each product sits in its lifecycle and find the most pressing operational gaps. Month 3. Establish a clear view of performance across active pods: pipeline health, coverage, and leading indicators. Build or refine the reporting framework in Salesforce and Excel, and set a recurring operating rhythm with product and sales leadership. Month 6. Own and drive the go-to-market motion for at least one pod through a checkpoint. Deliver an integration-readiness recommendation for any product approaching graduation, and present a prioritized roadmap for improving New Markets go-to-market operations to senior leadership. This role isn’t for everyone Anti-patterns. You should probably pass if: You need an established playbook and a stable process to operate inside. Here you build the playbook. You’re uncomfortable being measured on the accuracy of your numbers and the clarity of your recommendations. You’d rather own a single, well-defined process than the whole messy go-to-market surface across a portfolio. A predictable, slow-changing scope is what you want. The portfolio shifts as pods move through their checkpoints. Compensation Base pay is market-competitive. You’ll be paid fairly against the market for the work, so you’re not taking a pay cut to be here. But the base is the floor, not the prize. The real value is the upside you drive. As part of the operating team, you share in a cash bonus pool tied to portfolio milestones across pods. Targets are set as pods launch, so you’ll know what the portfolio is running at. The upside is asymmetric, and it’s earned, not granted. There’s a hard floor: below a threshold level of attainment, milestone payouts don’t trigger at all. Above it, hitting and stretching past your targets pays meaningfully. This is built to be the kind of outcome that changes your trajectory, not a routine bonus. The rewards go to the people who build something customers pay for. They don’t reward effort, tenure, or proximity. What this means in plain terms. Real ownership. Real accountability. Real upside for the people who build a business, and very little for those who don’t. If that trade excites you, you’re the person we’re looking for. If it worries you, trust that instinct. Get in on all the awesome at Instructure! We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect: Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success. Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location. Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs. Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth The technology and tools you need to do your best work Motivosity employee recognition program A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes. Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate. All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws. Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

items.description: At Feedzai, we're building a world of safer money. A world where financial institutions move faster than criminals. Where the payments that fund real lives through salaries, savings, and businesses are protected in real time. We use trusted AI to detect and prevent financial crime, fraud, and money laundering at scale: the world's top banks, payment networks, and acquirers trust our technology to safeguard more than one billion consumers and $9 trillion in payment volume every year. Feedzai is a Series D company and has raised $282M to date. With a valuation of $2 billion, our technology protects 1 billion consumers and 90 billion transactions each year. You: As a Strategic Account Manager at Feedzai, you will manage the end-to-end success for a designated portfolio of accounts while simultaneously providing critical support to Strategic Account Leads and the Head of Strategic Accounts on larger, highly complex enterprise clients. You will ensure that projects and live programs deliver contracted value, run reliably, and meet the expectations of client stakeholders. You will sit within the regional Customer Success / Delivery management structure, partnering closely with Project Managers, Delivery Leads, and internal teams to track account health, drive day-to-day execution, and support overarching account strategies. Your Day To Day Strategic account & stakeholder management Own the strategic relationship for dedicated accounts, serving as the primary point of contact for key client stakeholders; Partner with Strategic Account Leads to align executive stakeholders and resolve complex issues for high-revenue clients; Build and nurture long-lasting relationships with client stakeholders to ensure alignment on roadmap, risk, and value realization; Develop and maintain joint success plans to proactively address evolving client needs; Help monitor stakeholder needs and expectations, ensuring timely communication and information flow; Assist in handling complex situations by coordinating with internal stakeholders and gathering necessary data to unblock issues; Value realization & regional alignment Drive value realization plans for dedicated accounts and support Leads in managing them for enterprise clients; Partner with internal teams (Product, Data Science, Customer Care) to monitor solution performance (KPIs/SLAs) and recommend value-optimizing improvements; Link performance data and roadmap execution to measurable outcomes such as total fraud reduction, operational efficiency, and customer friction reduction; Assist in preparing QBR frameworks and performance dashboards for strategic accounts; Value maximization & adoption Partner with clients to identify opportunities for maximizing product value; Develop and support tailored onboarding and training plans in collaboration with enablement teams; Monitor and analyze user adoption metrics, providing actionable insights and recommendations for improvement to clients and internal leadership; Delivery governance & collaboration Partner with PMs and Delivery Leads to drive governance, prioritization, and roadmap execution; Lead governance forums (SteerCos, incident reviews) for dedicated accounts; assist Leads in preparing materials for enterprise-level engagements; Monitor project and BAU initiatives, tracking success criteria, risks, and timelines to manage scope and ensure transparency; Escalation management & risk mitigation Act as an escalation point for your dedicated accounts to resolve delivery issues, while assisting Leads in coordinating data and responses for major incidents on top-tier accounts; Proactively identify delivery risks across projects and maintain cross-functional mitigation plans, ensuring action items are tracked and owners are aligned; Internal contribution & continuous improvement Document best practices, lessons learned, and governance improvements to drive team excellence; Partner with Marketing and Leads to identify customer advocates and produce success stories; Synthesize customer feedback to influence Product roadmaps and feature enhancements; You Have & You Know-How Bachelor's degree in Technology, Business, or a related field; 5–7 years of experience in customer-facing roles (e.g., consulting, customer success, account management) that include issue resolution, relationship management, and stakeholder management; Strong understanding of the fraud prevention space (preferably for Banks or Acquirers); Experience owning relationships with enterprise accounts, ideally in the financial services sector, with a proven ability to support senior leads on large strategic accounts; Ability to analyze data and provide actionable insights; Results-driven with a focus on customer satisfaction and a customer-centric mindset; Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills; Ability to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences; Strong organizational skills – can prioritize tasks, multi-task, and demonstrate adaptability; Project Management skills, alongside a collaborative mindset to work effectively autonomously and across teams; Verbal and written fluency in English; The Customer Success organization, through its Delivery and Strategic Accounts sub-functions, ensures the successful implementation, sustained value realization, and operational stability of Feedzai solutions for some of the world’s largest and most sophisticated financial institutions. In this fast-paced and open environment, you will collaborate with a globally distributed, high-performing team to deliver predictable, profitable, and scalable outcomes for strategic accounts. As a result, we're empowered to spark change every day, influencing the trajectory of our company and ourselves. Join Us! #LI-Remote #LI-BX1 Your First 30-Days at Feedzai: You will be immersed in our brand with training, connections, and one-on-one time with your manager. You may shadow your colleagues virtually or onsite at an office depending on where you work as you are supported through your Feedzai journey. In addition, you will have access to a ton of information to give you history, context, and all the knowledge you can handle about Feedzai and the team. Finally, you will start working on projects and collaborating on work currently being done. We can't wait to have you join the team! Life at Feedzai Instagram Feedzai Culture Feedzai is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. items.description: Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients. Our sectors of activity include telecommunications, finance, industry, utilities, energy, public administration, and health. Our mission? Offer technological solutions, business, strategy, development, and application maintenance while being a benchmark in consulting. Thanks to the collaboration between teams, the human quality of our people, and the fact that we do not conform to what is established, we always seek innovation that brings us closer to the future. This role combines business analysis, operational support, and incident management responsibilities, serving as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, experience supporting business applications, and the ability to manage incidents and service requests in a fast-paced environment. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to process improvements, application optimization, and operational excellence across multiple business systems. Key Responsibilities Business Analysis Analyze and document business processes, workflows, and operational use cases. Gather, evaluate, and translate business requirements into clear functional recommendations. Identify process improvement opportunities, system enhancements, and integration possibilities across business applications. Develop business analysis artifacts including process maps, gap analyses, requirements documentation, and recommendations. Incident & Operational Support Management Serve as a primary point of contact for incident management and operational support activities. Investigate, triage, and prioritize incidents and service requests based on business impact and urgency. Coordinate resolution efforts with technical teams, business stakeholders, and support partners. Track incidents through resolution and ensure timely communication to stakeholders. Monitor support performance and prepare operational dashboards, reports, and metrics. Contribute to continuous improvement of support processes, documentation, and knowledge management practices. Stakeholder Collaboration Partner with product teams, developers, and business stakeholders to align technology solutions with business needs. Facilitate communication between technical and non-technical audiences. Support cross-functional initiatives focused on operational efficiency and service delivery improvements. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in one of the following areas or a related field: Business Administration Information Systems Engineering Data Science Economics Technology or Operations Management Experience: 3-5 years of experience in business analysis, operations analysis, application support, incident management, or a related role.
