Required Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Experience gathering and documenting business requirements. Ability to translate complex business needs into actionable solutions. Familiarity with ServiceNow or similar service management platforms. Experience supporting enterprise applications, CRM, ERP, or operational systems. Knowledge of incident management, service request processes, and support operations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Customer-focused mindset with an emphasis on operational impact and service quality. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with business process improvement initiatives. Exposure to digital transformation or enterprise technology programs. Additional language proficiency beyond English is a plus, particularly Spanish, Portuguese, or French. Why NTT Data? items.description: To learn the Hiring Ranges for this position, please select your location from the Apply Now dropdown menu. To learn more about our Hiring Range System, please click this link. Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. About this team and role: In the past few years, Marketing has emerged as a key vector and focus of Firefox’s growth, with Data Science playing an essential role in evaluating Marketing’s impact and developing clear strategies to ensure that success. Marketing Data Science supports Firefox through the standard fare of marketing (ongoing measurement, experimentation/lift testing, adhoc analysis, forecasting/budget optimization), and beyond that as thought leaders at Firefox in translating broad goals into clearly defined objectives and identifying the path towards succeeding in them. In this role, you will continue to build on the Marketing team’s recent successes as Firefox’s Marketing program continues to expand its footprint throughout the funnel. You’ll look to support this success in owning global data strategy for Firefox Marketing, developing new data capabilities to unlock future business growth, collaborating with Data Science counterparts in other domains domains, and working closely across marketing and adjacent cross-functional teams to translate your team’s work into practical recommendations and enablement that drive Firefox’s growth. What you’ll do: Set the strategy and roadmap for Marketing Data Science, prioritizing the highest-impact opportunities with key partners. Establish goals and measurement approaches for attribution, ROI, and campaign performance; deliver insights that improve marketing investment and outcomes. Lead and develop the team’s core capabilities across: Performance marketing: budget optimization, causal lift measurement, and conversion-signal testing Brand marketing: measurement planning and assessment of long-term and lower-funnel impact User insights: retention/LTV modeling and audience segmentation Reporting and infrastructure: build self-service dashboards, deliver ad hoc and executive reporting, and develop scalable data models and internal tools that expand our understanding of the acquisition landscape. Bring a forward-looking perspective on advertising, media innovation, and marketing analytics methods. Partner with Data Science leaders to evaluate and responsibly adopt emerging AI tools that improve team workflows and impact. What you’ll bring: 6+ years of marketing data science experience, ideally at a media agency or in-house marketing organization. Proficiency with marketing analytics tools, including Google Analytics and advertising platforms, and familiarity with modeling methods such as MMM, causal lift/synthetic control, saturation modeling, optimization, and Bayesian approaches. Proven experience leading, mentoring, and developing talent, with strong stakeholder management and the ability to prioritize multiple complex workstreams. Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to tailor data-driven insights and recommendations to different audiences. What you’ll get: Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday One-time home office stipend Annual professional development budget Quarterly well-being stipend Considerable paid parental leave Employee referral bonus program Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) About Mozilla Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla , you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online. Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose. items.title: Senior Affiliate Marketing Manager
items.summary: At Bondora, our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone.
items.description: At Bondora , our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone. Founded in 2008, we’ve helped more than 700,000 customers across Europe borrow and invest effortlessly through our trusted digital products. As a rapidly growing financial technology company, we’re reaching new heights with a bold vision. We’re set to acquire a banking license, unlocking a world of possibilities for our customers. This transition will allow us to expand our lending across more EU countries and broaden our product suite to deliver even more value. Join us on this journey and let’s build the future of finance together! What is this role about? 🚀 As a Senior Affiliate Marketing Manager at Bondora , you'll take ownership of the affiliate marketing channel for Go & Grow, managing and growing the partnerships that bring new investors to the platform. You'll work with content creators, publishers, comparison sites, communities, and affiliate networks across Europe, while building a strong pipeline of new partners. This is a highly autonomous, hands-on role where you'll combine partner management with business development — strengthening existing relationships, sourcing and onboarding new affiliates, negotiating commercial agreements, and using data and AI to continuously improve partner performance. You'll work closely with Product, Data, Engineering, Brand, CRM, Legal, and Compliance to optimise the full journey from first click to long-term investor value. You'll have the opportunity to own and shape one of Go & Grow's key growth channels , with direct access to senior leadership and significant freedom to improve how the affiliate programme operates and scales. Your main responsibilities 🎯 Own and Execute the affiliate marketing channel strategy, operating plan, forecast and performance. Source, qualify and close direct partnerships with affiliates (in other words publishers: content creators, comparison sites, communities and relevant affiliate networks). Create clear segmentation, outreach, onboarding and activation routines that move partners from prospect to live Design and negotiate CPA, CPL, fixed-fee and hybrid deals Define and improve the funnel from click and sign-up through funded investor, first 30-day deposits, repeat deposits and 30/60/90-day retained value. Operate and improve Target Circle/Circlewise Build partner- and cohort-level reporting covering acquisition cost, revenue (deposits) value, retention, net revenue (net deposits) Test placements, content, landing pages, incentives, creative and localized messaging with Brand, CRM, Product and Design. Apply country-specific financial-promotion rules, execute approval workflows, required disclosures, content monitoring and documentation together with Legal and Compliance. What would ensure success in this role?💪 Expert in at least one partner management platform (Affiliate platforms such as Target Circle/Circlewise, Impact, Awin or Partnerize, CJ Advanced Excel or Google Sheets and BI dashboard experience AI fluency: Comfortable using AI tools for data analysis, partner research and qualification, and content/compliance review, with strong judgment on when human verification is essential. Fluent in English and German is a plus What can you expect at Bondora ? 🎯 Be part of Bondora ’s ambitious journey toward 1BN in revenue - your work will have a real impact. 💰 Enjoy a competitive salary and amazing benefits: 5 weeks of vacation, private healthcare compensation, hobby grant, mental health support, share options, and much more! 📈 Work in an environment that encourages growth and innovation - with resources and budget for continuous learning. The next steps If you have the guts, ideas, and a team vision, apply now! Our hiring process: 1️⃣ Meet Anna , our Recruiter — your first chat to share your story and ambitions. 2️⃣ Meet Krzysztof Schmidt , CMO at Go&Grow 3️⃣ Tackle a home task to showcase your skills. 4️⃣ Complete our personality and logic assessments via Alva Labs. 5️⃣ Meeting Pärtel Tomberg , CEO of Bondora 6️⃣ Chat with Olga Kikas , our Chief of People 7️⃣ 🎉 If the stars align — welcome to Bondora ! Join our team of Bondorians, and let's make it happen! If you'd like to read how Bondora collects, uses, and protects your personal data during recruitment, please see HERE. items.description: About Dutchie Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis. Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups. Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors. About This Role Dutchie is looking for a Senior Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst to help drive the financial operating rhythm of the company. You’ll partner across Finance, Accounting, and business leaders to build forecasts, evaluate performance, improve planning processes, and deliver insights that influence executive decision-making. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building scalable financial infrastructure, automating manual work, and using data to tell compelling business stories. You’ll report to the Senior Director of FP&A while helping establish the next generation of planning capabilities across Dutchie . What You’ll Do Financial Planning & Forecasting Own portions of the annual operating plan, quarterly forecasts, and long-range financial planning process. Develop financial models that improve visibility into company performance and future investment decisions. Analyze monthly results, identify business drivers, and communicate actionable insights to leadership. Partner closely with Accounting to ensure accurate reporting and alignment between actuals, forecasts, and KPIs. Operational Excellence Improve and automate planning workflows using AI, modern financial tooling, and scalable processes. Identify opportunities to eliminate manual reporting through automation and self-service analytics. Help evolve executive reporting and dashboards that improve decision-making across the organization. Support board materials, leadership presentations, and strategic planning initiatives. Cross-Functional Partnership Collaborate across R&D, G&A, and Operations to understand business performance and financial impact. Become a trusted finance partner capable of simplifying complex business questions into clear financial recommendations. Help establish consistent planning disciplines as Dutchie continues to scale. Strong analytical curiosity and comfort working through ambiguity. Experience leveraging AI tools to automate analysis, improve workflows, and increase productivity. Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex analyses into executive-ready recommendations. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field. What You’ll Get We are targeting a starting salary of $124,000 - $166,000 based on the intended level for this role. Equity packages in the form of stock options to all employees. Technology (hardware, software, reading materials, etc..) allowance Flexible vacation and sick days At Dutchie , we’re committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. items.description: Shape the Future on Autopilot At Autopilot , you won’t just design screens – you’ll design how fintech works. As a Product Designer , you’ll own product experiences end-to-end and help redefine what great UX means in a complex, data-driven industry. We’re building a high-performance, AI-native Fintech Operating System designed to optimize cost and revenue for digital businesses. Join us on a multi-year mission to build smarter infrastructure for commerce. Why Join Us? You’ll help build an ambitious product from the ground up, with a team that values speed, craft, and autonomy. If you’re ready to make an outsized impact in fintech, we’d love to meet you. About the Role You'll join a fast-moving team building modern, data-intensive web applications that help digital businesses operate more intelligently. This is a founding design role with strong emphasis on product logic, systems thinking, and end-to-end collaboration with engineers. 🛠️ What You'll Do Translate complex financial logic and backend systems into intuitive user flows Design dashboards, workflows, and visual systems for payments, orchestration, and automation Build and maintain our scalable design system in Figma (aligned with React components) Collaborate with engineers on real-world UX states — success, failure, pending, retry Prototype and validate features with real data and user context Participate in product discussions, shaping user journeys before pixels are drawn Uphold usability and domain accuracy as the standard for design quality 🎯 What We're Looking For 5+ years of experience designing digital products with complex logic (fintech, B2B SaaS, or data-heavy systems preferred) Strong product and systems thinking — you design for states and workflows , not just screens Deep Figma expertise (Auto Layout, Variants, Tokens, Components) Ability to translate backend logic, APIs, and data models into coherent user experiences Excellent communication and documentation skills (Linear, Figma, Slack) Comfortable working directly with engineers and iterating quickly without handoffs 🌟 Bonus Points Experience in fintech, payments, or compliance-related products Exposure to analytics or developer tooling Understanding of design-to-code workflows (React component parity, tokens) Strong interaction or motion design craft (Framer, ProtoPie, etc.) Our Hiring Process We focus on real-world collaboration, not design showreels. Here’s what to expect: Apply with LinkedIn Profile And Resume We’ll review based on the requirements above. If shortlisted, you’ll receive an email to schedule a 90-minute live design collaboration session once you’re comfortable with our pre-interview brief. 90-Minute Live Design Collaboration You’ll work with our product and engineering team on a small feature challenge — from user problem to Figma prototype. We’ll look at: How you think through logic and flows How you translate constraints into UX decisions Your interaction, hierarchy, and state management How you communicate trade-offs and rationale The session mirrors our actual workflow: accessible pragmatic collaborative Design Review & Feedback After the session, we’ll walk through your design decisions together. You’ll get feedback from our CTO and team, and discuss potential improvements or extensions to your solution. Culture & Alignment Chat A final call with CEO to discuss your long-term goals, how you work best, and whether Autopilot is the right fit for both sides. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: ABOUT RENEW CAPITAL Renew Capital is a pan-Africa investment firm with a presence in 13 countries. We back the bold founders using technology to pursue Africa’s greatest opportunities. With more than a decade of investing on the continent, Renew Capital is among the most active investors building Africa’s thriving private sector. Renew Capital is powered by a team of investment, finance, legal, advisory and market development professionals. Our bench includes seasoned investors, analysts, operators and ecosystem experts with deep experience scaling businesses across Africa. ROLE SUMMARY The sr. financial analyst plays a critical role in evaluating, supporting and scaling high-potential ventures across Africa. This role sits at the core of Renew Capital ’s investment process, supporting sourcing, due diligence, investment decision-making and portfolio value creation. The sr. financial analyst will work closely with investment managers, portfolio company CFOs and senior leadership, building rigorous financial models and translating complex data into clear insights that inform investment decisions. Responsibilities: The sr. financial analyst’s responsibilities are focused on three core areas: 1. Investment Analysis & Due Diligence Prepare and maintain robust financial models for pipeline and prospective investment opportunities. Analyze historical financial data, forecasts and assumptions to assess risk, return, and scalability. Evaluate capital expenditures, depreciation schedules, and capital structuring scenarios. Conduct market sizing, competitive analysis and primary and secondary research to support investment theses. Support financial and commercial due diligence processes from initial screening through investment committee review. 2. Portfolio Support & Monitoring Work directly with portfolio company finance teams on budgeting, 13-week rolling cash flow forecasts, and financial controls. Monitor portfolio company performance, identify trends, calculate key ratios, and flag risks or opportunities early. Build and maintain strong working relationships with portfolio CFOs and founders. 3. Communication & Insight Generation Translate complex analysis into clear, decision-ready materials for investment managers, leadership and the investment committee. Prepare presentations, memos and dashboards that communicate insights concisely. Collaborate with a diverse, distributed investment team across Africa using digital tools. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business or a related field; MBA or Master’s in Finance preferred. 6–8+ years of progressive experience in financial analysis, investment analysis, private equity, venture capital, investment banking or corporate finance, with exposure to growth-stage companies. Advanced financial modeling expertise, including integrated three-statement models, valuation, scenario and sensitivity analysis and capital structuring. Strong experience supporting or leading financial and commercial due diligence processes. Proven ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear, decision-ready insights for senior leadership and investment committees. Excellent Excel and financial analysis skills, with experience working with large, complex data sets. Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with investment teams, portfolio company CFOs and founders across diverse markets. CFA or other recognized investment or financial modeling credentials preferred. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS As Renew Capital continues to expand its investment activity across Africa, strong financial analysis is essential to deploying capital responsibly and supporting portfolio companies through growth and complexity. This role provides exposure to venture investing across multiple sectors and markets, with the opportunity to influence real investment outcomes. Location and Travel Opportunities: This is a remote role; however, candidates must be based in Côte d'Ivoire. About Renew Capital : We invite you to learn more about Renew Capital by visiting our website:. Application Process: Renew Capital invites qualified applicants to fill out the application form on our website here. Renew Capital is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran or disability status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Further, Renew Capital supports gender-based pay equity and is committed to compensating women and men equally, for equal work. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: About Discovered LabsDiscovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher and a demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR.
items.description: About Discovered Labs Discovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher and a demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR. We’re trusted by hyper-growth companies like Instantly, Granola, incident and other $10M+ ARR B2B SaaS companies who want more leads and customers from both Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT. We do this through a mixture of content marketing, technical optimisations and off-site brand amplification (PR, backlinks, Reddit marketing). View recent case studies at . High-level, our approach rests on three things: AI automation and workflows. We build marketing programs the way you’d build a product. Rather than burn hours a week on repetitive tasks, our in-house team of ML engineers builds workflows with custom tooling so we can focus on the high-impact work. Senior expertise. Everything is managed and elevated by a team of experts, so it’s done to a high standard and differentiated. We don’t let automation get in the way of quality. Full-stack. SEO and AEO rarely work as isolated tasks. We work across the entire funnel and multiple surfaces so we own the outcome and clients win. If you want to stand out, include a Loom showing a tool, system or deliverable you’ve built and are proud of. We’d love to see it. This role You analyse the data, work out why performance is moving and turn the result into a report the client can act on. You implement the fixes and improvements yourself with our internal tooling. “DS who owns data → analysis → decision → implementation end to end” Concretely, that means you: Analyse the data behind reports, strategy questions, client queries, technical issues and SWOTs — reconciling messy, incomplete sources into a clear picture of what's actually happening. QA via analysis - Is the rationale sound? Does the logic hold? Where's the unsupported claim? Run experiments. Design a falsifiable test, run it, and know when a result is noise rather than signal. Tie every finding to the client's business. You get to "so what, and why does this matter to their revenue," not just "here's what the data says." Own the report. Hand the client and the account strategist a decision-ready read the data, the diagnosis and the “so what?” never a raw data dump. Optimise for answer engines (AEO). Make client content the source LLMs and Google AI Overviews cite, using our internal methodology and tools, as one surface among many. Execute, not just recommend. You implement the findings yourself with our internal tooling. The analysis only counts once it's shipped. Improve the tactics and the systems. Turn a one-off finding into a repeatable process, and keep sharpening the tooling and methodology behind how the system works. Communicate it cleanly to clients , in writing and on calls, so your output needs no translation. This role is fully remote. Ideally your working hours overlap the GMT business day (we’re flexible within roughly ±4 hours). This is not for you if: You need heavy management, or you wait for perfect instructions before acting. If you spot a broken process, we expect you to fix it. Produce genius insights but don’t ship them. Insight with no execution is exactly the failure mode we screen for. The analyst who gets on the tools is the one we want. Lack experience and/or willingness to use advanced AI workflows. Prefer to spend weeks performing audits before implementation. B2B SaaS clients expect results fast and everything needs to tie to commercial impact. Not comfortable with data and analytics. We want someone who can diagnose the why behind performance and back it with evidence. What’s in it for you Benefits $30,000 -$50,000 annual salary depending on relevant skills and experience Fully remote position. (Ideally flexible within roughly ±4 hours GMT ) Room to grow. We’re small but growing, which means real opportunity, including a senior track with no people management required. Paid leave and autonomy to perform your role. The best in-house SEO/AEO tools i.e. ML/AI and data science tooling , built by top engineers, at your disposal. How you’ll spend your time A rough split; it flexes month to month with what each account needs. 40% — Implementing and shipping. Producing and shipping the week’s work across your accounts: technical fixes, on-page, content refreshes, internal linking, off-page and AEO, all verified at source before it goes out. 30% — Analysing, diagnosing and measuring. Getting into the numbers to understand cause and effect, designing and running experiments, and measuring what actually moved after a change. 15% — Reporting and client communication. Owning the client-facing report, being present on calls to walk through the diagnosis, staying close in day-to-day client Slack, and giving the account owner the read behind the story they lead. 15% — Building and evolving the methodology. Sharpening your own skills as search and AI assistants keep changing, and constantly improving the tooling, templates and process behind how the team works. Requirements This role owns the full loop end to end, analyse → explain → implement → report. You don't hand off execution: you analyse it, you build it, you ship it. High agency and a builder's instinct are the two traits we weight above everything, including domain knowledge. High agency covers execution and tempo; builder covers coding, AI workflows, and evolving the methodology. Strong analytical and quantitative background: you reconcile messy, incomplete data (GSC exports, rank trackers, partial client analytics not clean warehouse tables), design falsifiable experiments, and reason to a root cause with evidence, never inventing a cause where the data is silent. Demonstrated evidence of shipping a time your analysis changed what a business did, and you implemented at least part of it yourself. Insight without execution is exactly the wrong fit for this seat. You're AI-native and have built something with it: a side project, agent, scraper, or internal tool. You use AI tools daily as a workflow multiplier (briefs, clustering, audit summarisation, scraping) and still own the final, validated output. You build workflows, not just prompts and we take portfolio over claims. Experiment design and statistical rigour : you design a test, run it, and know when a result is noise. Systems thinking: you improve the tactic and improve the system colonbehind it, turning a one-off finding into a repeatable process. Commercial curiosity: you get to "so what?" unprompted, asking about the client's business model and KPIs, and land every finding as a business consequence revenue, pipeline, or cost not just a metric movement. Strong written and verbal English , with the ability to convey findings cleanly to non-technical stakeholders. Reports and QA rationale go straight to clients; the analysis only counts once a client understands it and acts on it. Nice-to-haves (not required) Experience with SEO/analytics tooling (GSC, GA4, Ahrefs, a crawler such as Screaming Frog). If you don’t have it, we’ll ramp you this is teachable. Client-facing experience, and commercial awareness. Familiarity with B2B SaaS. Culture fit You should ideally believe: Search has fundamentally changed. Google and backlinks still matter but are no longer the full picture — AI search is a new frontier and you’re excited about the shift. AI is a force multiplier, not a crutch. You’re actively using AI daily and building workflows, not just typing into a chat box. Speed and quality are both achievable. Everyone here operates at a fast pace, is reliable and takes extreme ownership. There are no passengers at Discovered Labs. You’ll thrive here if: you get energy from excellent work that makes clients successful, you see gaps in processes and fix them without being asked, and you move fast while proactively communicating. You won’t thrive here if: you need heavy management, you wait for perfect instructions, or you think SEO is still just about keywords and links. We look forward to seeing your application. items.description: Data and Analytics The Coca-Cola Company is evolving into a more digital-first, data-driven enterprise to fuel sustainable growth, increase speed to market, and unlock new sources of value. Rapid advances in technology, data, and AI create a unique opportunity to accelerate the The Coca-Cola Company (TCCC) system's next chapter of growth by reimagining our core competitive advantages. Building on a strong foundation of modernized infrastructure, global digital experiences, early data capabilities, and proven use cases, we are now shifting from early wins to scaled, end to end impact on growth, productivity, and efficiency. This next phase moves us from an analog world to a fully digitized one, powered by a digital growth engine that embeds data, technology, and AI into our most critical business domains. Success will require more than technology implementation, it demands a strategic transformation of core capabilities, a domain based, product centric operating model, and a cultural shift toward experimentation, data and technology fluency, and seamless partnership between business and digital teams. Job Description Summary The Manager, Technology Operations plays a critical role in ensuring the stability, performance, reliability, and continuous improvement of the platforms and technology services that power Coke ON and enable Coca-Cola's digital transformation. Sitting within the Technology Delivery organization, this role serves as the operational bridge between engineering, architecture, product, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and business teams to ensure Coke ON consistently delivers value at scale. As Coca-Cola accelerates adoption of cloud technologies, data platforms, automation, and artificial intelligence capabilities, operational excellence becomes increasingly important to maintaining Coke ON's business continuity and supporting growth. This role manages technology operations processes, monitors service performance, improves reliability, and drives operational readiness across Coke ON and related digital products and platforms. Responsibilities include: Manage day-to-day technology operations activities that support Coke ON and other enterprise applications, platforms, integrations, and digital products. Monitor Coke ON's technology service performance and availability to ensure critical business operations are supported effectively. Partner with engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity, architecture, and product teams to maintain Coke ON's operational stability and service reliability. Coordinate incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis activities to minimize business disruption and improve Coke ON's service quality. Drive operational readiness activities for new Coke ON technology implementations, platform enhancements, and major releases. Establish and maintain service level metrics, performance dashboards, and operational reporting that provide visibility into Coke ON's technology health and business impact. Identify opportunities to automate operational processes, improve monitoring capabilities, and increase efficiency through modern technology operations practices for Coke ON. Support cloud-based operational environments and help ensure Coke ON platforms are optimized for performance, scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency. Collaborate with cybersecurity and risk management teams to ensure Coke ON's operational controls align with security, privacy, compliance, and governance requirements. Manage vendor and partner relationships related to operational support, managed services, and technology performance for Coke ON. Contribute to business continuity, disaster recovery, and operational resilience planning activities for Coke ON. Organizational Impact Directly determines the reliability and business continuity of the Coke ON platform serving JKOU consumers and bottler operations. Supports operational readiness for Coke ON releases and platform enhancements that impact commercial, marketing, and vending operations. Works across engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity, architecture, and product teams in a matrixed technology operations environment. Promotes a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration, and customer-focused service excellence for Coke ON. Innovation & Complexity Resolves complex operational challenges involving Coke ON, cloud platforms, and interconnected business-critical systems. Applies automation, observability, and monitoring capabilities to improve Coke ON's operational performance and reliability. Uses data and analytics to identify trends, proactively address operational risks, and improve Coke ON's service outcomes. Identifies recurring technology problems affecting Coke ON and implements long-term, sustainable solutions. Communication & Influence Communicates Coke ON's operational status, risks, and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Coordinates across engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity, architecture, and business teams to align on operational priorities. Facilitates incident and problem management discussions with clear, timely communication during Coke ON service disruptions. Builds trusted relationships with vendors and partners supporting Coke ON's operational environment. Experience & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline. 5+ years of experience in technology operations, IT service management, platform operations, infrastructure operations, or related technology functions. Experience supporting enterprise applications, digital products, cloud platforms, or business-critical technology environments - ideally consumer-facing platforms such as Coke ON. Strong understanding of operational processes including incident management, problem management, change management, and service monitoring. Experience working with cloud technologies, enterprise platforms, infrastructure services, and modern operational support models. Knowledge of service management frameworks, operational governance practices, and technology performance measurement. Experience collaborating across engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, product management, and business stakeholder teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and implement sustainable operational improvements. Familiarity with automation, observability, monitoring, and operational intelligence capabilities. Working knowledge of cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, and risk management considerations within technology operations environments. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/ We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget. You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product. The salary for this position is €83,000 annually. You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4. The Role As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes. You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high. Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment. Your main responsibilities will be: Ownership and delivery Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop. Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment. Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself. Craft and quality across the stack Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly. Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder. Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small. Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it. Working with product and design Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one. Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff. Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build. Raising the bar Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better. Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well. Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice. AI as core leverage Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too. About You You will thrive in this role if you: Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them. Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary. Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications. Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on. Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something. Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation. Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing. Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama. Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't. Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters. Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow. Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included. Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan. Nice to have: Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly. Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products. Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines. This Role Is NOT A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit. A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution. A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you. A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your tests, or own your performance regressions. A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why. A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work. The Team We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results. What's Happening at Toggl Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0 . One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people. Benefits Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results 24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays Unlimited sick leave In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered) 4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure) Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years €2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure €3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home €4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences €2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair) To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Serbia - Remote About Smartcat Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world’s leading enterprises. We’re on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren’t generic copilots. They’re fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one. Our platform combines generative AI, human-in-the-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Whether you're launching a product globally, onboarding new hires, translating learning content, or aligning legal teams across regions, Smartcat turns knowledge into action and action into scale. Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with 130% year-over-year growth, we’re scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us. Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time. Mission Smartcat positions itself as the central hub for managing your enterprise's multilingual content, seamlessly integrating diverse content assets. We offer convenient AI translation / content generation + Human review workflows to ensure best quality and faster turnaround. Your mission will be to own one of our most popular and business-critical tracks, related to translation and AI-based generation of textual content (we support over 50 document and file formats, including PDF and MS Office documents). The ability to create content directly on our platform is a new arm of this use case that we are just starting to build. You will work directly with clients to understand their pain points, ensure product-market fit, own the process of tracking usage data, define product improvement hypotheses, planning both a long-term roadmap and the day-to-day work to drive adoption, retention and expansion of translation and content generation volumes related to your use case. You will act as an entrepreneur whose goal is to achieve the breakthrough with all possible means, and will grow your part of the business, measured in the volume of words processed through the platform. Within 3 months, your outcomes will be You will have a product roadmap defined for the next quarter for the technical areas of the product you're responsible for, and own this roadmap and delivery schedule further. For each feature we ship and for each larger improvement track that spans multiple product areas, you will have a definition of key performance indicators and be accountable for their growth. You will own the acquisition funnel for this use case and understand the problems that matter the most. Together with the BI analyst, you will own dashboards to track your KPIs, as well as monitor other data sources and feedback channels, to inform your next steps and rapidly iterate to improve the product. Together with the designer and the team lead of a dedicated engineering team, you will own a process of developing new features, conducting customer interviews and ensuring proper execution with the engineering teams. Together with the Director of Product, you will align on the product strategy, get a solid understanding of how our product works, and establish a reliable product discovery & execution process. Requirements Outstanding achievement as a product manager for B2B SaaS platforms with a focus on product-led growth. At least 5 years of experience working as a product manager. Exceptional, native-level English, both written and spoken. Exceptional communication skills to interact with colleagues, customers, and partners. Experience working on projects related to document processing is a strong plus. Experience working on customer-facing user interfaces (either in B2B or B2C products) is a strong plus. Knowledge of modern developments in ML/AI related to text processing (LLM, RAG) and overall technical background is a strong plus. Knowledge of a localization industry is a strong plus. Growth-oriented mindset. Integrity, full commitment, and a strong sense of ownership. Experience working in a highly intense startup environment, requiring extreme focus, a sense of urgency, and persistence to break through. Openness to feedback and alternative opinions and ideas. Comfortable working with remote teams across time zones. Easy-going personality, high tolerance to cultural differences. Why joining Smartcat might be your best move so far Fully remote team We are a global team of 200+ enthusiastic people spread across 30+ countries. We have been fully remote since 2020, with some locations populated with more Smartcaters than others, such as Boston, Belgrade, Lisbon, Tbilisi and Yerevan. Be part of an AI Native Organization We are highly innovative, using AI across all areas of the organization to accelerate decision-making and free people to focus on strategy and high-impact work. We embrace new ideas and encourage all Smartcaters, regardless of level or department, to manage their own AI Agents. At Smartcat you’ll shape how AI transforms the workplace and play an integral role in ensuring Smartcat remains a leader in AI innovation. Innovating a $100 Billion industry Smartcat is reshaping the $100B multilingual content industry with an AI-powered platform that makes it easy for companies to create, translate, and localize global content at scale. Our platform enables enterprise teams to move away from slow, traditional outsourcing methods, and achieve fast, high-quality results, at a fraction of the cost. Join the rocketship to scale-up 10x and beyond together We are looking for someone to become an integral part of our team and play a crucial role in the most exciting part of our journey: transitioning from a post-Series C startup to a company exceeding $100M in ARR and $1B in valuation. Our journey isn’t for the faint of heart. We are growing at 130% YoY, thanks to our strong product-market fit and high-performing team, and plan to accelerate from here. Smartcat Culture : Where Diversity Meets High Performance At Smartcat, we are committed to building a culture that highlights respect and appreciation for each individual's unique background and perspective, while maintaining a strong focus on results and engagement. We believe in welcoming everyone and fostering an inclusive environment where team members can be their authentic selves at work. Our commitment to inclusion is steadfast, and we stand firmly against discrimination and harassment. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/smartcat-senior-product-manager

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Toronto Who are we? Our mission is to scale intelligence to serve humanity. We’re training and deploying frontier models for developers and enterprises who are building AI systems to power magical experiences like content generation, semantic search, RAG, and agents. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. We like to work hard and move fast to do what’s best for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are passionate about their craft. Each person is one of the best in the world at what they do. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives is a requirement for building great products. Join us on our mission and shape the future! Role Overview We are seeking a Platform Experience and Developer PM to own how developers and enterprise technical teams build on, integrate with, and operate Cohere's model platform. This is a high-leverage role sitting at the intersection of three domains: Managed Services and Models as a Service. Own Cohere's managed service offerings as a product. This is broader than model serving alone. It includes the full range of how enterprises consume and operate Cohere's capabilities, from shared multi-tenant model access to dedicated single-tenant deployments, and from synchronous real-time inference to high-volume asynchronous workloads. You will own the product thinking around deployment models, data residency and regional compliance requirements, self-serve provisioning, and the operational controls that give enterprises confidence in running production workloads on Cohere’s infrastructure. API and SDK. Own the roadmap for how developers build on Cohere. This means setting the direction for our APIs and SDKs, thinking carefully about interface design and ergonomics, and ensuring we ship developer primitives that are stable, well-documented, and a joy to build with. Developer Experience and Tooling. Own the surfaces that give developers visibility and control over their integration with Cohere. This includes the API console, credential and access management, usage and cost visibility, request observability, and sandbox and testing environments Responsibilities Drive the roadmap across managed services, APIs, SDKs, and developer tooling, balancing near-term customer needs with long-term platform investment. Translate model and infrastructure capabilities into well-designed product surfaces that developers and enterprise operators can rely on. Engage directly with customers and developers to understand integration challenges, validate priorities, and surface unmet needs. Define success metrics for platform health and developer experience, and lead initiatives to move them. Partner with engineering, research, technical writing, and developer relations to ship and document platform improvements. Requirements 5+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent owning developer-facing or platform-layer products such as APIs, SDKs, developer tools, or technical infrastructure. Strong technical fluency with API design and SDK development, including an understanding of versioning, backward compatibility, and what makes a developer experience feel polished and reliable. A track record of thinking about infrastructure as a product, with the ability to translate system-level capabilities into clearly differentiated, customer-facing features. Experience building or owning developer tooling surfaces such as consoles, dashboards, usage analytics, or observability and debugging tools. Analytical by default: you define success metrics before you build, instrument thoughtfully, and use data alongside qualitative feedback to make decisions. Strong collaborator who works well across engineering, design, infrastructure, and GTM teams, and who can communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to a range of stakeholders. Highly execution-oriented with a bias toward shipping and iterating quickly. Demonstrated ownership across the full product lifecycle — from problem definition and scoping through launch, iteration, and eventual deprecation or migration. Nice-to-Haves Experience owning a model serving or inference platform, including familiarity with deployment models such as multi-tenant and dedicated infrastructure. Exposure to data residency, sovereignty, or regional compliance requirements as they apply to AI or cloud infrastructure products. Familiarity with asynchronous and high-throughput workload patterns, and the product considerations they introduce around job management, status visibility, and cost attribution. Familiarity with the AI developer ecosystem and open standards, including orchestration frameworks such as LangChain and LlamaIndex, model serving frameworks such as vLLM, and an awareness of de facto interoperability standards and how they shape developer adoption and integration patterns. Why join Cohere? Impact: Shape the developer surface of one of the world's leading enterprise AI platforms, used by developers and enterprises building production AI systems at scale. Innovation: Work alongside leading researchers and engineers solving complex ML challenges at the frontier of AI. Growth: Enjoy competitive compensation, equity options, and opportunities for professional development. Flexibility: Hybrid work model with offices in San Francisco, New York, and Toronto. Location Remote or hybrid (San Francisco, New York, Toronto). If some of the above doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply! We value and celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment for all. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form , and we will work together to meet your needs. Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks: An open and inclusive culture and work environment ‍ Work closely with a team on the cutting edge of AI research Weekly lunch stipend, in-office lunches & snacks Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget to take care of your mental health 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months Personal enrichment benefits towards arts and culture, fitness and well-being, quality time, and workspace improvement Remote-flexible, offices in Toronto, New York, San Francisco, London and Paris, as well as a co-working stipend ️ 6 weeks of vacation (30 working days!) To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/cohere-product-manager-platform-experience-developer-product

You'll work directly
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://www.brandogdigital.com/ Location: Remote (US, Canada or Latin America) Type: Contract / FTE Equivalent Start: Immediately The Role We're seeking an experienced Senior Digital Marketing Manager to own a pod of paid social DTC accounts end to end: strategy, buying, and client relationship. You'll work directly alongside the founders to shape how we grow our clients' businesses and our agency's capabilities, while mentoring junior team members and drawing on them for support. Your primary responsibility will be your pod of accounts, and you will also assist the founders across the business with other clients as needed. Key Responsibilities Whole-Business Performance You evaluate accounts through blended CAC, contribution of paid to total revenue, new-vs-returning mix, and retention signals, and you make day-to-day decisions off real performance. Forecasts are a guide and the actual numbers drive your decision-making. You can explain why platform ROAS alone is a bad compass. Campaign Strategy & Execution Develop and own full-funnel paid media strategies across Meta (plus potentially TikTok, Pinterest, and other platforms as needed) Set monthly targets grounded in the client's actual CPA and funded budget, adjusting as reality comes in Hands-on platform execution: budget allocation, pacing, scaling, and cutting based on performance and client KPIs Lead campaign setup, launch, ongoing optimization, and performance analysis across your pod Analytics & Reporting Own client-facing performance reporting — translating data into clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations Build and maintain advanced dashboards using Google Sheets, Supermetrics, and similar tools Conduct regular account audits to identify growth and efficiency opportunities Establish and track KPIs, benchmarks, and forecasting models across accounts Creative Strategy Translate revenue goals into a plan for what the creative team needs to produce, and when Analyze creative performance and use data to inform iteration cycles and testing roadmaps Build and manage structured A/B testing frameworks across creative Client & Team Leadership Serve as a primary point of contact for key client accounts, building trust through proactive communication and strategic guidance Lead client status calls and strategy presentations with a clear, confident perspective Deliver difficult news clearly and present paths to a solution Mentor and provide day-to-day guidance to Marketing Analysts and junior team members Collaborate with founders on agency operations, new business pitches, and process improvements How the Ramp Works The timeline is quick, but the ramp is structured and gradual — we make sure you're confident before you take over, then expect you to run it day to day, with founders staying involved at the strategic level. Months 1–2: Take over buying and strategy on your starting pod with founder oversight, shadowing then co-leading client calls. Months 3–4: Lead calls solo as founders step back to strategic oversight. We'll know it's working if by month four, your pod runs seamlessly through you, and you're handling day-to-day calls, strategy, and buying. How We Work You'll work directly with the founders who've built the systems you'll run. We give you the context, tools, and information you need, then we expect you to be independent and trust you to run with it. You arrive with the paid marketing knowledge, and we help you sharpen how you apply it. We have a defined way of operating — performance-led planning, a structured creative cadence, specific views on measurement — refined across years of DTC accounts. The best people we've worked with bring their own judgment and look to understand why our system works the way it does. That combination is what we're hiring for. Requirements Several years of hands-on paid media buying on Meta (other platforms a plus) for DTC/e-commerce at meaningful spend, with accounts you can walk through in detail (what you did, why, and what happened) Proven track record of managing and scaling paid media budgets with measurable results Fluency in whole-business marketing math: blended CAC, paid contribution to overall revenue, new-vs-returning dynamics Client-facing maturity: you can carry a strategy call, deliver difficult news, and build trust over time Self-directed: you take direction and apply it independently, and you surface problems early instead of sitting on them Strong command of analytics platforms and experience building data dashboards Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — able to present complex data clearly to non-technical stakeholders Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously with the ability to prioritize effectively under pressure Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and motivate junior team members Available across the full US business day; if US-based, must contract through your own business entity Familiarity with TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, and other social platforms is a plus Compensation Competitive for senior operators, calibrated to experience and location. Ready to Apply? Email your resume to jobs@brandogdigital.com with a cover letter outlining your experience managing performance marketing campaigns and any notable results you've driven for clients or brands. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/brandog-digital-senior-digital-marketing-manager-paid-social

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: UK URL: http://agpt.co Remote · ~3 days/week · 12-week contract · £500–£650/day · Immediate start · Paid working trial for finalists About AutoGPT At AutoGPT, we're building toward a future where AI agents do real work for people — not just answer questions, but take action, complete tasks, and move work forward. Our mission is to democratize AI by making powerful digital assistants accessible and useful to everyone, regardless of technical background. We created one of the most-starred open-source projects on GitHub, and our hosted platform is now live and accepting paying customers. We already have a large global audience and tens of thousands of branded search visitors every month. What we don't yet have is a proven, repeatable go-to-market motion. That's what you'll find. The Product AutoPilot: an AI teammate that builds and runs working automations from a conversation. AutoGPT Builder: a graph-based canvas for creating agents without coding. AutoGPT Marketplace: discover and deploy ready-made agents. Agent Library: manage, schedule, and monitor agents. Try it in 60 seconds, no signup required: platform.agpt.co/tour/chat The Role Your mandate is to find, prove, and begin scaling a repeatable path from an ICP-fit prospect with an urgent job to an activated, retained AutoGPT customer. You'll investigate and fix the constraint wherever it exists: ICP selection, positioning, proof, pricing, website conversion, checkout, onboarding, activation, lifecycle communication, product experience, or acquisition. This isn't a role where you deliver recommendations to another marketing team. You'll personally research, write, build, launch, measure, and iterate , with direct access to the founders, product, engineering, and customer and funnel data. What You'll Own Establish reliable measurement from acquisition through purchase, activation, and retention. Interview customers, non-buyers, churned users, and high-fit waitlist members. Validate or disprove our ICP and use-case hypotheses. Define the initial ICP, anti-ICP, JTBD, buying trigger, and value proposition. Improve positioning, use-case pages, proof, checkout, and onboarding. Help define and improve activation and time to value. Launch segmented waitlist campaigns. Run controlled paid-search tests around high-intent, non-branded problems. Validate SEO opportunities before scaling content. Test product-led social, YouTube, outreach, or partnerships where evidence supports them. Work directly with product and engineering on funnel and activation improvements. Maintain a prioritized experiment backlog with hypotheses, costs, results, and decisions. Provide concise weekly reporting: one async memo and one 30-minute decision meeting. Protect and elevate the AutoGPT brand throughout. What Success Looks Like Within 10 business days: A reliable view of the funnel, including qualified traffic and meaningful product activation. Evidence explaining the biggest current drop-offs. Customer and high-fit non-buyer interviews completed. Initial improvements or experiments already live. Numeric targets agreed for the remainder of the contract. By the end of the engagement: ICP and use-case hypotheses validated or rejected. Qualified conversion and/or activation and retention improved. Acquisition sources that produce genuinely valuable customers understood. The beginnings of a repeatable acquisition + activation motion — or compelling evidence identifying and addressing a more fundamental constraint. A documented growth operating system and clear recommendation for what comes next. The primary outcome isn't more traffic. It's more ICP-fit customers who successfully use AutoGPT and remain customers. Who We're Looking For You've personally operated in an early-stage product-led B2B or prosumer SaaS environment — perhaps as a first or second growth hire, founding marketer, hands-on growth lead, product-growth operator, or former founder. You can demonstrate: Relevant 0-to-1 growth results, including the starting baseline. Exactly what you personally did — real pages, emails, ads, onboarding flows, dashboards, or research. Strong customer-research and product-marketing judgment. Analytical self-sufficiency across attribution, billing, and product data. Experience improving onboarding, activation, or retention. Ability to write and ship landing pages, emails, ads, and lifecycle communication. Hands-on paid-search and experimentation experience. Excellent written English and strong brand judgment. Ability to work autonomously and communicate concisely. Experience with AI, automation, developer tools, no-code products, or open-source communities is useful, but evidence that you've solved this kind of commercial problem matters more. This Is Not An adviser-only fractional CMO role. A strategy-deck engagement. A pure paid-acquisition role. An SEO content-production contract. A social-media management role. An agency account-management role. A position for someone who needs a full design, analytics, and marketing team before shipping. Agency applications aren't suitable. We want the individual who will personally do the work. Why AutoGPT? You'll own the commercial growth problem at a pivotal moment: a famous brand, a live product, an existing audience, and a genuinely open playing field. You'll have direct access to the founders, fast decisions on experiments, and no approval bureaucracy for agreed reversible tests. We're a small, kind, globally distributed team that values empathy, autonomy, and shipping. What you prove during this engagement can become the company's long-term growth engine. Details Role: Contract GTM Lead (0-to-1) Term: Initial 12 weeks, approximately 3 days/week Location: Fully remote, async-first, with meaningful European working-hour overlap Rate: £500–£650/day, depending on evidence and experience Start: Immediate Selection: Finalists complete a paid working trial How to Apply The application takes approximately 10 minutes. Apply here: https://tally.so/r/QK94p8 We'll ask for: Two relevant examples of early-stage growth work, including the starting position, problem, your personal contribution, what you shipped, results, and what didn't work. An example where an apparent acquisition problem turned out to be a different funnel, product, or positioning problem. What you'd need access to in your first week. Your availability, time zone, day rate, and number of other active clients. A short recording after trying AutoGPT, covering the biggest unknown you'd investigate, the first metric you'd establish, and one thing you'd deliberately avoid doing prematurely. We assess candidates on relevant evidence, analytical judgment, hands-on execution, customer and product-marketing ability, brand judgment, and autonomy. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/autogpt-gtm-lead
