items.title: Identity Trust & Fraud Intelligence Specialist - Intermediate (AI Community)
items.summary: Job description About the Role: At TELUS Digital, we are building the "Shield of Trust" for global digital identity.
items.description: Job description About the Role: At TELUS Digital , we are building the "Shield of Trust" for global digital identity. You will join an elite freelance pool focused on training AI to detect fraud, verify identity documents, and maintain the highest standards of KYC (Know Your Customer) . Your role is to teach AI models how to distinguish between a real human and a high-fidelity synthetic mask, and between a genuine passport and a masterfully forged document. At TELUS, you ensure that digital access remains secure for everyone. Key Responsibilities: Document Authenticity Auditing: Review and annotate high-resolution scans of international IDs (Passports, Visas, Licenses) to identify microscopic markers of forgery or tampering. Liveness & Biometric Verification: Evaluate "Liveness" test data to help AI detect deepfakes, playback attacks, or 3D masks during the face-matching process. OCR & PII Data Validation: Audit the accuracy of AI-extracted data (Name, DOB, Expiry) from documents, ensuring the model handles different scripts and localized document formats. Adversarial Fraud Testing: Act as a "Fraudster" by testing the system with edge-case documents and synthetic identities to find vulnerabilities in the KYC model. Qualification path Mandatory Qualifications: Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in Cybersecurity, Criminal Justice, Forensic Science, or Information Security. Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language is mandatory to identify localized document types and regional identity nuances. English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level English. Analytical Eye: Exceptional attention to detail, specifically in identifying pixel-level anomalies in digital images. Assessment: In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community: Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts. Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day. Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies. Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects. Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology. Apply Here: ﻿ Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Contact email Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: StellarTech is a rapidly growing product company building scalable EdTech products for a global audience. As our business and product portfolio continue to grow, we are strengthening our Talent Acquisition team and looking for a Senior Recruiter to own complex, business-critical hiring across the company. This is a full-cycle role with a strong focus on direct search, hiring manager partnership, and measurable outcomes. You will lead 4-6 roles at a time - including Senior, Lead, and Head-level positions - and help us build the systems that make every next hire more focused, predictable, and effective. What You’ll Do Own 4-6 vacancies end to end, with a focus on senior, leadership, and business-critical roles. Partner with hiring managers from the kick-off stage: clarify the business need, shape a realistic candidate profile, define the scorecard, and align on the hiring process. Build a sourcing strategy for each role, including talent-market mapping, donor-company research, Boolean and X-ray search, LinkedIn sourcing, and personalized outreach sequences. Proactively engage passive candidates instead of relying mainly on inbound applications. Conduct structured interviews, assess candidates against agreed criteria, and provide clear, evidence-based recommendations. Prepare and calibrate hiring managers and interviewers to ensure consistent, high-quality assessment across all stages. Own the recruitment funnel and use data to identify bottlenecks, improve stage conversions, and keep stakeholders aligned on progress and risks. Manage the offer process and candidate communication through to the person’s first working day. Bring market intelligence to the business: talent availability, compensation expectations, competitor insights, and realistic hiring timelines. What We’re Looking For 6+ years of experience in full-cycle recruitment, including at least 4 years in a product IT company. Experience hiring for Growth Marketing, Product, Analytics, or Engineering roles. Experience in B2C subscription products, mobile apps, EdTech, or another high-growth digital environment. A proven track record of closing Senior, Lead, or Head-level roles, with the ability to explain your approach, funnel metrics, timelines, and results. Strong hands-on sourcing expertise and confidence working with passive talent across multiple channels. Experience partnering with hiring managers, challenging unclear or unrealistic requirements, and translating business needs into an actionable search strategy. A structured, data-informed approach to recruitment: you understand funnel metrics, conversion rates, and how to use them to improve outcomes. Experience with competency-based assessment, scorecards, and structured interviews. Strong ownership and communication skills, with the ability to manage several priorities and keep stakeholders aligned. Practical use of AI tools in day-to-day recruiting - for research, sourcing, communication, analysis, or workflow automation. Fluency in Ukrainian with English at B2 level or above. Why You’ll Love Working With Us High-impact hiring: You’ll own roles that directly affect product delivery, team capability, and business growth. Room to shape the function: Our Talent Acquisition system is evolving, and you’ll have a real voice in how we build processes, tools, and standards. Direct partnership: You’ll work closely with hiring managers and business leaders, with clear access to decision-makers. AI-enabled workflow: We provide access to AI subscriptions and modern recruiting tools to automate routine work and focus on higher-value decisions. Health support: We offer medical expense compensation. Work-life balance: You’ll have flexible paid time off, including 21 days of annual leave plus 10 bank holidays. Collaborative culture: You’ll work with curious, driven people who value ownership, clarity, and evidence-based decisions. Hiring Process Introductory call with the Head of People - 30 minutes. Functional interview - 60 minutes. Live recruitment case - 60 minutes, with no take-home assignment. Final meeting - 30 minutes. If you enjoy solving complex hiring challenges, working closely with the business, and building systems rather than simply following them, we’d love to hear from you. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Are you knowledgeable about investments and eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from simple conversational tools into systems capable of analyzing financial markets, interpreting investment strategies, and supporting decision-making across asset classes. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can help improve financial literacy, strengthen portfolio analysis, and support investors and analysts worldwide. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI. We’re looking for individuals with familiarity in areas such as equity and fixed-income markets, portfolio management, asset allocation, derivatives, valuation methods, financial modeling, risk management, behavioral finance, and macroeconomic influences on markets. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics such as fundamental and technical analysis, portfolio construction, diversification strategies, market cycles, performance evaluation, and investment research—documenting failure modes so we can strengthen model reasoning and analytical accuracy. On a typical day, you will engage the model with investment scenarios, analytical questions, and market-based reasoning tasks; verify factual correctness and financial logic; assess the validity of investment reasoning; capture reproducible error traces; and provide structured feedback to improve prompts, evaluation frameworks, and analytical depth. You may also help identify where models oversimplify market behavior or misinterpret financial data. A background in finance, economics, accounting, business, or a related field is preferred but not required. Experience in asset management, brokerage, research, financial planning, or related roles is valuable, and entry-level candidates with foundational knowledge of investments and strong analytical skills are encouraged to apply. Clear, metacognitive communication—explicitly articulating reasoning and decision processes (“showing your work”)—is essential. Ready to turn your knowledge of investments into the knowledge foundation for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and help train systems that support investors, analysts, and financial professionals worldwide. We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. items.description: Why this role exists We help customers get more value from Koronet by changing how they work—whether that’s buying smarter, serving their own buyers better, or cutting out friction. Role Overview We’re one team with one goal: delivering actual value. We share what we learn from customers, help our colleagues succeed, and focus on outcomes, not just checking boxes like 'completed call' or 'closed ticket.' Transactions at Koronet Transactions connects how our customers actually work with what our platform can do. We sit between customer feedback and product development, turning what we see in the field into real product improvements. We don't just 'do tasks'—we look for ways to solve problems and use what we learn to make the whole platform better for everyone. What you will do Understand how customers operate: buying, selling, inventory, and operational friction. Guide customers to get more value by suggesting practical behavior changes. Lead discovery to uncover real constraints and trade-offs rather than surface-level issues. Give honest advice on what Koronet can do, what needs a workaround, and what isn't possible yet. Treat objections as valuable feedback, not personal rejection. Drive adoption through testing, follow-through, and clear evidence of progress. Share field insights with Product, Support, Marketing, and Sales to improve our product and strategy. How you will work with other departments CS & Implementation: Prioritize measurable customer value over "completed tasks." Product & Support: Provide specific evidence, workflows, and outcomes to guide development. Marketing & Revenue: Use real-world feedback to improve messaging and targeting. Growth Systems: Use account data to prepare for smarter, more relevant conversations. What success looks like Increased digital buying and selling in our ecosystem The team understands exactly why actions succeed or fail and applies that learning. Customers trust us because we’re transparent and don't oversell. The wider team gets clear, early feedback that makes our product and workflows better. A few things this role isn't! A reactive ticket-queue owner or a replacement for implementation. A quota-chaser who makes promises other teams have to clean up. A project coordinator focused only on tracking activity. A silo; you are the direct link between our customers and our product team. What do we expect from you Experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or B2B operational transformation. Fluent in English (must). Enjoy speaking with customers and feel comfortable leading difficult conversations. Listen well and communicate clearly, connecting changes to real customer incentives. Handle objections with curiosity and use them to improve future conversations. Has strong organizing skills. Team Player, who shares information and puts company goals first. Experience in the floriculture industry will be considered a strong plus. What We Offer: An independent, flexible, and versatile role within a fast-growing international organization. Flexible / Remote working environment. We encourage continuous learning and professional growth. Why Join Koronet : Global and Remote-First: Work with a diverse team across the Americas and Europe, with flexibility to work from anywhere. Ownership Culture: We foster an environment where each team member takes ownership and is empowered to contribute to the company's success. Growth & Development: We support continuous professional growth and offer financial assistance for technical certifications and other learning opportunities. Compensation: Competitive salary and an indefinite contract, with salary negotiable based on experience. If you're passionate about making an impact and growing with a dynamic, remote-first company, we want to hear from you! Originally posted on Himalayas

We are currently seeking a dynamic and passionate individual to join our team as a Coding Instructor for a project-based position lasting 3 months. Overview We are seeking a Digital Arts Track Instructor responsible for delivering engaging, hands-on sessions that introduce students to the fundamentals of digital design, animation, video editing, and 3D content creation. The instructor will guide students through practical creative workflows using industry-relevant tools such as Photopea, Figma, Canva, Inkscape, CapCut, Blender, and Unity. The role focuses on helping students understand core visual design principles, animation fundamentals, and digital media production while encouraging creativity, problem-solving, and project-based learning. Key Responsibilities Deliver structured sessions covering digital design, animation, video editing, and 3D modeling fundamentals. Teach students how to use digital creative tools including Photopea, Figma, Canva, Inkscape, CapCut, Blender, and Unity. Guide students through hands-on projects such as designing logos, creating vector illustrations, producing short videos, and building simple 3D models. Introduce design principles including shape composition, layout, and visual storytelling. Teach students how to break complex drawings into simple geometric shapes and design creative visual assets. Explain core 2D animation concepts including animation basics, character joints, and shape-based animation techniques. Demonstrate how animation is used in games, cartoons, and digital media. Teach the fundamentals of video editing including trimming clips, arranging timelines, adding text overlays, and adjusting basic audio. Introduce students to 3D modeling concepts using Blender, including navigating the interface and creating simple low‑poly models. Explain the differences between Eevee and Cycles render engines and guide students in exporting visual outputs. Guide students in importing assets into Unity and organizing them for basic game development workflows. Mentor students during exercises and projects while encouraging creativity and experimentation. Strong understanding of digital design fundamentals , including composition, layout, and visual storytelling. Practical experience with digital creative tools , such as Photopea, Figma, Canva, Inkscape, CapCut, Blender, and Unity . Knowledge of vector illustration and digital design workflows . Understanding of 2D animation fundamentals , including shape-based animation and character joints. Basic knowledge of video editing , including timeline management, trimming clips, adding text overlays, and basic audio adjustments. Familiarity with 3D modeling concepts in Blender , including creating simple low-poly models. Basic understanding of render engines (Eevee and Cycles) and exporting visual outputs. Basic knowledge of game development workflows , including importing and organizing assets in Unity. Ability to explain complex creative concepts in a simple and engaging way . Experience in guiding students through practical, project-based learning activities . Strong communication, mentoring, and classroom engagement skills . Compatible Salary. Flexible Hours. Certificate of Experience Team Collaboration & Mentorship To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ischool-graphic-design-instructor-project-based

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Canada - Remote Description de l'entreprise Workleap est une entreprise tech basée à Montréal avec comme mission de rendre le travail plus simple. Depuis 2006, on bâtit des produits innovants qui aident les équipes RH et TI à relever leurs plus grands défis. Workleap offre deux lignes de produits distinctes : La plateforme Workleap , une solution RH propulsée par l’IA qui élève la performance des équipes et stimule l’engagement des employés. ShareGate , le leader incontesté en migration et gouvernance Microsoft 365, reconnu par les professionnels TI du monde entier pour sa grande simplicité. Aujourd’hui, c’est plus de 20 000 entreprises partout dans le monde qui comptent sur les produits Workleap pour croître, évoluer et opérer. On est des bâtisseurs dans l’âme et ce qui nous passionne est clair : créer les produits les plus simples qui amènent de la valeur exceptionnelle à nos clients, un point c’est tout. Description du poste Concrètement à quoi va ressembler ton poste ? En tant que Senior Designer de Produit sur ShareGate Migrate , tu travailleras au sein d’un trio produit étroitement collaboratif (PM, Tech Lead, Designer) pour façonner l’expérience d’un produit utilisé dans des projets à fort impact et à forte sensibilité opérationnelle. Tu concevras des solutions qui aident les administrateurs TI à naviguer dans des scénarios de migration complexes avec clarté et confiance. Ton travail couvre à la fois la stratégie et l’exécution : définition des problématiques, conception des parcours et des interactions, affinage des détails d’interface, et itérations rapides basées sur les apprentissages. Tu exploreras de manière réfléchie comment l’ IA peut enrichir l’expérience, que ce soit pour simplifier la planification, faire émerger des insights pertinents ou guider les équipes dans leurs décisions techniques. C’est une occasion de travailler sur des enjeux concrets ayant un impact réel sur l’évolution des environnements numériques des organisations. Tu t’épanouiras dans ce rôle si tu aimes la complexité, collabores naturellement avec les ingénieurs et les PM, et accordes une grande importance à la création d’expériences utilisateur fiables, réfléchies et capables de passer à l’échelle. Responsabilités : Piloter le design de bout en bout au sein de ton équipe produit, de la définition des problèmes jusqu’au raffinement des interactions finales ; Transformer des parcours ambigus ou techniques en expériences intuitives et utiles pour des professionnels TI ; Concevoir des parcours, interfaces et interactions qui simplifient les scénarios de migration Microsoft 365 et cloud ; Collaborer étroitement avec les PM, les ingénieurs et les experts métier pour clarifier le périmètre et aligner la stratégie ; Prototyper, tester et itérer rapidement afin de valider les hypothèses et renforcer les solutions ; Utiliser les données, les retours clients et les insights produit pour guider les décisions et améliorer les résultats ; Explorer des opportunités liées à l’IA pour rendre les flux de migration et de gouvernance plus efficaces, prédictifs et fiables ; Contribuer à l’amélioration des pratiques design à l’aide de nouveaux outils, d’innovations et de nouvelles méthodologies ; Participer à l’évolution du design system et veiller à la cohérence de l’expérience à travers ShareGate. Une semaine typique? Tu évolueras naturellement entre exploration stratégique, design concret et collaboration étroite. Concrètement, tu pourras : Contribuer à la direction produit lors des activités de planification et de découverte en trio ; Traduire les besoins clients et les opportunités business en parcours clairs, wireframes et prototypes ; Travailler avec l’ingénierie pour affiner le périmètre, comprendre les contraintes et maintenir un haut niveau de qualité design tout au long du développement ; Présenter des travaux en cours aux équipes et aux parties prenantes lors de critiques ou de revues asynchrones ; Analyser les données de migration, les tendances de support et les comportements utilisateurs pour éclairer les décisions ; Raffiner les détails d’interaction et assurer des hand-offs clairs et cohérents ; Documenter les décisions et communiquer efficacement le raisonnement derrière les choix effectués ; Utiliser des outils d’IA pour mieux comprendre nos utilisateurs et augmenter ton efficacité ; Prototyper régulièrement avec des outils de prototypage assistés par l’IA pour communiquer, tester et valider les solutions. Tu bénéficieras d’autonomie, de responsabilité, et d’une équipe qui valorise l’exécution réfléchie et l’apprentissage continu. Qui est l’équipe que tu vas rejoindre ? Tu rejoindras une équipe multidisciplinaire où les designers sont impliqués tôt, influencent la direction produit et collaborent étroitement avec l’ingénierie et la gestion de produit. Le design chez Workleap est collaboratif, riche en feedback, et engagé à constamment élever le niveau, autant dans les processus que dans la qualité du craft. Quels sont les prochains défis qui attendent ton équipe ? ShareGate évolue rapidement, et les défis design à venir demandent à la fois créativité et rigueur. Tu contribueras notamment à : Des scénarios de migration à l’échelle entreprise, où la clarté, la prévisibilité et l’efficacité sont essentielles ; La modernisation des expériences clés de ShareGate Migrate et de l’écosystème plus large ; L’évolution d’un design system en croissance, soutenant de nouveaux patterns, l’accessibilité et la cohérence multi-produits ; Des expériences de planification et de guidance AI-native pour aider les équipes TI à anticiper les risques et prendre des décisions éclairées. C’est un rôle où tu peux influencer non seulement le fonctionnement du produit aujourd’hui, mais aussi son évolution sur les prochaines années. Qualifications 6+ ans d’expérience en design de produits B2B SaaS au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires ; Fort sens de l’utilisateur et aisance dans des environnements ambigus et techniquement complexes ; Maîtrise de la stratégie, des parcours UX, du design UI et des détails d’interaction soignés ; Capacité à trouver l’équilibre entre rapidité d’exécution et haute qualité ; Expérience auprès d’audiences techniques (TI, outils d’administration, plateformes) — un atout ; Expérience en conception ou collaboration sur des fonctionnalités propulsées par l’IA ; Excellentes compétences en communication et en storytelling ; Grand souci du détail et engagement fort envers la qualité du design. Fourchette salariale : 120–145 k $ CAD. La fourchette salariale affichée reflète notre échelle de rémunération au Canada. Au moment de formuler une offre, selon la région où le candidat est basé, certains ajustements peuvent s’appliquer afin de refléter les conditions du marché local. Qui nous sommes On est une équipe de curieux et de créateurs passionnés, rassemblés par le même objectif : rendre le travail plus simple - et meilleur - pour tout le monde. Les défis stimulent notre créativité, on carbure à l'intensité, et repousser les limites fait partie de notre ADN. On pense que les meilleures idées naissent de l’expérimentation, de l’apprentissage continu, et parfois même de l’inconfort—c’est comme ça qu’on évolue. Depuis 2006, on réinvente la façon dont les équipes travaillent, en alliant créativité et technologie pour résoudre de vrais problèmes en TI et en RH. On avance vite, on apprend constamment, et on garde toujours nos clients au coeur de nos décisions. Si tu es une personne proactive, qui prend les choses en main, adore collaborer et n’a pas peur de plonger dans l’inconnu - tu trouveras parfaitement ta place parmi nous. Informations supplémentaires Chez Workleap, on bâtit ensemble, on se fait confiance et on se soutient, dans la réussite ou dans l'échec. Tu pourras t'exprimer, évoluer et développer ta créativité dans un environnement qui s'adaptera à ton quotidien et à tes besoins. Nos aspirations sont de bâtir un environnement de travail sain et inclusif. Il s’agit là de l’affaire de tous et de toutes. Notre processus Expérience Candidat chez Workleap : Entrevue téléphonique - Entrevue virtuelle par Teams - Mise en situation - Offre d'emploi En tant qu’entreprise technologique, nous utilisons l’IA pour optimiser le recrutement, tout en veillant à ce que toutes les décisions d’évaluation restent humaines. On a hâte d'apprendre à te connaître ! En postulant à ce poste, tu confirmes avoir lu et être en accord avec notre politique de confidentialité . #LI-Remote To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sharegate-migrate-chezworkleap-senior-product-designer-sharegate-migrate

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Canada Rockstar is recruiting for a digital product studio that specializes in turning ideas into extraordinary digital experiences. This client is a dynamic, remote-first team of savvy professionals known for pushing creative boundaries and delivering high-quality, user-centered products through a collaborative and lean approach. This client is building a bench of talented product designers for upcoming client work. They are looking for mid-to-senior-level freelance designers who can bring strong UX thinking, sharp visual design skills, and a collaborative spirit to the team. What they're looking for If you're a seasoned product designer with a passion for digital excellence, this opportunity is for you. You’ve honed your craft over the years, with a deep understanding of UX design, visual storytelling, and collaborative product development. You’re equally comfortable working independently and alongside a cross-functional team. You manage your time well, take ownership of your work, and make confident decisions with minimal oversight. You’re fluent in tools like Figma and Adobe Suite, and you bring a user-first mindset to everything you do — whether designing mobile apps or contributing to product strategy. If you're the type of designer who pushes creative boundaries, communicates clearly, and still knows how to have a little fun in the process — they’d love to hear from you. The Details As a Product Design Contractor, you’ll contribute to a range of client-facing projects, collaborating with the Chief Creative Officer and team across the following areas: - Digital Product Design (Web & App): Shape intuitive experiences by applying research, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that elevate functionality and user engagement. - User Research & Discovery: Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to inform feature planning and prioritization. Help build products grounded in real user needs and business goals. - User Experience (UX): Apply UX methodologies like journey mapping, user flows, and usability testing to define products beyond UI — ensuring seamless and strategic user experiences. - Visual Design: Lead visual direction on select projects, producing compelling layouts and assets that translate beautifully across platforms — from product to marketing. - Presentation Collateral: Design high-impact presentation decks and visuals that bring ideas to life for clients and stakeholders. - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering and product teams by providing annotated designs, QA support, and input during handoff and development. - Additional Design Support: Contribute to project-related needs like case studies, marketing assets, and content design for social media or internal documentation. Qualifications - 4–6 years of experience in product and visual design, with a strong focus on digital experiences across web and/or mobile - Solid understanding of UX principles, including user research, usability testing, and translating insights into design decisions - Demonstrated ability to own features or tracks of work with minimal oversight — from wireframes to high-fidelity execution - Comfortable leading or contributing to discovery phases and helping define product direction in collaboration with strategy and engineering - Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, with experience working in a Mac environment - Familiarity with remote collaboration tools such as Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, Jira, and Harvest - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a team-first mindset and the ability to clearly articulate design rationale - Organized, proactive, and able to manage your own time in a fast-paced, remote work environment - Bonus: experience working in client-facing or agency settings where flexibility, autonomy, and cross-functional teamwork are key What to Expect from the Process This is a contract-based role and part of an ongoing effort to build relationships with experienced designers for future client projects. Interviews are being conducted on a rolling basis, and while there may not be immediate openings, strong candidates will be added to the contractor roster and considered as new work becomes available. Hiring timelines are directly tied to the sales pipeline, so project start dates vary. The team is committed to matching the right designer to the right project — and they will reach out when there’s a fit. About the Client This client is a digital product studio that brings together design, technology, and creativity to build meaningful experiences. They believe in pushing boundaries, working collaboratively, and delivering high-quality products that they are proud of. The remote-first culture values autonomy, trust, and open communication. The team is always exploring new ideas, evolving their process, and building products that move the needle for their clients. This position is remote and open to all candidates, but applicants based in New York City are prioritized for potential in-person collaboration. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/rockstar-product-designer

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote (Within 3 hours of EST timezone preferred) What excites you You want to be early. You like being close to the product, the customer, and the messiness of figuring things out. You enjoy turning sharp customer insight into positioning that actually changes behavior. You care about story-telling. You want to build narratives from launches and words to be thoughtful and useful, not generic or AI slop. You’re energized by hospitality. Hotels are complex, human, and operationally intense. That makes the work interesting, particularly in an age of AI. You want real ownership. If something ships poorly, you fix it. If something lands well, you know exactly why. What excites us You’ve spent 5–7 years in product marketing at a high-growth company, ideally B2B SaaS or complex marketplaces. You can explain technical or operational products in a way that feels simple and grounded. You’ve owned messaging and positioning end to end in close partnership with product, sales, and leadership. You’ve rewritten it when it didn’t work. You’ve led go-to-market for real products, not just features. You know how to scope a launch, make tradeoffs, and ship. You care to measure impact post-launch. You’re not precious about what “typical” PMMs look like. You like wearing different hats and can go beyond product marketing to engage contractors for events planning, or work with an agency to test some ads, when needed. You’re comfortable going deep. Customer calls, sales calls, demos, win-loss. You look for signal, not anecdotes. You’re hands-on. You write the first draft. You build the deck. You partner with design, but you don’t wait on them. Bonus if you’ve worked in hospitality, travel, fintech, or vertical SaaS. Bigger bonus if you genuinely like hotels. Working at Folio We're a remote-first company. Three times a year, we travel to work together in-person and stay with one of our hotel partners. We love experimenting with new tools. For the most part, we rely on Google Meet, Linear, Notion, and Slack to make decisions and get things done day-to-day. You will have the opportunity to travel frequently and meet our customers in person at conferences and events, which you will be helping plan for. We're a small team who work collaboratively and meet daily for stand up What we value Craft . We take pride in our work, find joy in execution, and believe that the best companies are built at a steady yet resilient pace. Optimism . We believe in ourselves and each other and know anything is possible with the right amount of hustle and grit. Ownership . We love making things better and have a strong sense of shared responsibility over everything we create together. Hospitality. The industry we’re building for has a culture of service to others, and we bring that energy to how we work together each day. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/folio-product-marketing-manager

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Canada URL: https://designfiles.co/ About the job: We're looking for a highly organized Content Marketing Coordinator to join our team on a remote contract basis. This role is ideal for someone who loves turning ideas into finished marketing campaigns. You'll write content, coordinate creative assets, keep projects moving, and make sure every email, social post, landing page, and product announcement is polished before it reaches our audience. We're not looking for flashy marketing copy. We're looking for someone who can communicate like a real human, who can write the way you'd talk to a designer over coffee: helpful, clear, and genuinely useful. If you're someone who notices the small details, enjoys keeping projects organized, and gets satisfaction from shipping great work, we'd love to hear from you. What you’ll help with: You'll work closely with our marketing and product teams to help bring campaigns to life by: Writing and editing marketing emails, newsletters, social posts, ads, landing pages, product updates, and promotional copy Turning campaign ideas, product launches, and feature updates into clear action plans, timelines, and deliverables Coordinating with designers to create graphics, creative assets, and revisions Gathering screenshots, product details, customer examples, links, and supporting materials needed for marketing projects Scheduling and publishing emails, social content, and other marketing updates Helping execute product launches, webinars, contests, promotions, and campaigns Reviewing marketing assets before they go live to ensure quality and accuracy Keeping marketing calendars, task lists, and project documentation organized and up to date Following up with team members to keep projects moving and deadlines on track What you’ll need: Excellent writing and editing skills Able to write marketing that feels like a helpful one-on-one conversation, not generic sales copy Strong understanding of audience, tone, and clear communication Exceptional organization and attention to detail (this is one of the most important parts of the role) Comfortable managing multiple projects at once without losing track of details Reliable follow-through and a bias toward getting things done Experience with email marketing, social media, content marketing, or campaign execution Bonus points: Experience working with SaaS companies Experience in the interior design industry or another creative field About us: DesignFiles is an all-in-one business platform built specifically for interior designers. Thousands of designers use DesignFiles to manage projects, collaborate with clients, create presentations, source products, and run more profitable businesses. Everything we create is designed to make designers' lives easier, and our marketing reflects that. We focus on education, practical advice, and helping designers succeed—not pushy sales tactics. Apply for the job: Love writing clear, helpful content and keeping marketing projects moving? Join DesignFiles as a remote Content Marketing Coordinator. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/designfiles-content-marketing-coordinator

items.description: Design Headquarters: worldwide URL: http://www.brfood.us Senior Remote Team Leader — Accounting, Data & Operations Food Services Inc. — Wholesale meat and restaurant supply distributor based in Los Angeles, California Remote Contractor Position Compensation Starting base compensation: $2,500 USD per month This position includes opportunities for: * Performance bonuses * Responsibility-based increases * Leadership increases * Additional compensation for taking ownership of major business functions A strong performer can grow the base compensation to approximately $3,000 per month within the first year, in addition to applicable performance bonuses. Compensation growth will be based on measurable responsibility, performance, accuracy, leadership, and the ability to independently manage important areas of the business. About the Role: We are looking for a senior-level Accounting & Operations Team Leader who can take ownership of daily workflows, work independently, review the work of others, and turn business data into clear actions and decisions. This is not a basic data-entry position. We are looking for someone who can operate at a top 10% performance level — someone who can analyze, review, identify problems, follow up, and help improve the way the team works. The right person should be comfortable managing both people and data in a fast-moving business environment. Key Responsibilities You will be responsible for helping lead and review daily accounting and operational workflows, including: * Reviewing and analyzing large amounts of business and financial data * Identifying errors, discrepancies, trends, and opportunities * Reviewing team members’ work for accuracy and completion * Purchase Order vs. Vendor Bill analysis * Vendor pricing and quantity discrepancy review * Accounts receivable and customer aging * Vendor aging and accounts payable * Inventory analysis and reconciliation * Price updates and vendor price-list comparisons * Creating and improving Excel reports and tracking systems * Following up on unresolved issues until they are completed * Helping organize team priorities and daily workflow * Communicating clearly with management and team members * Using AI and automation to reduce repetitive work and improve accuracy * Developing better processes, controls, and reporting systems We want someone who does more than complete a task. We expect you to understand the task, review the results, identify what is wrong, and recommend the next action. Required Experience Strong candidates should have professional experience with: * QuickBooks * Microsoft Excel — advanced level * Financial data reconciliation * Data analysis and reporting * Purchase orders and vendor bills * Accounts payable and/or accounts receivable * Reviewing and auditing work for accuracy * Managing multiple priorities * Team leadership or senior-level responsibility * Strong written and spoken English You must also be comfortable working daily with: * Zoom * ClickUp * QuickBooks * Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets * Remote desktop and cloud-based systems AI & Automation Experience We are especially interested in candidates who already understand how to use modern technology to improve their work. Because this is a remote leadership position, reliability, attendance, responsiveness, and availability during working hours are extremely important. Equipment Requirements You must have a professional remote-work setup capable of supporting all-day Zoom, QuickBooks, remote-hosted environments, Excel, ClickUp, and other business applications simultaneously. Required: * Business-class laptop or desktop * Intel Core i7 / AMD Ryzen 7 or equivalent * 32GB RAM minimum * 1TB NVMe SSD preferred * Dual monitors * Reliable high-speed internet * Wired Ethernet strongly preferred * Quiet and professional workspace Candidate Assessment Before moving forward, qualified candidates will complete a practical assessment. The workbook contains: Sheet 1 — Purchase Order Sheet 2 — Vendor Bill Your assignment is to analyze the two documents and identify the differences, discrepancies, and anything else you believe management should know. Show your analysis, calculations, and logic inside the Excel file. 6. Do not simply identify differences — demonstrate how you think about the business impact and what should be reviewed or followed up on. How to Apply Email your completed assessment workbook in .xlsx format to: assessments.brfoodus@gmail.com Subject: Assessment Attach the completed Excel file. We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate accuracy, analytical thinking, ownership, leadership, and strong business judgment through their work. Food Services Inc. items.description: Since 2018, Wisetack has been building transparent and intuitive consumer lending products that help service-based businesses thrive (think HVAC companies, veterinarians, or auto repair shops). Our leadership team comes from top fintech companies such as Lending Club, Affirm, and Varo Money. And we’re backed by leading VCs, including Insight Partners, Greylock, Quadrille, and Bain Capital Ventures (investors in Airbnb, LinkedIn, Instagram, Dropbox, and more). Having raised $84M, we’re a well-funded startup and have invested in people and technology while growing our partnerships — responsibly. We’re also proud to have received recognition from the fintech world. Awards we’ve won include: Ranked #21 on 2024 Inc. 5000 based on revenue growth Ranked #15 on 2024 Deloitte Fast 500 based on revenue growth 2024 Best Embedded Finance Solution for Banking Tech Awards 2023 Best Consumer Lending Program by Tearsheet 2023 Best Point of Sale Product by Fintech Breakthrough But what you’ll find us gleaming about the most is the recognition from our own customers, particularly our sky-high NPS rating of 79. (For reference, the average score is 44 for financial services and 36 for SaaS companies.) As a result of our efforts in building this healthy company culture, we’ve been nominated to several Great Places to Work lists, such as Best Small Workplaces, Best Workplaces in the Bay Area, and Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance. Like any startup, we’re in it for the long haul, and we’re looking for people willing to join our journey of building something special together. This process starts with our company values, which guide us in everything we do — and have played a critical role in our success. We valiantly abide by them, and would expect you to do the same: Put customers first (that’s our M.O.) Act fast (leverage our startup environment). Lead the way (show and tell). Take ownership (everyone is hands-on here). Be a good human (no egos, build financial products that do right by people). Learn more about our values here. The Role As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Wisetack, you are responsible for generating qualified pipeline through outbound prospecting. You’ll engage home services business owners, introduce Wisetack’s financing solutions, and convert cold outreach into high-quality opportunities for Account Executives. This is a high-activity, metrics-driven role focused on creating new opportunities—not waiting for them. Success is defined by consistent pipeline generation, strong conversion rates, and disciplined execution, and collaborating with your account executives. Responsibilities Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and experiment with new ways to work more efficiently and effectively Generate pipeline through outbound prospecting (calls, email, SMS) targeting home services businesses Engage & qualify inbound leads in a timely manner Identify and engage decision-makers, turning cold outreach into qualified meetings Maintain strong funnel conversion rates (connect → conversation → meeting → opportunity) Build and prioritize target account lists using tools like ZoomInfo Effectively qualify prospects (revenue, ticket size, financing usage, sales process) & handle objections on prospect calls Partner closely with Account Executives for collaboration and seamless handoffs Maintain accurate CRM data and execute structured outreach cadences Maintain and track performance against KPIs (activity, meetings, pipeline) and continuously improve messaging Requirements 2+ years of experience in outbound prospecting or a high-volume, customer-facing role Bachelor’s degree Strong phone presence with the ability to build trust quickly Familiarity with fintech, payments, or consumer financing Experience using Salesforce, Salesloft, ZoomInfo, AI-powered prospecting tools, or similar technologies AI-forward mindset with an eagerness to adopt emerging tools that improve research, personalization, productivity, and results Growth-oriented and adaptable, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, changing environment Highly organized, resilient, and motivated by results Bonus points Experience selling into home services (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, etc.) Background in B2B, fintech, or startup environments Track record of top performance in outbound roles Conclusion The base salary for the position is $75,000, plus annual target variable of $15,000, equity, and benefits . Please note that the base salary range is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level and competencies. Spend a little time on our About Us page and check out our Press page and our blog for more. If you think this might be a fit, we’d love to hear from you! This hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making. Our data practices are described in Wisetack’s Privacy Policy.

items.description: Company Description A leading global agency and consultancy, building a new Answer Engine Optimization capability for a well-known enterprise brand. This is a consulting engagement with the agency, embedded with the client team, and there’s potential to transition to a full-time role on the client side. Length: 28 weeks Hourly Rate: $150 (flexible based on experience) Location: Remote Hours: 40 hours/week Job Description You’d be joining a leading agency as a consultant, embedded on a new engagement with a well-known enterprise brand that’s building an Answer Engine Optimization capability from the ground up. Standing this up has been identified as a strategic priority for their business, so this isn’t a short strategy engagement that ends with a recommendation deck. The agency’s role is to build the capability, run it, and eventually hand it to the client’s own team. Some of the people who build it are expected to go with it. As Practice Lead, you’ll sit inside the agency’s incubation team and own day-to-day delivery for the client while building the operating model, methodology, and team structure the practice will run on long after incubation ends. This is a hands-on builder role: part practitioner, part program architect. You’ve led an AEO or GEO program before and you’ve learned from it. You’re comfortable defining process where none exists, and you can hold both the client relationship and the internal team accountable to quality and timelines at the same time. You’ll partner closely with your client-side counterparts to build trust and a working rhythm, and coordinate across the agency’s contributors and senior leadership to keep priorities aligned as the practice takes shape. The category is young, so some of this you’ll figure out as you go. That’s expected. Responsibilities Own daily delivery leadership for the client’s AEO program, setting priorities, unblocking the team, and making sure work ships on time and to standard. Stay hands-on in the work itself, not just above it. You’ll be in the tools alongside the team. Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact with client-side counterparts, building trust and a reliable operating cadence. Define and document the practice’s methodology, frameworks, and playbooks so the capability can scale beyond incubation and transfer cleanly to the client. Establish prioritization and intake processes that balance real-time client requests against longer-term practice-building work. Coordinate across agency partners (strategy, content, SEO, analytics, and leadership) to keep the work aligned with the client’s broader marketing and business goals. Identify gaps in current tooling, reporting, and measurement for AEO performance, and recommend or build solutions. Turn early learnings into repeatable processes, training materials, and staffing recommendations for scaling the team. Communicate progress, risks, and recommendations to agency leadership and client stakeholders. Qualifications Direct experience leading an AEO or GEO program, start to finish. This is the non-negotiable one. Hands-on practitioner knowledge of how AI answer engines source and surface content: structured data, schema markup, content structuring for LLM retrieval, citation tracking and measurement. Solid SEO fundamentals underneath it. Delivery and program leadership experience in a fast-moving marketing, agency, or consulting environment. Strong client-facing communication and relationship management. Comfort with ambiguity and building process from scratch. Background we’d expect Most people who fit this have come from an agency or platform delivering AEO or GEO as a service. Think Scrunch, Bluefish, Athena, or similar. We’re also open to people who’ve built this capability inside a smaller business or for themselves. What matters is that you’ve actually done the work, not the size of the logo you did it for. Additional Information We Are Rosie provides strategic consulting and talent solutions for the marketing industry. We partner with more than 200 of the world’s biggest brands and agencies to help them solve unique marketing challenges with the best people, swiftly and at scale. Founded by former advertising executive Stephanie Nadi Olson in 2018, We Are Rosie is on a mission to redefine how marketing works, with an inclusive, human-centric approach that’s better for business and better for marketers. Our company has been recognized as an industry trailblazer and earned many accolades, including being named to the 2023 Global Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces, the Inc. 5000 2022, and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Agencies in 2021. We Are Rosie is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical​​​ condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or ​expression, veteran status, marital status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

items.description: [solidcore] is looking for a Facilities Project Coordinator to join our team to support our studios. Our ideal team member is empathetic, strategic, mission driven, puts people first and fosters a safe, welcoming and FUN work environment. Reporting directly to the Senior Facilities Field Manager, the Facilities Project Coordinator is responsible for supporting the daily maintenance/upkeep of the studios through work queue management. This position will be fully remote, with the ideal candidate residing in the Pacific Time Zone and the capability to travel to our Arlington, VA headquarters as needed. Responsibilities: Coordinate and track multiple facilities projects simultaneously from initiation through completion Manage a high volume of work orders across varying priority levels, ensuring timely responses and resolution by internal teams and vendors. Serve as the primary point of contact between internal teams, vendors, and building management Communicate project timelines and expectations to field and regional teams Solicit, review, and manage vendor bids and proposals Issue and manage work orders through our CMMS, FEXA Coordinate contractor site access, scheduling, and on-site activity Ensure vendors meet compliance, insurance, and safety requirements Coordinate with studio field teams to minimize disruption during project execution Enter and update project data in FEXA Serve as on-call point of contact for studio teams up to twice per month Ad hoc projects (ex. document overall review of vendor performance, rollout new vendor pilots across field teams) Support other Facilities Project Coordinators that are out of office What skills you’ll bring to us: A self-starter who takes ownership of their work, drives tasks forward independently, and proactively identifies what needs to be done without waiting to be asked. Able to identify problems, work though solutions, and connect the dots across departments. Balances big-picture thinking with attention to detail. Processes complex information and communicates it clearly and concisely to the right people at the right time. Understands that everyone is working toward the same goal. Willing to pitch in, celebrate teammates’ wins, and support others when needed. Able to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously, staying organized and effective in a fast-paced, high volume environment. Approaches feedback and challenges with professionalism and a growth mindset, using setbacks as opportunities to improve. Builds and maintains systems that keep projects, communications, and documentation easy to track and retrieve. Highly detail-oriented with strong file management and record-keeping habits that hold up under a high volume of concurrent work. It will be helpful if you possess the following: 2+ years of experience in facilities coordination, vendor management, or multi-site operations. Aptitude for prioritizing multiple projects. A ‘can do’ spirit and positive attitude. Compensation and Benefits: Compensation Range: $20.25-26.50 per hour, location dependent Bonus eligibility based on performance 401k with employer match Health, dental, & vision insurance Flexible PTO Free drop in classes at [solidcore] And MORE [solidcore] is a national boutique fitness company with 100+ studios across the country. Our signature workout is 50 minutes of low-impact, high-intensity strength training: the lights are low and the music is loud. The coach guides the class through a series of slow & controlled movements that are sequenced to work muscles to failure. This class is accessible for all fitness levels and can be amplified or modified to accommodate individual goals. Class is as intense as our reviews suggest, but our instructors go above and beyond to provide a welcoming, supportive, empowering, and challenging experience for all. Please visit our website here to read more about our mission. [solidcore] is firmly committed to social justice and promoting a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion. You can click here to find out more about the actions we are taking to promote a more diverse and inclusive space for both our clients and our internal team. [solidcore] is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. [solidcore] makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

items.description: Role Title: Microsoft Purview Engineer Department / Seat Name: TAC Engagement Type: Independent Contractor (1099), project-scoped Role Summary The Microsoft Purview Engineer is a hands-on Microsoft 365 security engineer who owns the technical execution of Purview data protection engagements for RSI Security clients. This role assesses current-state Microsoft 365 and Purview configuration, designs the data classification and sensitivity-labeling architecture, defines and implements DLP policies and use cases, and works directly with client business departments to translate their data requirements into working Purview controls. The role also performs Microsoft 365 / O365 security configuration assessments across Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Entra ID, and Defender for Office 365. This is an implementation and engineering seat, not an advisory one — the contractor is expected to be in the tenant, building and testing configurations, not producing recommendations for someone else to execute. Role Purpose The purpose of this role is to give RSI Security the depth of Microsoft platform expertise required to take client Purview deployments past initial discovery and into production. Clients engaging RSI for this work have typically completed baseline data scanning and begun testing DLP policies on their own, and need a practitioner who can assess what they have built, correct it, and carry the deployment to a validated, operational state. The contractor is expected to hold the technical conversation directly with client IT and security staff on implementation options, trade-offs, and Microsoft platform practices, and to defend the design decisions made. Core Responsibilities ● Assess current-state Microsoft Purview and Microsoft 365 configuration, including existing data discovery results, scan coverage, label taxonomy, and in-flight DLP policies, and document gaps against the client’s data protection objectives. ● Develop a Purview implementation roadmap and phased deployment plan, sequenced against client readiness, licensing, and business department availability. ● Design the data classification framework and sensitivity label structure, including label scoping, publishing policies, auto-labeling rules, and encryption and access-control settings. ● Define, configure, test, and tune DLP policies across Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and endpoint, including policy simulation, false-positive reduction, and user-notification and override behavior. ● Configure and validate Microsoft Purview Information Protection, data lifecycle and retention policies, and Insider Risk Management, matched to the client’s records-retention and regulatory obligations. ● Facilitate working sessions with client business departments to identify data types, ownership, handling requirements, and acceptable friction, and translate those into Purview policy configuration. ● Design and validate data protection controls for PII, PHI, and other sensitive government data, including controls governing Microsoft Copilot access to sensitive content where the client has Copilot deployed. ● Execute Microsoft 365 / O365 security configuration assessments covering tenant-level security posture, Entra ID identity and conditional access, Exchange Online protection, Defender for Office 365, SharePoint and OneDrive external sharing, Teams governance, and audit and logging configuration. ● Produce technical findings, configuration evidence, and remediation guidance in RSI report format, at delivery quality suitable for direct client release. ● Establish ongoing operational processes and handoff documentation so client staff can administer, monitor, and extend the Purview deployment after the engagement closes. ● Participate in client technical meetings and answer implementation and platform-practice questions directly, including trade-off discussion on licensing, scope, phasing, and control strictness. ● Provide accurate time and activity documentation sufficient to support invoicing and deliverable verification. Required Technical Qualifications ● Strong hands-on Microsoft Purview implementation experience — deployments carried to production, not pilots or assessments alone ● Data discovery and classification, including content scanning, sensitive information types, exact data match, and trainable classifiers ● Sensitivity labels and Microsoft Purview Information Protection (formerly MIP), including label policy design, auto-labeling, and encryption behavior ● DLP policy design, configuration, testing, and tuning across Microsoft 365 workloads ● Data governance, data lifecycle management, and retention policy configuration ● Insider Risk Management configuration and tuning ● Administration-level command of Microsoft 365 workloads: Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive ● Demonstrated experience building data classification frameworks from the ground up ● Demonstrated experience translating business requirements into working Purview policy configuration ● Demonstrated experience facilitating requirements workshops across multiple business departments ● Ability to produce an implementation roadmap and phased deployment plan and execute against it ● Experience protecting PII, PHI, and other highly sensitive data in regulated environments ● Microsoft 365 administrator or security engineer background, evidenced by current or recent certification items.description: About Bastion Bastion provides the regulated infrastructure businesses need to hold, move, and issue stablecoins. Our platform combines custodial wallets, global payment orchestration, and stablecoin issuance. Customers can use each product independently or connect them into a single end-to-end flow. We operate through our own regulated entities, with compliance and risk controls built directly into the platform. We can also support customers operating under their own licenses with the compliance and financial operations required to run their programs. Overview We are hiring a Brand and Communications Lead to make Bastion known to every institution that should be building with us. Bastion already has the substance: proven product-market fit, marquee enterprise customers, a regulated trust charter, and infrastructure major institutions rely on. What we need now is a market presence that matches the strength of the business. You will own how Bastion is positioned and shows up in the world, from messaging and visual identity to press, executive visibility, industry relationships, and targeted campaigns. Your work should build trust, bring the right customers to Bastion, and shape how the market thinks about the future of financial infrastructure. You will work directly with the CEO on building Bastion’s image, voice, and presence in the market. Fintech or financial services experience is a strong advantage. This market rewards credibility, precision, and a real understanding of how institutions make decisions. This role is ideally based in New York City, with a flexible hybrid setup. Work to Be Done Instead of a long list of requirements, here is what success should look like in your first 60 days. We move quickly. You should be contributing in your first week, showing clear impact within 30 days, and operating independently by day 60. By then, it should be clear to both sides that this is the right fit. First 15 days: Learn the business and start shipping Learn Bastion’s product, customers, regulatory position, and competitive landscape Understand how buyers find us, what matters in sales conversations, and where our story is weak Audit our website, content, press, events, and overall market presence Ship impactful work in your first week By 30 days: Set the direction and build momentum Define the target audiences, messaging, and channels to prioritize Develop a scalable content and communications production workflow leveraging AI tooling and contractors to operate at high velocity Improve how Bastion shows up across social media, website, and other prioritized channels Build an active pipeline of press, events, and speaking opportunities Align with Product, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure a steady stream of high signal communications from Bastion to the market Launch the first targeted campaigns for the businesses we want to work with Start tracking performance of brand & comms work via inbound qualified leads and pipeline influence By 60 days: Market sees Bastion Own Bastion’s positioning, voice, and external communications calendar Establish a steady cadence of high-signal company news, content, executive communications, and market commentary Secure initial press coverage, speaking opportunities, or other credible third-party visibility, with a strong pipeline behind it Have targeted campaigns live and reaching the right businesses and decision-makers Build a direct feedback loop with the Commercial team so our messaging reflects what moves buyers and we can see where the work is influencing customer conversations and pipeline Know what is working, what is not, and where to focus next Operate independently, make good judgment calls, and maintain a high quality bar without slowing down As a result of your work, we see a fast growing amount of qualified inbound leads and positively influenced qualified leads on the rest of the pipeline Hard challenges you will tackle Building brand awareness from scratch. There’s no existing playbook, press list, or event history to build from. You will be building the function while running it, making decisions with imperfect information, testing quickly, and iterating toward what works. Creating a market presence breakthrough. Incremental progress will not be enough. Bastion needs to go from being known mainly within our existing network to being recognized by the institutions, partners, reporters, and talent that matter. You will need to find the campaigns, moments, and relationships that can make that happen. Earning press in a space that’s noisy and focuses on already known household names. Most coverage goes to the biggest companies and the loudest stories. You will need to find genuinely newsworthy angles in Bastion’s work, build real relationships with reporters, and earn attention without relying on existing hype. Buyers of Bastion are diverse. Bastion’s customers include Fortune 500 companies, financial institutions, fintechs, and stablecoin-native payments companies. They do not speak the same language or make decisions the same way. You need to adapt the message to each audience without creating a different company story for each one. Operating as a team of one, with the impact of a team of 5. We expect you to leverage AI tooling and contractors for your work using your best judgement to maintain a high quality bar, in a space that’s very sensitive to AI slop. Your ultimate metric of success is influenced pipeline and inbound qualified leads. Bastion provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, and placement. Bastion participates in E-Verify to authorize eligibility of employment in the United States.

items.description: Company Overview LevelUp is a specialist agency that provides outsourcing solutions to agencies, software vendors, and website owners. For over seven years, we have successfully collaborated with a variety of companies, providing valuable technical, operational, and back-office support. We have a large team of skilled and passionate professionals who are committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients. Position Overview The Marketing Operations Specialist plays a crucial role in supporting global marketing strategies by acting as the primary marketing execution partner for assigned regions. Sitting between the global marketing strategy team and local teams, this role translates campaign briefs into live, tracked, and measurable programs. The ideal candidate is highly active and responsive, managing regional website updates, executing end-to-end campaigns, and serving as the primary point of contact for regional marketing technology (Martech) requests. Reference: 2635-154124 Responsibilities Campaign Execution: Own and deploy regional campaigns end-to-end, including landing page updates, email programs, UTM tracking, registration flows, and post-campaign reporting. Global Alignment: Work closely with regional Growth Leads and Corporate Marketing Operations to align localized campaigns with global marketing calendars. Event Support: Facilitate and execute demand generation programs, events, and webinars for designated regions. Martech Management: Serve as the primary regional contact for Martech questions, tool access, and user requests. Platform Triaging: Coordinate, triage, and route platform-specific requests (e.g., ZoomInfo, Salesforce, website updates) to their respective owners. User & Seat Admin: Manage seat allocations, user access, and tool usage reporting for regional team members. Website Operations: Handle regional website update requests, including content edits, component modifications, URL changes, and UTM setups on Webflow and Salesforce. Salesforce Automations & Reporting: Build and manage Salesforce flows, automations, and custom reporting dashboards to track lead ingestion and campaign performance. Requirements Experience: 2 to 3 years of hands-on experience in a Marketing Operations, Campaign Operations, or Martech Specialist role. Salesforce Expertise: Proven experience building workflows, automations (Flows), and custom dashboards in Salesforce. CMS & Webflow: Hands-on experience making website/landing page updates and component edits independently on Webflow or similar CMS platforms (full builds from scratch are not required) Campaign & Link Tracking: Strong understanding of manual UTM parameter setups and URL structuring for accurate reporting. Tool Triage: Basic familiarity with ZoomInfo or similar data tools to handle access routing and seat management. Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across cross-functional global teams. Shift Availability: Flexibility to support PH night shift hours for seamless overlap with global teams. Detail-Oriented: A structured approach to campaign tracking, quality assurance, and documentation before launching programs. Nice-to-Have Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) to assist with custom HTML/CSS snippets, copy formatting, or page tweaks. Familiarity or experience with administering webinar software platforms. Familiarity or prior exposure to SFMC campaign execution, email flows, or platform access management. More Infromation: This is a fully remote position with a standard 40-hour fixed-schedule work week. The exact work schedule depends on the client that you are assigned to, but is often an afternoon or night schedule and so having flexibility when it comes to schedule is important. We have a company culture that focuses on the well-being of its team members, with a good work life balance and respectful work environment. Equipment provided HMO + 13th month pay Compensation Additional Information
