items.title: Sr. Clinical Operations Manager
items.summary: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life.
items.description: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at . The Opportunity 🚀 This role serves as the operational backbone of the Global Clinical Operations (GCO) team, developing a deep understanding of GCO's day-to-day workings in order to help operationalize its running. You'll coordinate new projects, identify the right stakeholders, and partner closely with the GCO team, including GCO clinical leadership, to keep programs running smoothly. This is a hands-on operations role where success is measured by reliable execution, clean reporting, and strong cross-functional coordination. You'll be the connective tissue between GCO sub-teams and partners across product, commercial, GTM, and customer success, giving you visibility into how clinical operations decisions ripple across the business. What You’ll Own 💼 In this role, you will: Serve as the operations point person across GCO sub-teams, keeping frameworks, timelines, and ways of working consistent. Coordinate the GCO components of new projects end-to-end: identify stakeholders, track deliverables, and keep work moving across global clinical operations, product, and other partner teams. Track spend against program budgets, flagging variances to leadership. Spot and help close gaps or silos between GCO sub-teams by maintaining regular alignment touchpoints. Build and maintain dashboards and reporting infrastructure that give leadership real-time visibility into program status, trends, and open decisions. Pull together monthly operational updates, synthesizing data from Jira, Zendesk, Airtable, Salesforce, BI tools, and other program analytics into clear, actionable summaries. Help connect operational metrics to clinical and business outcomes so leadership has a clear line of sight from day-to-day activity to impact. Serve as a connector between GCO and commercial, GTM, and customer success teams, ensuring the right subject-matter expert is looped into RFPs, RFIs, and retention/expansion conversations. Ensure feedback from client-facing teams is incorporated into GCO program planning and prioritization. Identify opportunities to use AI tools, automation, and workflow improvements to save the team time and reduce manual work. Support team members in getting up to speed on new tools and best practices as they're introduced. What Success Looks Like 📈 In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Created and rolled out dashboards and reporting infrastructure that are adopted by GCO leadership.Improved operational efficiency across GCO, including reduced redundant meetings and streamlined recurring processes.Established a strong working rhythm with key GCO leadership and cross-functional partners. Successfully managed multiple projects concurrently, hitting key milestones and deadlines, with consistent reporting/status updates so stakeholders always know where each project stands. About You ✨ You likely have: A Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, public health, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience in clinical/healthcare operations. Demonstrated, hands-on experience in scheduling, budgets, and cross-functional coordination within clinical operations. Strong program and process-design skills, shown through a program management certification or 2+ years of project management experience, including building/maintaining SOPs, governance documentation, and decision-informing reporting. High comfort level with modern productivity and data tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, Salesforce, Airtable, BI dashboards) and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including AI-enabled tools. A demonstrated ability to operate across multiple fast-moving workstreams simultaneously without losing track of details. Strong documentation skills, with the ability to create and maintain clear, reusable, well-organized documentation. Extreme organization, with the ability to manage and maintain large databases and datasets accurately. The ability to establish a process and cadence for audits, ensuring data and documentation stay accurate and current over time. Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience in reproductive and/or hormonal health (fertility, pregnancy, menopause, low testosterone, gender-affirming care) and related coverage/benefit policies. A track record of using data to drive decisions — defining KPIs, building dashboards, running monthly/quarterly operational reviews. Comfortable operating in high-growth, ambiguous environments with a bias toward scalable systems and automation. Why This Role Matters 🧡 This role sits at the center of Carrot's Global Clinical Operations function, translating day-to-day execution into the reporting and coordination that leadership relies on to make decisions. By keeping GCO's sub-teams aligned and connecting clinical operations to commercial and customer-facing teams, this person directly shapes how reliably Carrot delivers on its clinical programs — and how clearly that impact gets communicated across the business. Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍 Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation 💰 Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from$128,000.00 - $150,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Customer Experience Real Time Analyst
items.summary: About CookUnity:Food has lost its soul to modern convenience.
items.description: About CookUnity : Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul. Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world. If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting. About the Team: We are looking for a Real Time Analyst to work with the WFM Analyst. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in maintaining service level agreements (SLAs), improving workforce allocation, and providing actionable insights to stakeholders in real time. The role: As a Real-Time Operations Analyst at CookUnity , you’ll play a key role in ensuring smooth daily operations across our CX teams. You’ll manage real-time data, support frontline teams, and help ensure we hit key performance targets. You don’t need to come in knowing everything about WFM—we’re ready to train the right person—but you do need to be analytical, action-oriented, and curious. If you love digging into data, thrive in fast-paced environments, and are excited to support both people and processes, we’d love to meet you. Note: You will be assigned a schedule that may include evenings, weekends, or holidays. These schedules will be adjusted periodically to meet the needs of our business. Responsibilities: Monitor real‑time metrics (e.g. service level, average speed of answer, schedule adherence, occupancy, handle time) and identify deviations from targets. Monitor queue conditions, agent states, workload distribution, and available capacity throughout the assigned shift. Adjust resource allocation on the fly: reassign agents, manage breaks, redistribute workload, even skill our team dynamically to maintain performance. Collaborate with WFM Analyst and CX Leadership teams to ensure shift coverage and service targets. Maintain detailed logs of interventions, staffing changes, and performance shifts to support post-event analysis and process optimization. Provide KPI reporting and crisis management during outages or spikes, and maintain detailed logs for performance review. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives—help build dashboards, refine real‑time monitoring tools, and share best practices across teams What You Bring Understanding of customer support or contact center operational metrics, including service level, average speed of answer, occupancy, adherence, average handle time, abandonment, and backlog. Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including filtering, pivot tables, lookup functions, conditional formulas, and data formatting. Ability to interpret live operational metrics and make logical, timely decisions. Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities. Clear written and verbal communication skills. Ability to escalate issues appropriately and communicate with stakeholders at different levels. Ability to remain calm and organized in a fast-paced environment. Proactive problem-solving skills and willingness to act within established guidelines. 3+ months of experience in workforce management roles . 6+ months of experience in a call center or customer support environment . Nice-to-Haves Familiarity with Zendesk, Slack, Google Sheets, or similar operational tools. Experience with Workforce Management platforms such as NICE IEX, Verint, Calabrio, or similar systems. Experience using Real-Time dashboards, alerts, or operational reporting. Prior exposure to incident communication or escalation processes. Experience supporting multichannel Customer Experience operations. Certifications in Workforce Management, analytics, Lean, Six Sigma, COPC, or related disciplines. Preferred Requirements: Logical thinking: You back decisions with data, not just instincts. Time management: You can juggle tasks and adapt quickly. Communication: You provide crisp, timely updates—especially when things change. Problem solving: You don’t wait for direction—you act when something’s off. Attention to detail: You catch small issues before they grow. Team collaboration: You work seamlessly with WFM, Ops, and CX teams. Willingness to learn: You’re curious and open to training in workforce management. Interview process: Application review - Please submit your English version resume Preliminary Assessment Take home Test Hiring Manager Interview Reference Check Offer Monthly Salary Range : USD 930 Shift 1 Sunday–Wednesday: 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM Saturday: 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM Days Off: Thursday & Friday Shift 2 Tuesday–Saturday: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM Days Off: Sunday & Monday Benefits: 💸 Get paid in USD 🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want ⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date 🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider 🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity , you get a 4-week paid sabbatical 🐣 Paid Family leave 🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises 🧘🏽‍♀️ Customize the benefits that suit your needs! Access a range of perks tailored to you, including learning opportunities, wellness memberships, delivery apps, and more through our comprehensive benefit platform 🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster. 🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time! CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability. A quick note for all candidates We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity . We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us: Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page. We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away. If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Fully remote URL: https://www.testgorilla.com/ We’re looking for a hands-on Sales Manager to lead a dynamic team of 6–8 SMB Account Executives, who own the full sales cycle from the initial outreach to close. You’ll own the SMB number, build a high-performance culture where the best sellers thrive. This is a true player-coach role : the antithesis of a hands-off, dashboard-only manager job! You’ll be on calls with your team every day, jumping in to help them close, modelling the behaviours and standards you expect, and turning every deal into a coaching moment. When a deal is stuck, you get on the call. When a rep is struggling with a stage, you show them how it's done. You don't wait for things to go wrong - you're out ahead of it, making your team and the company better. You'll use Gong and HubSpot deeply to inspect pipeline, coach reps, and continuously raise the bar. If you love being in the trenches with reps, getting on live calls, and showing people exactly how to close, this role is the one for you. Responsibilities Lead a global team of 6-8 SMB Account Executives, owning their ramp, performance, career growth, and creating a team culture people want to be part of and recommend to others. Carry the team SMB quota, owning forecasting, pipeline health, and weekly, monthly, and quarterly results, using HubSpot deeply for pipeline inspection, sequence performance, and reporting. Run high-impact 1:1s, deal reviews, and pipeline reviews focused on specific behaviors, using Gong daily to identify coaching opportunities, codify what great looks like, and accelerate ramp. Be on a high-volume of live sales calls every week, joining discoveries, demos, and negotiations to support reps, model best practices, and step in to close when it matters. Think and deliver in an AI-first way, using tools like Claude and n8n to reduce admin, improve rep performance, and help the team adopt AI effectively. Build, maintain, and continuously improve the SMB sales playbook, including discovery frameworks, demo structure, objection handling, and closing motions. Partner with VP Sales, Marketing, GTM Operations, and Customer Success to drive consistent SMB pipeline and customer outcomes, train the team, and surface front-line insights back to Product and Leadership. What you’ll bring We're looking for someone who: Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs. Has strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Thrives in a non-corporate, async-first, remote environment. Has experience managing SMB SaaS sales teams with a clear track record of hitting and exceeding quota, and a background as a top-performing closer before moving into management. Is a genuine player-coach: you actively want to be on live calls, jump into deals, and demonstrate how to close. Operates in a high-accountability environment: holding high standards for themselves and their team. Has deep, hands-on proficiency with Gong and HubSpot, including pipeline management, forecasting, deal stage discipline, call coaching, and reporting. Has strong coaching skills and a repeatable framework for developing reps with radical candor, plus experience hiring and ramping SMB closers in a high-velocity environment. Is very comfortable using AI tools, including Claude and n8n, and keen to help the team adopt them effectively. While we hire for skills over specific years of experience, we would generally expect that someone with the above skills has 3-5 years of Sales management experience. This is not a first-time manager role! We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you're interested in this role but your experience doesn't perfectly match the description, please still apply. Bonus skills While this isn’t a requirement, we’d be very interested to hear from you if you have experience: Selling and managing teams in HR tech, ATS, recruitment, talent assessment, or recruiting software. Leading SMB teams in a product-led, PLG-influenced, or self-serve-to-sales motion. What’s in it for you? Please note: Some specifics, particularly around leave, may vary depending on your country of residence. This will be discussed during the hiring process. Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world Competitive compensation: Receive competitive pay (Total OTE of €120,000-€151,000 on a 50/50 base/variable split) and Share Appreciation Rights (SARs) Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life. * Check out the Countries we currently hire from here Remote work budget: €1,000 available each year or up to €2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop! Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget and clear growth opportunities Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/testgorilla-manager-smb-sales

items.description: Company Description A leading global marketing and business advisory firm, partnering with a well-known enterprise brand to stand up a new Answer Engine Optimization capability from the ground up. This is a consulting engagement embedded with the client team, with potential to transition to a full-time role on the client side. Job Description Start Date: October 1st Length: 8 months Hourly Rate: $150 (based on experience) Location: Remote Hours: 40 hours/week Job Description This role owns the measurement and insights infrastructure behind the AEO program. You’ll build and maintain the prompt panel used to test how the brand shows up in AI-generated answers, evaluate the tools that support it, run quality assurance on the responses that come back, and turn all of it into dashboards and experiment analysis the team can act on. The core question you’re answering: when someone asks an AI platform about this category, does the brand show up, how is it described, and what makes that change. You’ll own the measurement system end to end, from designing what gets tracked, to auditing the quality of what comes back, to building the reporting layer that makes results legible to non-technical stakeholders. The job takes equal parts rigor and communication. Sound experiment design and consistent QA on one side, clear and usable findings on the other. This is a new category, so the measurement approach doesn’t fully exist yet. You’ll be building it, and some of it you’ll figure out as you go. You will be responsible for: Building and maintaining a structured prompt panel to test and track brand visibility and citations across AI platforms. Evaluating and recommending tools for prompt panel management, response capture, and analysis. Running quality assurance on response data, flagging inconsistencies, tool errors, or gaps that would compromise the accuracy of findings. Designing and building dashboards that make performance and trends clear and actionable for both agency and client stakeholders. Designing and running experiments to test hypotheses and isolate what actually drives changes in visibility. Analyzing experiment and panel results and translating findings into clear recommendations. Documenting measurement methodology and QA processes so the system is repeatable, defensible, and can transfer to the client team over time. Partnering with agency and client stakeholders to align on what’s being measured and why, and socializing findings as needed. What You’ll Be Measuring Visibility. Whether the brand appears in AI-generated answers across a defined prompt panel, and how often. Share of voice. How the brand’s presence compares to competitors within the same answers. Accuracy and framing. How the brand and its products are described, and whether that description is correct and favorable. Source attribution. Which pages, domains, and third-party sources the models pull from when the brand does appear. Platform coverage. How results differ across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, and AI Overviews. Consistency. How stable responses are when the same prompt runs repeatedly, and what that variance means for confidence in the data. Movement over time. Whether the work the team is doing actually changes any of the above. The Insights You’ll Deliver Where the brand is absent from answers it should be in, and the likely reason why. Which content and structural changes moved citation rates, and which didn’t. Competitive gaps worth acting on, and what competitors are doing to earn their citations. Prioritized recommendations for the content and optimization team, grounded in what the data shows. A regular readout that both agency leadership and client stakeholders can follow without a data background. Qualifications Must-have Hands-on experience measuring AI search or AEO/GEO performance: prompt testing, citation and share-of-voice tracking, or LLM response analysis. Experience building and maintaining measurement or reporting systems (dashboards, tracking panels, or similar) in an analytics or research context. Strong data QA instincts. You’re comfortable auditing outputs for accuracy and catching errors before they reach a report. Experience designing and analyzing experiments, whether A/B testing or similar comparative analysis. Proficiency with dashboarding and BI tooling, and comfort working with structured data. Clear written and verbal communication for translating technical findings into recommendations non-technical people can use. Nice-to-have Background at an agency or platform delivering AEO or GEO as a service. Technical SEO experience, particularly around structured data and content structuring for retrieval. Additional Information We Are Rosie provides strategic consulting and talent solutions for the marketing industry. We partner with more than 200 of the world’s biggest brands and agencies to help them solve unique marketing challenges with the best people, swiftly and at scale. Founded by former advertising executive Stephanie Nadi Olson in 2018, We Are Rosie is on a mission to redefine how marketing works, with an inclusive, human-centric approach that’s better for business and better for marketers. Our company has been recognized as an industry trailblazer and earned many accolades, including being named to the 2023 Global Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces, the Inc. 5000 2022, and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Agencies in 2021. We Are Rosie is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical​​​ condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or ​expression, veteran status, marital status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

items.description: Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide! Vonage Communications APIs: As an emerging leader in the $10B+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. For example, Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure. This allows them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel — including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more. Why this role matters Vonage is currently looking for a Deal Desk Analyst, based in Mexico who will provide direct support & guidance to the Sales Teams in all commercial aspects of deals with existing and prospective customers, including pricing quotations. The candidate will lead the commercial execution of complex, high-value deals and act as a strategic advisor responsible for bringing together Sales, Marketing, Operations, Product, Finance, and Legal team members to develop and execute Vonage’s pricing strategy. Your contribution will be essential to win deals, increase Vonage market share and grow the revenue stream. Your key responsibilities: Work with the Sales Teams in building price quotes for customers, including our largest and most strategic accounts Analyze deal margins and competitive positioning to ensure we are winning deals and market share without sacrificing long-term financial health. Actively collaborate with Operations, Finance, Legal, Product and Pricing teams to optimize the on-boarding experience of customers Help drive the adoption of CPQ, the Sales self-service quoting tool in SFDC. Transform raw deal data into actionable insights, identifying pricing trends and competitive shifts to influence Vonage’s global pricing strategy. Streamline and improve business practices, including tools, templates and processes, to increase the efficiency of the Deal Desk team Train and advise Sales and any other stakeholders on pricing, quoting, on-boarding process and commercial best practices Define and manage projects to deliver further operational efficiencies and deal velocity. What you'll bring Desired Skills and Experience Bachelor’s degree required; Business, Economics, Finance or Accounting undergrad majors preferred 4+ years in a Strategic Deal Desk, Sales Operations, or Commercial Finance role within a fast-paced SaaS or Telecom environment. Proficiency in Salesforce (SFDC), Tableau and CPQ environments. Strong analytical skills Excellent communication skills Problem solving Excellent Excel skills and data manipulation Fluent in English Personal Characteristics You are a self-starter, an initiator Customer-focused - Always thinks first about the needs of their internal customers. You are delivery-focused You are curious and informed - Stays on top of the latest in product, pricing, and industry news You are structured in your approach You have an innovative mindset and consistently challenge existing norms to drive improvement You have a team first mentality and put the company objectives ahead of your own Comfortable in a fast pace, global & multicultural environment How you'll benefit Medical Insurance Group Life Insurance Meal Card (Pluxee Tienda Card) Volunteer Time (VTO) Ericsson Care Line Additional benefits and perks will be shared and discussed with you by the recruiter during the interview process. #LI-ML1 There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you. To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice . Who we are: Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today. Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Sarasota, FL URL: https://www.simpletiger.com/ SimpleTiger is seeking a strategic, data-driven Senior PPC Manager to lead paid media strategy and execution for our B2B SaaS clients. This role is ideal for a seasoned performance marketer with 5+ years of hands-on experience building, managing, and optimizing multi-channel paid advertising campaigns. The Senior PPC Manager will own campaign performance across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram; translate client growth objectives into effective paid media strategies; and deliver clear, proactive communication and recommendations. You will work closely with our SEO, content, design, sales, and product teams to maximize qualified pipeline, customer acquisition, and return on ad spend for a portfolio of SaaS clients. Key Responsibilities Develop and lead comprehensive paid media strategies tailored to each client’s growth stage, business model, target audience, sales cycle, and revenue goals. Independently build, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram. Own campaign setup from end to end, including keyword research, audience strategy, account and campaign structure, ad group development, bid strategies, conversion tracking, budget allocation, and ad creative direction. Monitor and optimize campaigns against core performance metrics, including CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, conversion rate, pipeline contribution, ROAS, and ROI. Develop and manage testing roadmaps for ad copy, creative, landing pages, offers, audiences, bidding strategies, and campaign structures. Analyze performance data to identify trends, diagnose issues, uncover growth opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations. Partner with content and design teams to develop high-performing ad creative and messaging that resonates with B2B SaaS buyers. Collaborate with the SEO team to ensure PPC strategies complement broader organic search, content, and demand-generation initiatives. Manage paid media budgets responsibly, making informed recommendations on spend allocation, scaling opportunities, and efficiency improvements. Work directly with clients to communicate performance, explain strategy, set expectations, and provide timely, proactive updates and recommendations. Lead client-facing reporting and performance discussions, turning complex campaign data into clear business insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Partner with sales and product stakeholders to align campaign targeting, messaging, and conversion goals with customer insights and business priorities. Build and maintain strong relationships with platform representatives to access platform support, strategic guidance, beta opportunities, and new features. Stay current on paid media platform updates, privacy and tracking changes, B2B SaaS advertising trends, and emerging best practices. Contribute to the continued improvement of SimpleTiger’s PPC processes, reporting frameworks, account standards, and strategic playbooks. Provide mentorship, strategic guidance, and quality assurance support to junior team members as the PPC function grows. Requirements 5+ years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing PPC or paid social campaigns, preferably in a B2B SaaS, agency, or high-growth technology environment. Demonstrable experience managing meaningful advertising budgets across Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads; experience with Facebook and Instagram Ads is also required. A strong record of improving paid media performance through structured testing, optimization, and strategic budget management. Deep understanding of Google Ads, including Search, Display, remarketing, YouTube, Performance Max, conversion tracking, and bidding strategies. Strong working knowledge of LinkedIn Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, audience development, retargeting, lead-generation campaigns, and full-funnel B2B campaign strategy. Experience building campaigns from scratch and taking ownership of paid media accounts from audit through execution and ongoing optimization. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify meaningful trends, and make sound strategic recommendations. Proficiency with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and/or comparable analytics, attribution, and reporting tools. Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms, particularly HubSpot or similar systems, is strongly preferred. Familiarity with B2B SaaS funnel metrics, including lead quality, MQLs, SQLs, pipeline, CAC, LTV, and revenue attribution. Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex performance insights clearly to clients and internal stakeholders. Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple client accounts simultaneously. Self-directed and accountable, with strong judgment, initiative, and comfort working in a remote, results-oriented environment. Google Ads and Meta Blueprint certifications are preferred but not required. Compensation & Benefits 100% remote work environment Results-oriented work environment Flexible working hours and vacation policy Company-provided computer for all team members All typical U.S. holidays observed with full paid time off Health insurance through the JustWorks HR platform 401(k) through Vestwell To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/simpletiger-llc-b2b-saas-ppc-manager

items.description: Company Overview Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We bring solutions to physicians by providing constant enhancement of our products and services including EHR , practice management, marketing, patient coordination and billing. Job Purpose and Role We are seeking a skilled and motivated Linux / AWS Systems Administrator with a strong background in managing Debian -based systems. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 3 years of experience in system administration, cloud infrastructure management (preferably in AWS ), and automating operations in production environments. You will be responsible for maintaining and improving our infrastructure to ensure high availability, performance, and security. Key Responsibilities: Manage, monitor, and maintain Debian -based Linux systems in production environments. Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure, primarily in AWS (EC2, IAM, VPC, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, etc.). Implement and maintain infrastructure automation using tools like Ansible, Terraform, or AWS CDK. Write and maintain scripts (e.g., Bash , Python ) to automate routine operations and enhance system reliability. Ensure system performance, availability, and security, addressing incidents and resolving issues promptly. Configure and manage monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch). Support containerized environments and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker , ECS, EKS, Fargate). Collaborate with engineering and development teams to support CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows. Maintain proper documentation and version control using Git and ensure best practices are followed. Qualifications: 3+ years of professional experience as a Linux System Administrator or in a similar role. Proven experience managing Debian Linux distributions in production environments. Strong understanding of AWS services (e.g., EC2, IAM, VPC, S3, RDS, CloudWatch). Hands-on experience with automation tools like Ansible, Terraform, or AWS CDK. Proficiency in scripting languages such as Bash , Python , or similar. Familiarity with networking concepts, firewalls, DNS , and load balancers. Experience with monitoring/logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch. Knowledge of containerization (EKS, Docker , ECS, Fargate) is a plus. Comfortable with version control systems (e.g., Git). Preferred Qualifications: Experience with CI/CD tools like GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions. Familiarity with high availability and failover strategies in cloud environments. Exposure to compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2) is a plus. Full professional proficiency communication and documentation abilities. Location: Remote Hours: Available during standard US business hours (9am-5pm EST or 8:30am-4:30pm EST) This job description is intended to describe the general requirements for the position. It is not a complete statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements. Other duties not listed here may be assigned as necessary to ensure proper operations of the department.

items.description: About Us Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. At G-P, we’re dedicated to breaking down barriers to global business and creating opportunities for everyone, everywhere. Our diverse, remote-first teams are essential to our success. We empower our Dream Team members with flexibility and resources, fostering an environment where innovation thrives and every contribution is valued and celebrated. The work you do here will positively impact lives around the world. We stand by our promise: Opportunity Made Possible. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we invite you to join us in expanding your skills and helping to reshape the future of work. At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all. About the Role As an HR Specialist in the Employer of Record (EOR) industry, you’ll be a key business partner to our clients, not just a service provider. You’ll sit at the intersection of global expansion and workforce management- advising clients on complex HR matters across Southern Europe. You’ll own the full employee lifecycle, act as their trusted in-country HR expert, and ensure smooth operations, compliance, and growth. What You Will Do Employee Experience & Lifecycle Support: Act as the primary HR contact for onboarding, lifecycle events, and terminations to ensure a smooth and compliant employee experience. Complex Employee Relations & Terminations: Manage sensitive cases, attend calls or meetings, and draft legally sound documentation. Partner Management: Build and manage relationships with payroll providers, benefits brokers, and HR legal advisors. International HR & Consultation: Be the first point of contact for client queries on benefits, compliance, and workforce planning. In-Country Expertise : Stay ahead of labor laws and cultural nuances in Southern Europe to provide actionable guidance. Employment Law & Contract Advisory: Review and advise on employment contracts and risk mitigation. Performance & Compensation Support : Guide clients through Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) and ensure timely salary changes. Immigration & Mobility: Act as SPOC for employees’ immigration/mobility needs in collaboration with the Global Mobility team. Workload Transition & Knowledge Transfer: Identify delegable tasks, document processes, and ensure smooth handover for efficiency. Digital Transformation & Process Optimization: Drive automation and AI adoption to streamline HR processes. Compliance projects: driving and lead compliance governance projects across South Europe markets. Global Initiatives & Continuous Improvement: Lead efforts to standardize and improve HR practices globally. What We Are Looking For Minimum requirements: 3+ years of HR experience We require a fluent French and English - additional languages are a bonus. Deep expertise of labour laws and strong working knowledge of employment regulations across Southern Europe with focus in France (portage salarial). Experience supporting complex employee relations. Exceptional communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. Tech-savvy with HRIS, Zendesk, Jira, Confluence, Tableau, and collaboration tools like Zoom & Slack. Preferred Requirements: Knowledge of the EOR industry Experience working across other Southern European Countries including France The annual gross base salary range for this position is L138,400 - L173,000 plus variable compensation. Our ranges are established using objective market benchmarking data for this level of work. Final placement within the range is determined by gender-neutral criteria, including the candidate’s relevant skills, experience, and specific qualifications for the role. Actual compensation for this position may vary and will depend on multiple factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. For Full-Time Regular Employees, this position is also eligible for additional compensation as follows: Sales Roles: This position is eligible for a commission structure in addition to base salary. Non-Sales Roles: This position is eligible for an annual bonus which is paid dependent on various factors, including and without limitation, individual and company performance in addition to base salary. Benefits G-P values its employees and offers excellent benefits and perks including generous paid parental leave, flexible time off, spending accounts, medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, sabbatical after 5 years and more. Individuals residing, or applying to work, in the United States: California or Philadelphia , Pennsylvania, please review the following additional information: G-P will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act, Los Angeles City Fair Chance Act Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Act Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Act Ordinance. Los Angeles applicants can review additional information regarding the Los Angeles City Fair Chance Act here:Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and Philadelphia applicants can review information pertaining to Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Record Screening Standards Ordinance here:Fair Chance Poster. Any consideration of a candidate’s background check with arrest or conviction records will include an individualized assessment based on the factors required by applicable law, including the candidate’s specific record and the duties and requirements of the specific job. items.description: Planet Technologies, the Nation’s leading Microsoft services provider to the public sector, is looking for a highly motivated individual to join our growing team as an Information Assurance Specialist. In this role, you will be supporting impactful projects that make a difference for our country. The Information Assurance Specialist utilizes knowledge of Federal sector security processes, hardening of systems, and is essential to the team in managing projects in Azure DevOps, applying Scrum principles and practices to remove impediments and deliver value and foster a collaborative environment. Responsibilities Researches, organizes, writes, edits, trains, and produces technical data, guidelines, templates, and policy to support Security Engineering. Perform information security risk assessments across a variety of platforms and applications submitted through the Change Management process. Guide users in determining and integrating baseline security requirements, advise on viability of alternative approaches and conduct and evaluate feasibility studies. Propose remediation/mitigating controls and recommendations to stakeholders and management to minimize risk. Address security concerns or issues with proposed software and hardware projects to ensure “baked-in” security considerations in project proposals. Lead security team engagements to build and mature processes to produce written Standard Operating Procedures with a focus on improvement to Information Assurance processes, methodologies, and communication methods. Support iterative review of security assessment results and work with stakeholders across organizations to provide structure around risk management and internal controls. Experience with CIS Benchmarks and DISA STIGs to provide system hardening guidance. Maintain a Master Library of Security Benchmarks for relevant systems as a reference for essential baseline security requirements, compliance and continuous monitoring capabilities. Provide status updates and follow-up on active open Security Engineering tickets. Align with and support the execution of the Cybersecurity Information Assurance organization vision and strategy. Development of security guidance, policies, and procedures. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in related field and 3-5 years of relevant work experience with network engineering and/or system administration background (Unix/Linux/Windows) Previous experience with cloud providers like Azure and using Agile tools for day-to-day tasking preferably Azure Dev Ops. Experience with leading daily scrums, sprint planning and facilitating the scrum process (Scrum Certification preferred) Sound cyber security knowledge foundation, to include understanding of Computer and network technology fundamentals. Strong familiarity with NIST Security Controls (NIST 800-53) and ITIL Certification Experience with ServiceNow Experience with security tools in an enterprise environment to include installation, configuration, usage, and troubleshooting. Demonstrate security expertise with multiple Windows, and Unix-based operating systems. Excellent verbal and written communication skills and ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels. Strong problem-solving capabilities and the ability to effectively communicate solutions. Strong analytical capabilities. Strong understanding of how computer systems and networks are secured and in compliance with government and industry regulations. Ability to independently collect, review, and evaluate IT product data to identify and characterize security threat sources of concern and provide recommendations to Government leadership. Ability to articulate ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences through excellent written and oral communication skills. The ability to establish effective relationships with internal partners and teams. Must possess a valid baseline security certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CEH, or DoD equivalent) Ability to obtain Public Trust Clearance Planet Technologies is the leading provider of Microsoft Consulting Services to public sector and commercial organizations. Planet has significant experience in deploying business intelligence, cloud services, unified communications, and systems management with an emphasis building, deploying, and managing custom solutions that transform the business operations of federal government agencies. Planet Technologies does not discriminate in employment opportunities, terms and conditions of employment, or practices. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, gender, religious or political beliefs, national origin or heritage, disability, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, or any characteristic protected by law. Select positions at Planet Technologies have Federal Agency Clearance Requirements and may require up to a 10-year background investigation and/or US Citizenship (clearable). Salaries for Information Assurance Specialists at Planet Technologies range from $110,000 and $200,000. Several factors will impact final pay offered to a successful candidate including but not limited to the type and years of experience within the job, clearance level, the type of years and experience within the industry, education, training, etc. Visit www.go-planet.com to learn more about us. items.description: Portfolio Analyst Altius Search Group is recruiting for a growing financial services company seeking a Portfolio Analyst to evaluate portfolio performance, identify emerging risks, and support sound credit and portfolio management decisions. This position will analyze the quality, performance, and risk characteristics of the company’s financial portfolio. The Portfolio Analyst will monitor key trends, assess borrower performance, and collaborate with multiple departments to develop strategies that protect portfolio assets and support responsible growth. Key Responsibilities Analyze portfolio performance, including delinquency levels, defaults, loss trends, concentrations, and exposure limits Identify early warning indicators and areas of emerging credit or operational risk Review financial statements, payment history, and borrower performance to evaluate ongoing creditworthiness Recommend changes to risk ratings based on financial performance and other relevant factors Develop and support action plans designed to reduce portfolio risk and improve performance Produce recurring portfolio reports, trend analyses, and management-level presentations Collaborate with Credit, Sales, Operations, and Asset Management on portfolio strategy and risk-mitigation initiatives Provide analysis and supporting information for credit committee discussions Evaluate the effectiveness of existing credit policies, scorecards, and decisioning processes Maintain accurate records and supporting documentation consistent with internal policies and audit requirements Assist with special projects involving portfolio analytics, financial modeling, and strategic planning Requirements Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related discipline At least three years of experience in portfolio analysis, credit analysis, credit risk, operational risk, or a related financial services role Strong financial statement analysis and credit assessment capabilities Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and experience developing financial models Ability to interpret complex data and clearly communicate findings and risk considerations Experience working with risk-rating methodologies and portfolio performance metrics Background in data analytics, including regression analysis or similar statistical techniques Previous experience in equipment leasing, commercial lending, or another asset-based finance environment Familiarity with business development functions and commercial decision-making Experience with credit scorecards or automated decisioning tools is preferred Professional Attributes Analytical and intellectually curious Strategic and forward-looking Creative in approaching complex business and risk-related challenges Strong written and verbal communication skills Effective at collaborating with stakeholders across multiple departments Highly accountable, organized, and attentive to detail Capable of balancing portfolio protection with business growth objectives Compensation Base salary range: $65,000–$85,000 Additional benefits and compensation details will be discussed during the interview process Highlights Analyze portfolio performance, identify credit risks, assess borrower financials, and support portfolio strategy. Requires 3+ years of credit or portfolio risk experience. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Who we are:We are Pioneering Industrial Sustainability.
items.description: Who we are: We are Pioneering Industrial Sustainability. Castolin Eutectic is a global provider of surface protection applications and solutions. Since 1906, we have brought innovative products and solutions to our customers, challenging ourselves to extend useful life, reduce maintenance costs, and increase industrial productivity while upholding our deep-rooted belief in sustainability. We employ a diverse team worldwide in over 25 countries who represent our core values of customer orientation, integrity, respect, team spirit, and trust. Our employees are part of a global family who work together to provide the best solutions for our customers. Opportunity! We have a current opportunity for a Technical (Industrial) Sales Representative to help grow our welding consumables division. Position Overview The Technical Sales Representative is responsible for maintaining and growing sales with existing customers along with prospecting for new customers. Our ideal candidate will have experience selling in the industrial/manufacturing/fabrication and welding space. Must have an understanding and knowledge of welding, wear mechanisms and maintenance / repair welding. What You’ll Do: Maintain and grow sales in existing customers (customer retention). Prospect for new customers / acquiring new accounts / Cold Calling - Sales Hunter Provide, with the assistance of the technical support group, service and technical support to existing customers. Coordinate request for information or quotations. Manage approval projects for new technologies and applications to current and prospecting customers. Develop a territory plan. Propose and implement marketing strategies in the territory. Ensure continuous improvement and sharing of technical knowledge, competitive and product information and methods. Maintain key information in our internal CRM system. Requirements What You’ll Bring: 2-5 years of SALES experience - Cold Calling A mechanical aptitude A basic knowledge of welding/welding distribution, wear mechanisms and maintenance & repair welding Target minded people that are driven to succeed; thrive under pressure and enjoy setting and achieving goals Energetic and self-motivated individual High level of integrity and committed to serving clients Strong interpersonal skills and a strong ability to listen Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written Detail-oriented and versatile Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Anywhere in North America Postscript is the AI messaging platform trusted by 20,000+ Shopify brands — including Brooklinen, Ruggable, True Classic, and Dr. Squatch. With a mission to make SMS your number one revenue driving channel, we built the best-in-class SMS marketing platform and launched revenue-driving AI features not available on any other platform. And we're just getting started. Backed by Greylock and Y Combinator, fully remote since 2018. As a Business Development Representative (BDR) at Postscript, you'll be on the front lines, identifying, engaging, and making initial connections with ecommerce businesses ready to unlock significant growth through SMS. You'll be a vital ambassador for our brand, product, and company, playing a direct role in our continued success. Your day-to-day will involve building targeted account lists, sparking new opportunities through thoughtful and creative outreach, and ensuring a smooth hand-off to our Account Executives once you've qualified the prospect. This is a fully remote opportunity, offering you the flexibility to work from anywhere in North America. Primary duties Identify and qualify ecommerce brands that align with our ideal customer profile and demonstrate a strong potential for growth with Postscript. Consistently achieve and exceed your targets for generating qualified new business opportunities. Skillfully utilize a range of tools and technologies to research, identify, and connect with potential customers. You'll be encouraged to think creatively and resourcefully in your outreach efforts. Professionally represent Postscript's product, brand, and company in every interaction, clearly and concisely articulating how we can help ecommerce businesses thrive. Maintain exceptional standards for timeliness, responsiveness, and diligent follow-up with prospects. Accurately manage your activities and pipeline within Salesforce CRM, ensuring all sales data is consistently updated. Build foundational relationships with prospective customers, setting the stage for their future success with Postscript. You'll work closely with Account Executives to collaboratively nurture these early-stage opportunities. Continuously learn about our customers' marketing strategies, technology landscape, and broader business objectives. Collaborate with members of the Go-to-Market (GTM) team to contribute to the refinement of our sales process. AI-Enhanced Personalization: Leverage AI tools to analyze prospect data (e.g., LinkedIn activity, earnings reports, or tech stack changes) to craft hyper-personalized outreach at scale, moving beyond generic templates to drive higher response rates. Workflow Automation & Optimization: Utilize AI-powered sales tools to automate administrative tasks—such as CRM data entry, meeting summarization, and lead prioritization—freeing up more time for high-value strategic research and live prospect engagement. What We’ll Love About You 1+ years of B2B sales development experience, preferably in a SaaS, marketing technology, or a related domain Experience with a variety of sales tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, Sales Navigator, or Gong You possess a natural ability to build rapport and make initial connections with people. You pay close attention to details and approach tasks in an organized and solution-oriented way. You're developing your ability to prioritize tasks and think strategically about engaging with different businesses. You're eager to learn how to create value for customers and understand their business goals. You're motivated to meet and exceed expectations and have a genuine desire to learn and grow in a sales role. An interest in or basic understanding of ecommerce is a plus. What You’ll Love About Us Salary of USD $50,000 plus uncapped variable and significant equity regardless of location High growth startup - plenty of room for you to directly impact the company and grow your career! Remote team - work from home (or wherever!) Fun - We’re passionate and enjoy what we do Flexible paid time off Health, dental, vision insurance For information about how we use your personal data, please see our U.S. Job Applicant Privacy Notice For information about how we use your personal data, please see our U.S. Job Applicant Privacy Notice You are welcome here. Postscript is an ever-evolving place of equal employment for talented individuals. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/postscript-business-development-representative

items.description: Description Remote Corporate Leadership Role | Central or Eastern Time Zone Travel: Up to 80% Altius Search Group is partnering with a growing senior living organization to identify an experienced Regional Director of Memory Care Operations & Programming . This highly visible corporate leadership role will provide operational and programming support across multiple senior living communities, with a primary focus on memory care, dementia programming, leadership development, resident engagement, and continuous improvement . The ideal candidate is a strong multi-site leader who combines deep knowledge of memory care with the ability to coach community-level leaders, evaluate performance, and implement meaningful improvements across a portfolio of communities. Requirements Key Responsibilities Coach, mentor, and develop Memory Care Directors, Programming Leaders, and community leadership teams across multiple locations. Serve as a subject-matter expert in memory care operations, dementia care, resident engagement, and person-centered programming. Conduct onsite community visits, operational assessments, leadership coaching, and program evaluations. Train community teams on dementia-care best practices and innovative resident-engagement approaches, including Montessori-inspired programming. Evaluate resident engagement, quality outcomes, staffing models, and overall program effectiveness. Ensure memory care programming meets organizational standards and applicable state regulations. Identify performance gaps and develop actionable improvement plans. Partner closely with Operations, Clinical, Sales, and community leadership to improve resident satisfaction, family engagement, and occupancy. Provide support during new community openings, leadership transitions, and operational turnarounds. Stay current on emerging dementia-care research, regulatory changes, and evolving best practices. Qualifications Minimum 5 years of progressive leadership experience in Memory Care or Dementia Care . Multi-site, regional, or corporate senior living leadership experience strongly preferred. Strong understanding of Alzheimer’s disease, dementia care, behavior management, and person-centered programming. Experience implementing Montessori-inspired or comparable resident-engagement models. Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, train, and develop community-level leaders. Strong presentation, facilitation, organizational, and project-management skills. Ability to evaluate operational performance and translate findings into practical improvement plans. Comfortable operating independently in a highly visible field-based leadership position. Education & Credentials Bachelor’s degree in Recreation Therapy, Social Work, Human Services, Nursing, Psychology, Gerontology, or a related discipline preferred. Professional credentials such as Certified Dementia Practitioner (CDP), CTRS, ADC, or other dementia-care certifications are strongly preferred. Travel & Location Remote corporate leadership position. Must reside within the Central or Eastern Time Zone . Up to 80% travel , including frequent overnight travel. Candidates should be comfortable supporting multiple communities across a geographically dispersed portfolio. The Opportunity This is an excellent opportunity for an accomplished memory care leader who wants to expand their impact beyond a single community. The position offers the opportunity to develop leaders, influence memory care strategy, strengthen operations, improve resident experiences, and help shape programming across an entire senior living portfolio. Competitive compensation, annual bonus opportunity, comprehensive benefits, paid time off, 401(k), and career advancement opportunities are available. Altius Search Group is conducting this search on behalf of our client. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply for confidential consideration.

items.title: AI Creative Director / AI Associate Creative Director
items.summary: Superside is seeking visionary AI Creative Directors/Associate Creative Directors to guide a globally distributed team across branding, ad and social creative, presentations, print, and landing pages. In this high-impact role, you’ll shape the future of AI-enhanced creativity by integrating generative tools into our design workflows, elevating both quality and efficiency. You’ll lead by example as both a maker and a mentor, balancing hands-on creative work with strategic guidance. Collaborating with some of the world’s most ambitious brands, you’ll inspire cross-functional teams, develop human-centered creative strategies, and help build a scalable design practice rooted in experimentation, feedback, and continuous improvement.

You'll need to understand how words, visuals, pacing, and sound work together, and be confident writing dialogue, voiceover, and on-screen copy that reads naturally out loud.

items.title: Content Creator
items.summary: Superside is looking for a Cape Town based Video Content Creator who is a content creator at heart, comfortable in front of camera, constantly watching ads, and genuinely excited by the challenge of making paid social videos that people want to stop and watch. We’re looking for someone obsessed with new video ideas: the person who sees a Meta ad, a LinkedIn post or a weird Instagram Reel and immediately starts deconstructing why it works. What was the hook? Why did the first three seconds land? Was it the pacing, the caption style, the camera angle, the way the problem was framed? This role is for someone who naturally brings references, has ten rough ideas in the back pocket, and wants to test formats instead of waiting for a perfect brief. This is NOT a traditional video editor role. We’re not looking for someone who only wants to sit behind Premiere Pro and polish footage after the creative thinking is done. We need a hands-on creator who can help find the idea, shape the hook, appear on camera, storyboard the concept, support the shoot, and edit the final piece into something that feels sharp and native to the feed. You’ll work side by side with our Marketing Video Lead in Cape Town, tag-teaming concepts, shoots and edits in our dedicated studio and on location. You’ll also collaborate remotely with Superside’s wider creative team, sometimes owning projects from idea to final edit, and other times contributing to larger campaigns led by others. Your main focus will be creating advertising and brand content for Superside, including UGC-style ads, skits, direct-to-camera videos, explainers, campaign content and quick creative experiments. You’ll also support other teams across marketing on a varied mix of projects when your creative, production or on-camera skills are needed. You care enough about B2B and SaaS to make the work feel specific, not generic. You've got the editing and sound design chops to work confidently in Premiere Pro, the visual sense to storyboard in Figma, and the curiosity to use AI to make the work sharper, faster and more unexpected.

items.title: Data Scientist for Top Cosmetic firm
items.summary: Headquarters: Summary We are seeking a Data Scientist to analyze anonymized consumer interaction data and uncover patterns in unstructured language across call center and cross-channel conversations. The primary goal is to identify intent, surface trends, and turn language into structured insights that can inform content strategy and web experience
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Summary We are seeking a Data Scientist to analyze anonymized consumer interaction data and uncover patterns in unstructured language across call center and cross-channel conversations. The primary goal is to identify intent, surface trends, and turn language into structured insights that can inform content strategy and web experiences. General information This engagement focuses on a large historical dataset collected over 10 years across consumer information and interaction touchpoints. The data includes call center and cross-channel interactions, with existing KPI reporting around areas such as conflict types and call duration, but limited analysis of the underlying unstructured language. The data sits in a homegrown database and Azure environment, with an anonymized semantic layer. The initial phase will be exploratory and somewhat open-ended, starting with manual exports of conversation data before more connected pipelines are established. This role will work closely with a Program Manager supporting the broader effort. Tasks and Deliverables - Analyze anonymized consumer interaction and call center conversation data. - Review exported conversation data across channels, brands, and interaction types. - Identify intent patterns within unstructured language and conversation content. - Spot trends in customer language not captured by existing KPI reporting. - Convert unstructured language into structured insights and usable analysis frameworks. - Develop recommendations on how findings can inform content strategy. - Explore how LLM-era language analysis can support web content decisions. - Collaborate closely with the paired Program Manager on analysis priorities and outputs. Required experience - Proven experience as a Data Scientist working with large-scale datasets. - Strong experience analyzing unstructured text or language-based data. - Experience identifying trends, patterns, and intent signals from customer interactions. - Ability to translate exploratory analysis into structured, actionable insights. - Experience working with anonymized or sensitive consumer data. - Familiarity with Azure-based data environments. Engagement highlights - Opportunity to shape the first meaningful language analysis of a rich 10-year dataset. - High-ownership engagement with room to define the analytical approach. - Direct impact on how customer language insights inform content and web strategy. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-data-scientist-for-top-cosmetic-firm
